translation: 跳过；略过；不做（应做的事）
sub_section: Welcome to the unit
original_sentence: Carol often skips breakfast.
readingExamples: Carol often skips breakfast.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to not do something that you usually do or should do, especially eating a meal or attending a class
(2) vt. & vi. to leave out something or move past it, going on to the next thing
(3) vi. to move forward lightly and quickly, jumping from one foot to the other
(4) vt. & vi. to jump repeatedly over a rope swung under your feet

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】跳，蹦
uncommonMeanings.example: The child went along with little skips of happiness. 那孩子一路快乐地蹦蹦跳跳。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 跳（绳）；跳绳（skip rope / skip a rope）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children skipped rope in the yard until the sun went down. 孩子们在院子里跳绳，直到日落。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 蹦蹦跳跳地走;轻快跳跃
uncommonMeanings.example: The little girl skipped down the lane ahead of her grandmother, her pigtails bouncing, utterly unaware that this would be the last spring they ever walked together. （读后续写·童年·温情反衬）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (不辞而别地)溜走;逃避(常 skip town / skip class)
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than face the shame of his failing marks, he skipped class for a week, wandering the riverbank until the guilt grew heavier than any lecture could have been. （读后续写·逃避与自省）

posExamples.sentence: In her desperate rush to lose weight before the dance, Jenny began to skip breakfast day after day, never once suspecting that the very meal she scorned was the fuel her exhausted body was silently crying out for. （读后续写·健康·因小失大）
I am writing to remind every member of our study group never to skip the warm-up reading, for those few minutes lay the groundwork on which a whole productive session is built. （应用文·通知）
Those who habitually skip the small, unglamorous steps of learning often find, to their regret, that no shortcut can replace the patient labour they once thought beneath them. （议论文·勤学·反面论证）
Overjoyed at the news, the children skipped across the sunlit playground, their laughter ringing so freely that even the weary teachers paused to smile. （读后续写·喜悦·画面渲染）

wordForms.other: 构词/拼写:重读闭音节,末尾单辅音字母 p 前是单元音,故双写 p 再加 -ed/-ing → skip-skipped-skipping;skipping rope (n. 跳绳绳,英式) = jump rope (美式);词义辨析记忆:skip 一词多义——①(该做却)略过、不做(skip breakfast)②跳读、略过内容(skip over)③蹦跳(vi.)④跳绳(skip rope)

idioms.translation: (心)漏跳一拍;(因紧张/激动而)心头一颤
idioms.example: When she heard her own name announced as the winner, her heart skipped a beat, and for a moment the crowded hall dissolved into a warm, dizzy blur. （读后续写·惊喜·心理描写）

collocations.translation: 【课件】不吃早餐/不吃(应吃的)一顿饭 (skip vt. 不做应做之事)
collocations.example: Carol often skips breakfast. 卡罗尔经常不吃早餐。（课件·课文原句）
He's in trouble for skipping classes / the exams. 他因为逃课/逃避考试有麻烦了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】跳过(正常步骤/章节/细节)
collocations.example: You can skip (over) the next chapter if you have covered the topic in class. 下一章你要是在课堂上已经讲到了，就可以跳过。（课件原句）
Skip to the last chapter. 跳到最后一章。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】蹦蹦跳跳地走 (vi. 每一步都轻快小跳)
collocations.example: She skipped home merrily. 她连蹦带跳，开心地回家了。 He came along the road, skipping and jumping. 他一路连蹦带跳地走来。（课件原句）
She likes to skip rope as a warm-up. 她喜欢以跳绳来热身。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 不吃早餐（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Carol often skips breakfast. 卡罗尔经常不吃早餐。（课文原句）
Every evening the sisters skip rope in the courtyard. 每晚姐妹俩在院子里跳绳。
Doctors warn that teenagers who regularly skip breakfast are far more likely to feel dizzy and lose focus long before the morning is over. （议论文·健康·数据论证）
It was only after he began to skip class that his once-brilliant marks slid, quietly and steadily, toward disaster. （读后续写·堕落·因果）
Eager to reach the exciting part, the young cook skipped a crucial step, and the cake collapsed the instant it left the oven. （读后续写·操之过急）
The examiner advised us never to skip over a difficult question in panic, but to mark it, move on, and return with a clearer mind. （应用文·经验分享）
Every evening after supper, the sisters would skip rope in the courtyard until the fireflies came out and the counting turned to giggles. （读后续写·童年·温情）
So gifted was the shy boy in mathematics that his teachers arranged for him to skip a grade, though his heart secretly ached to leave his friends behind. （读后续写·天才的孤独）
During the exam week, several devoted volunteers even skipped lunch to help set up the charity book fair on time. （应用文·活动报道）
Do not merely skip through the passage hunting for answers; a single careful reading often reveals far more than three hurried ones. （应用文·学习建议）

synonyms.example: By oversleeping just ten minutes, she missed the only bus that would have carried her to the interview of her dreams. （读后续写·错失）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:miss 强调'因故未能赶上/得到',往往是被动、非本意(miss the bus / miss a chance);skip 强调'主动、故意地略过或不做'该做之事(skip breakfast / skip class),句法上直接接宾语

synonyms.example: In his haste, the reporter omitted one vital fact, and the whole story took on a meaning he had never intended. （议论文·媒体责任）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:omit 较正式、书面,指'省去/漏掉某部分内容',常 omit to do / omit doing;skip 更口语,常指略过步骤、章节或跳过一顿饭/一节课

synonyms.example: Determined to bypass the endless queue, the clever traveller booked her ticket online the night before. （应用文·出行建议）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bypass 强调'绕开、避开'某障碍/环节/人,含迂回之意;skip 强调'直接跳过'某步骤或不做某事,不含'迂回'

advancedExpressions.expression: skip breakfast / skip a meal｜skip class / school｜skip over sth.｜skip rope｜skip a grade
advancedExpressions.example: 从'不吃早餐'到'逃课''跳读''跳绳''跳级'——skip 一词多用:Carol often skips breakfast.(课文,不吃);Don't skip over the hard questions.(跳读);The girls skip rope after supper.(跳绳)。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表达'略过/不做该做之事'
advancedExpressions.expression: skip sth. / miss sth. / leave out sth. / give sth. a miss / go without sth.
advancedExpressions.example: 同一句可替换:She skipped breakfast. → She left out breakfast. → She went without breakfast. → She gave breakfast a miss.(均表'没吃早餐')

advancedExpressions.expression: never once suspecting that the very ... she skipped was ...
advancedExpressions.example: She skipped meal after meal, never once suspecting that the very nourishment she denied herself was the ground on which her whole strength stood. （分词状语+the very...强调，为后文晕倒埋伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to remind everyone never to skip ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to remind every classmate never to skip breakfast, however busy the morning, for a clear mind runs on more than sheer willpower. （通知/倡议中温和而有力的告诫）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who skip ... often find that no shortcut can replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who skip the slow, patient stages of learning often find, too late, that no shortcut can replace the mastery only time and effort can grant. （often find that... 引出教训，论证有说服力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Carol often skips breakfast.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Morning after morning, Carol would skip breakfast and dash out of the door, brushing aside her mother's worried voice — never dreaming that the empty stomach she carried so carelessly would one day betray her at the worst possible moment. （读后续写·健康·伏笔）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Morning after morning 时间副词营造习惯感 + brushing aside 分词状语加动作 + never dreaming that... 分词+宾语从句埋伏笔 + betray her 拟人化后果

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should not skip meals.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: However pressed for time we may feel, we ought never to skip meals in the vain hope of saving a few minutes, for a body starved of fuel repays us not with efficiency but with exhaustion. （议论文·健康观·辩证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: However pressed...we may feel 让步状语从句 + ought never to 加强语气 + in the vain hope of 揭示动机 + not with...but with 对比揭示后果

classPractice.question: 我一页不漏地读完了全书。
classPractice.answer: I read the whole book without skipping a page.
classPractice.note: 课件原题;without + doing(skipping);skip a page 跳过一页

classPractice.question: 跳过第一章，从第25页开始看。
classPractice.answer: Skip the first chapter and start from page 25.
classPractice.note: 课件原题;祈使句;skip 此处为'跳过(章节)'义

classPractice.question: 我建议我们不讨论细节，而是回到基本原则上来。I suggest we ____________ and get back to first principles.
classPractice.note: 课件原题;skip over 跳过、略去(内容);suggest (that) sb. (should) do,故用原形 skip

classPractice.question: 他们看见那个男人身后还跟着一个蹦蹦跳跳的小姑娘。They saw the man with a little girl ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原题;skip(vi.)蹦蹦跳跳地走;现在分词 skipping 作后置定语修饰 girl

classPractice.question: 我们挽着胳膊，蹦蹦跳跳地沿着大街走。
classPractice.answer: We skipped down the street, arm in arm.
classPractice.note: 课件原题;skip(vi.)蹦蹦跳跳地走;arm in arm 挽着胳膊

classPractice.question: Carol often ____ (skip) breakfast, which leaves her feeling dizzy by ten o'clock.
classPractice.note: 课文原句改编;主语 Carol 第三人称单数 + often 表习惯用一般现在时,skip 双写 p 变 skipped 只在过去式/进行时

classPractice.question: 用 skip / miss 填空(注意主动还是被动):Because he got up late, he ____ the early bus; but on diet days he deliberately ____ lunch.
classPractice.note: miss 因故错过(非本意);skip 故意略过、不做该做之事

classPractice.question: 每天晚饭后，孩子们都在院子里跳绳。(skip)
classPractice.answer: After supper, the children skip rope in the yard every day. / Every day after supper, the children skip rope in the courtyard.
classPractice.note: skip rope = 跳绳(此处 skip 是'跳绳'义,非'略过');一般现在时表习惯

sub_section: Welcome to the unit
original_sentence: Tom likes drinking fresh juice and yogurt.
readingExamples: Tom likes drinking fresh juice and yogurt.
definitionEn: (1) n. a thick, slightly sour food made from milk that has had bacteria added to it, often eaten with fruit or used in cooking

posExamples.sentence: Every morning before dawn, Grandma would stir a spoonful of honey into a bowl of homemade yogurt and set it by my bed, her quiet way of saying the love she never spoke aloud. （读后续写·亲情·细节传情）
For our class picnic, I suggest we bring plenty of fresh fruit, whole-grain bread and low-fat yogurt, so that a healthy meal need never come at the cost of a delicious one. （应用文·活动方案）
Nutrition experts remind us that a simple cup of plain yogurt, rich in protein and friendly bacteria, does far more for a growing teenager than any sugary drink ever could. （议论文·健康饮食·对比论证）

wordForms.other: 构词/用法小贴士:yogurt 是不可数名词(uncountable),不能说 a yogurt / two yogurts,要用量词——a cup / carton / pot / bowl of yogurt;拼写另有 yoghurt / yoghourt(英式)三种写法,读音相同 /ˈjɒɡət/;与 juice(果汁,亦不可数)同属'一杯……'类饮食名词

collocations.translation: 喝新鲜果汁和酸奶（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Tom likes drinking fresh juice and yogurt. 汤姆喜欢喝新鲜果汁和酸奶。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a cup / carton / pot of yogurt
collocations.translation: 一杯/一盒/一罐酸奶（不可数,靠量词计数）
collocations.example: He grabbed a carton of yogurt on his way out. 他出门时抓了一盒酸奶。
She topped a bowl of plain yogurt with berries and nuts, turning a plain breakfast into a small, bright celebration. （读后续写·生活情趣）
For those watching their diet, a cup of low-fat yogurt makes a light yet satisfying afternoon snack. （应用文·健康建议）
On that scorching afternoon, a cup of frozen yogurt tasted like the sweetest reward the summer could offer. （读后续写·夏日）
Thick, creamy Greek yogurt has become a favourite among health-conscious students for its high protein content. （议论文·饮食潮流）
Tom likes drinking fresh juice and a chilled yogurt drink after every training session. （读后续写·日常）

advancedExpressions.expression: a cup / carton / pot of yogurt｜plain / low-fat / Greek / frozen yogurt｜a yogurt drink
advancedExpressions.example: 点餐、写健康饮食清单必备:a cup of plain yogurt(一杯原味酸奶)、low-fat yogurt(低脂酸奶)、frozen yogurt(冻酸奶)。课文:Tom likes drinking fresh juice and yogurt.

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:列举健康饮食(可替换名词)
advancedExpressions.expression: yogurt / fresh juice / whole-grain bread / low-fat milk / fresh fruit
advancedExpressions.example: 写'均衡早餐'时并列替换:For breakfast I suggest fresh fruit, whole-grain bread and a cup of low-fat yogurt.(健康食物清单,写作高频)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Tom likes drinking fresh juice and yogurt.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Instead of reaching for sugary sodas as his teammates did, Tom always chose fresh juice and a cup of cool yogurt, a small daily habit that kept him energetic long after the others had wilted. （读后续写·健康习惯·对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Instead of...as his teammates did 对比结构 + a small daily habit that... 同位语+定语从句点明意义 + long after the others had wilted 结果对比升华

classPractice.question: Tom likes drinking fresh juice and ____ (a / \ ) yogurt after training. (若无需填词填 '\')
classPractice.note: 课文原句;yogurt 不可数,前面不加不定冠词 a,故留空

classPractice.question: 她每天早餐都要喝一杯原味酸奶。(yogurt)
classPractice.answer: She has a cup of plain yogurt for breakfast every day. / Every day she drinks a cup of plain yogurt for breakfast.
classPractice.note: 酸奶不可数,'一杯'用 a cup of;考查量词搭配

sub_section: Article: Teen faints after skipping meals
original_sentence: A teenage girl fainted yesterday at Stonechester High School after skipping meals.
readingExamples: A teenage girl fainted yesterday at Stonechester High School after skipping meals.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to suddenly become unconscious for a short time, especially because of heat, hunger, shock or exhaustion
(2) adj. (of a sound, smell, light or feeling) not strong or clear; slight and difficult to notice
(3) adj. (of a person) feeling weak and dizzy, as if about to lose consciousness
(4) n. a sudden, brief loss of consciousness

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】昏眩的，感到虚弱的(feeling weak) —— feel faint
uncommonMeanings.example: She suddenly felt faint. 她突然感到一阵眩晕。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 微弱的,隐约的,不清晰的(声音/光线/气味/希望)
uncommonMeanings.example: Through the fog a faint light glimmered in the distance, and with it flickered the first faint hope the shipwrecked sailors had felt in days. （读后续写·绝境·一线希望）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (of a person)虚弱的,头晕的,快要昏倒的(feel faint)
uncommonMeanings.example: By the third hour without food she felt faint, the classroom swimming before her eyes. 熬到第三个小时没吃东西,她感到头晕,教室在眼前直打转。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (not have the faintest idea)一点儿也不(知道),丝毫没有(=slightest,熟词僻义)
uncommonMeanings.example: He stared blankly at the question, not having the faintest idea where to begin, while the clock on the wall ticked mercilessly on. （读后续写·考场·慌乱）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 昏厥,晕倒(a dead faint 彻底昏厥)
uncommonMeanings.example: She fell into a dead faint the moment the shocking news reached her. 噩耗传来的那一刻,她当即昏死了过去。

posExamples.sentence: Halfway through the burning-hot ceremony, the exhausted girl swayed once, twice, and then fainted onto the polished floor, her collapse sending a gasp rippling through the silent hall. （读后续写·意外·紧张场面）
I am writing to warn fellow students that skipping meals to save time can make you faint in class, as one of our own classmates unfortunately did last week. （应用文·倡议书）
A faint but persistent worry gnawed at the back of my mind, warning me that something, somewhere, had gone terribly wrong. （读后续写·不祥预感）
Even the faintest act of kindness, a smile offered to a stranger, can ripple outward in ways we may never live to witness. （议论文·善意·观点论证）

wordForms.other: 一词多性记忆:faint 既是动词(晕倒)又是形容词(微弱的/虚弱的)还可作名词(昏厥);faint-hearted (adj. 胆怯的、懦弱的);短语 not have the faintest idea 中 faintest 是 faint 的最高级,=slightest;辨析近形词 feint(n./v. 佯攻、假动作)勿混

idioms.example: When the teacher asked who had left the classroom door unlocked, the whole class fell silent, for not one of them had the faintest idea. （读后续写·谜团）

idioms.idiom: faint heart never won fair lady
idioms.translation: (谚)懦夫难得美人心;不勇敢就得不到想要的
idioms.example: Reminding himself that faint heart never won fair lady, the trembling boy finally stepped forward to ask her for the very first dance. （读后续写·鼓起勇气）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(vi.)因饥饿而昏厥、饿昏过去
collocations.example: The girl fainted from hunger after skipping meals. 那女孩不吃饭后饿昏了过去。（课件·vi. 昏厥 faint from hunger）
She suddenly felt faint. 她突然感到一阵眩晕。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: a faint light / a faint smile
collocations.translation: 【课件】(adj.)微弱的光/微微一笑 (微弱的、不清楚的)
collocations.example: a faint light 微弱的光; a faint smile 微微一笑。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(声音等)逐渐变弱、变模糊
collocations.example: We could hear their voices growing fainter as they walked down the road. 他们沿路走远时我们听见他们的说话声逐渐模糊。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: a faint hope / the faintest chance
collocations.translation: 【课件】(adj.)一线希望/微乎其微的可能 (可能性不大的、微小的 = slight)
collocations.example: There is still a faint hope that she may be cured. 她的病还有一点点希望可以治愈。 They don't have the faintest chance of winning. 他们毫无获胜的可能。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 不吃饭后晕倒（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: A teenage girl fainted yesterday at Stonechester High School after skipping meals. 一名少女昨天在斯通切斯特中学不吃饭后晕倒了。（课文原句）
She stood up too fast and suddenly felt faint. 她起身太快，突然感到一阵眩晕。

collocations.translation: 一丝淡淡的气味/微弱的声音/微光
collocations.example: A faint smell of jasmine drifted in through the window. 一缕淡淡的茉莉花香从窗户飘了进来。

collocations.translation: 毫无头绪，一点儿也不知道（熟词僻义,faint=slightest）
collocations.example: I haven't the faintest idea where she has gone. 我完全不知道她去哪儿了。

collocations.translation: 因饥饿/炎热/疲惫而晕倒
collocations.example: After marching under the blazing sun for hours, several soldiers began to faint from exhaustion, one after another. （读后续写·极限考验）
The moment she stood up too quickly, she felt faint, and the whole room seemed to tilt and swim before her eyes. （读后续写·身体不适）
In the dead of night a faint sound of footsteps reached her ears, and every hair on her arms rose in alarm. （读后续写·悬疑）
A faint smile crossed the old man's tired face, as if some long-buried happiness had briefly surfaced. （读后续写·人物神情）
Clinging to a faint hope that help might still come, the trapped miners kept tapping on the rock, hour after hour. （读后续写·绝境求生）
She grew faint with relief when the doctor at last stepped out and said, gently, that her father would be all right. （读后续写·转危为安）
He had only a faint recollection of the seaside town where, as a small boy, he had once been so happy. （读后续写·回忆）
Lost in her book, she was only faintly aware of the rain that had begun to drum softly against the window. （读后续写·氛围）

synonyms.example: The runner crossed the line, staggered two steps, and passed out into the arms of the waiting medics. （读后续写·极限）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pass out 更口语,泛指各种原因(含醉酒)突然完全失去知觉倒下;faint(v.) 略正式,常暗示因虚弱/饥饿/情绪等短暂晕厥,两者作动词常可互换。句法:两者都是不及物,faint 单个词,pass out 是短语动词

synonyms.example: Overcome by grief, she collapsed onto the cold hospital chair, unable to hold herself upright a moment longer. （读后续写·悲痛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:collapse 指'身体突然瘫软倒下',未必失去意识,画面感/程度更强;faint 特指'短暂昏厥、失去知觉'。collapse 也可指(建筑/计划)倒塌、崩溃

synonyms.example: In the dim glow of the single candle, their two shadows swayed gently on the wall like old friends dancing. （读后续写·氛围）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dim 专指光线/视线昏暗微弱,或(记忆/前景)暗淡;faint(adj.) 范围更广,可指声、光、味、希望、微笑等一切'微弱、隐约'之物

advancedExpressions.expression: faint from hunger / heat｜feel faint｜a faint smell / light / hope / smile｜not have the faintest idea
advancedExpressions.example: 一词横跨'晕倒'与'微弱':She fainted from hunger.(晕倒) / She felt faint.(头晕) / a faint hope(一线希望) / I haven't the faintest idea.(毫无头绪)。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表达'晕倒/失去知觉'

synonyms.example: The documentary about melting glaciers left such a deep impact on the students that many began cycling to school. （议论文·环保）
synonyms.usage: 近义辨析②：impact 语气更强，指'强烈、显著的冲击性影响'，常搭 on；effect 为中性通用词，指任何'结果、作用'，程度不限

synonyms.example: Her gentle influence on the whole class was like sunlight — quiet, warm and impossible to ignore. （读后续写·感染力）
synonyms.usage: 近义辨析③：influence 侧重长期、潜移默化地'改变人的思想或行为'，常指人对人的感化；effect 侧重某一原因直接产生的'具体结果'

synonyms.example: The result of years of patient practice showed itself in a single flawless performance. （读后续写·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 近义辨析④：result 侧重事件'最终产生的结局'，是过程的终点；effect 侧重某原因'带来的作用或影响'，强调因果关系本身

synonyms.example: He acted without a second thought, never imagining the painful consequence his careless words would bring. （读后续写·冲动）
synonyms.usage: 近义辨析⑤：consequence 多指'(尤指负面的)后果、结局'，语气较重且常带评价；effect 中性，好坏皆可，单纯陈述作用

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·effect(n.)/affect(v.) 形近易混辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: affect 动词'影响'；effect 名词'影响/效果'（也有正式动词义'实现'）
advancedExpressions.example: Lack of sleep affects (v.) your grades. = Lack of sleep has an effect (n.) on your grades. —— 高考语法填空高频考点。口诀：Affect=Action(动词)，Effect 常作名词。（课件辨析）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·effect 词族(并入 effective)
advancedExpressions.expression: effect(n.) → effective(有效的) → effectively(有效地/实际上) → effectiveness(有效性) → ineffective(无效的)
advancedExpressions.example: an effective method 有效方法 / take effect 生效 / do it effectively 有效地做 / an ineffective way 无效的办法（课件填空考点：effect→effective→effectively→ineffective 一网打尽）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·effect 高频搭配（高考必备）
advancedExpressions.expression: have/produce/exert an effect on 对…有影响 / take effect 生效 / come into effect (法规)开始实施 / in effect 实际上 / put·bring ... into effect 付诸实施 / with immediate effect 立即生效 / side effect 副作用
advancedExpressions.example: The new rule came into effect last week and has already had a real effect on students' habits. （一句串联高频用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·影响/作用（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: have an effect on / have an impact on / exert an influence on / take a toll on（负面）
advancedExpressions.example: have a negative effect on health → take a heavy toll on one's health（议论文高级替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: a single ... had an effect far greater than sb. could ever have imagined
advancedExpressions.example: A single word of encouragement had an effect far greater than the old teacher could ever have imagined — it kept a hopeless boy in school for one more day, and that day changed everything. （以小见大+补叙点明深远影响）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we hope to ..., we must first understand the effect that ... has on ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we truly hope to build a healthier campus, we must first understand the effect that irregular meals and endless late nights have on our developing bodies. （倡议信·由认知引出行动号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: the positive effect of ... should not blind us to its potential negative effect on ...
advancedExpressions.example: The positive effect of artificial intelligence on efficiency should not blind us to its potential negative effect on human creativity and independent thought. （承认利处+not blind us to 转折，凸显辩证）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·effect 高频搭配（高考必备）
advancedExpressions.expression: have an effect on 对…有影响 / take effect 生效 / come into effect (法规)开始实施 / in effect 实际上 / put ... into effect 付诸实施 / side effect 副作用
advancedExpressions.example: The new rule came into effect last week and has already had a real effect on students' habits. （一句串联高频用法）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His words influenced me a lot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The few quiet words he offered that evening had an effect on me that time has never worn away; even now, whenever doubt creeps in, I hear his voice steadying me like a hand on my shoulder. （读后续写·师长影响·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: have an effect on 替换 influence + time has never worn away 时间维度延展 + a hand on my shoulder 触觉隐喻外化安慰

sentenceUpgrade.original: Junk food is bad for our health.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The cumulative effect of a diet dominated by junk food is far more alarming than a single unhealthy meal suggests, for it silently undermines the very body on which a bright future must be built. （议论文·健康·因果论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the cumulative effect of 抽象名词化主语 + far more...than...suggests 比较凸显严重性 + silently undermines...隐喻+ on which 定语从句升华

sub_section: Article: Teen faints after skipping meals
original_sentence: They are increasing their efforts to educate teenagers about the side effects of losing weight too quickly.
readingExamples: They are increasing their efforts to educate teenagers about the side effects of losing weight too quickly.
definitionEn:
(1) phr./n. an unwanted and often harmful result that a drug or medical treatment produces in addition to its intended effect
(2) phr./n. an unplanned or unexpected consequence, usually undesirable, that accompanies a course of action or decision

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （引申）意想不到的连带结果，附带影响（不限于药物，可褒可贬）
uncommonMeanings.example: An unexpected side effect of volunteering was that the shy boy I once was slowly disappeared. （读后续写·成长收获）

posExamples.sentence: Desperate to lose weight before the class photo, she began skipping meals, never dreaming that the dizziness and constant fatigue were the first cruel side effects of her reckless plan. （读后续写·减肥·后果警示）
I am writing to remind all boarding students that so-called 'quick-fix' slimming pills often carry serious side effects, and no photograph is worth the health of your growing body. （应用文·健康倡议信）
While endless online learning brings undeniable convenience, one worrying side effect is the growing distance between classmates who now share a screen but rarely share a smile. （议论文·网络学习·辩证论证）

An unexpected side effect of volunteering at the nursing home was that the shy, silent boy I once was slowly disappeared, replaced by someone who could finally look strangers in the eye. （读后续写·志愿·成长收获）

collocations.example: Now I know this extreme weight-loss method has serious side effects. 如今我明白这种极端减肥方法有严重的副作用。（课件/课文·副作用）

collocations.phrase: the side effects of losing weight too quickly
collocations.translation: 过快减肥的副作用（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: They are increasing their efforts to educate teenagers about the side effects of losing weight too quickly. （课文原句·健康教育）
The doctor warned that the new pills might cause mild side effects. （应用文·就医）
Losing weight too quickly can bring serious side effects that damage a teenager's body. （议论文·健康）

collocations.translation: 令人不适的/不想要的副作用
collocations.example: The medicine eased his cough, yet the unpleasant side effects kept him tossing all night. （读后续写·守夜）
A potential side effect of praising children only for marks is that they come to fear failure. （议论文·教育）
Teachers educate students about the side effects of losing weight too quickly, from fainting to lasting harm. （应用文·健康教育）
A balanced diet and regular exercise are the only 'medicine' that strengthens the body without side effects. （议论文·健康之道）

collocations.translation: 一个意想不到的副作用/连带结果
collocations.example: An unexpected side effect of keeping a diary was that I began to treasure the tiny joys I once walked past. （读后续写·习惯）

synonyms.example: Deep friendship was an unexpected by-product of the long hours we spent rehearsing for the play. （读后续写·情谊）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：by-product 中性，指'伴随主要结果产生的附带产物'，好坏皆可；side effect 多含'不良、不想要'的意味，尤指药物或行为的负面后果

synonyms.example: He never paused to weigh the consequences of his hasty decision until it was too late. （读后续写·冲动）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：consequence 泛指'(尤指负面的)最终后果'，范围更广；side effect 特指'伴随主要作用而来的附带负面影响'，常与医药、政策相关

synonyms.example: The aftereffects of that sleepless week lingered for days, dulling her thoughts. （读后续写·熬夜）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：aftereffect 强调'事件结束后一段时间才显现或持续的影响'；side effect 强调'与主作用同时伴随产生的附带影响'

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 side + effect
advancedExpressions.expression: side（附带的、旁侧的）+ effect（作用）→ side effect 副作用
advancedExpressions.example: 课本同类合成词一组：side effect（副作用）、weight-loss（减重）、over-exercise（过度运动）、quick-fix（速效的）、self-image（自我形象）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·side effect 核心搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: have / cause side effects 引起副作用 / serious side effects 严重副作用 / the side effects of doing sth 做某事的副作用 / without side effects 无副作用
advancedExpressions.example: Crash diets often cause serious side effects, while healthy eating strengthens the body without side effects. （串联核心用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·负面后果（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: side effect / harmful consequence / downside / drawback / hidden cost
advancedExpressions.example: the side effects of dieting too fast → the hidden costs of crash dieting（议论文高级替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: what sb. never expected were the side effects that ...
advancedExpressions.example: What she never expected were the side effects that crept up on her one by one — the trembling hands, the fainting spells, the mother's tears — until the mirror finally showed her the price of her foolish pride. （逐项罗列+递进，让代价具象化）

advancedExpressions.expression: before you try ..., consider the side effects it may bring
advancedExpressions.example: Before you try any drastic method to lose weight, please consider the side effects it may bring, for a healthy body is a treasure no quick result can ever replace. （倡议信·劝诫句式+价值升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: every solution carries its own side effects; the wise ask not only whether it works, but at what cost
advancedExpressions.example: Every convenient solution carries its own side effects; the truly wise ask not only whether a method works, but at what cost to the body, the mind and the future. （否定简单化+at what cost 三重追问深化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Losing weight too fast is bad for teenagers.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: far from the harmless shortcut 否定假象 + 破折号插入三项side effects 具体化 + outlast...satisfaction 时间对比凸显得不偿失

sentenceUpgrade.original: Helping others also helped me grow.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Helping others turned out to have a wonderful side effect I had never sought: with every hand I reached out, the shy, uncertain boy inside me quietly grew braver, until one day I no longer recognised my old fear. （读后续写·志愿·成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: side effect 反用于积极语境制造惊喜 + with every hand I reached out 平行递进 + no longer recognised my old fear 今昔对比收束

classPractice.note: 药物负面附带作用用 side effect；by-product 中性指'副产品'

translation: 证明，证实；后来被发现是
sub_section: Article: Teen faints after skipping meals
original_sentence: These so-called 'quick-fix methods' prove to be harmful to teenagers.
readingExamples: These so-called 'quick-fix methods' prove to be harmful to teenagers.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to show that something is true or correct by providing evidence, facts or a logical argument
(2) vi. to turn out to be; to be found to have a particular quality or result after a period of time or experience
(3) vt. to demonstrate one's own worth, ability or courage through actions rather than words
(4) vt. (law) to establish the validity or genuineness of a will or document

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 后来被发现是，结果是（系动词 link-verb 用法，后接 to be/形容词/名词，并非'证明'，且无被动语态）
uncommonMeanings.example: The path that had looked so frightening in the dark proved, in the light of morning, to be a gentle slope lined with wildflowers. （读后续写·恐惧消散）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 证明自己（的价值/能力），争一口气（prove oneself）
uncommonMeanings.example: Overlooked all his life, the quiet boy stepped up to the microphone with one burning wish — to prove himself. （读后续写·逆袭）

posExamples.sentence: The shortcut Grandpa swore by proved to be a disaster, for within minutes we were hopelessly lost among identical hills, laughing and grumbling in equal measure. （读后续写·迷路·幽默叙事）
I am writing to propose a school recycling scheme, and I am confident that, given a single month's trial, it will prove both practical and rewarding for every class. （应用文·建议信）
History has proved, time and again, that a nation which values knowledge over ignorance will always find its way through the darkest of times. （议论文·教育·论证）
Words were never his weapon; instead, the shy new boy chose to prove his worth quietly, staying late each evening to help clean the classroom no one else remembered. （读后续写·人物·默默付出）

wordForms.noun: proof (n. 证据,证明); prover (n. 证明者)
wordForms.adjective: proven / proved (adj. 被证实的); proof (adj. 防……的,如 waterproof)
wordForms.other: disprove (vt. 反驳,证明……有误); approve (vt./vi. 批准,赞成); improve (vt./vi. 改进); provable (adj. 可证明的); irregular: prove - proved - proved / proven

idioms.example: Given at last the chance he had waited years for, he was determined to prove himself, and he poured every ounce of his heart into that single performance. （读后续写·机会·励志）

idioms.translation: 例外印证规律;有例外反而说明有规律
idioms.example: One lazy afternoon hardly means she is careless — the exception proves the rule, and years of diligence speak far louder than a single slip. （议论文·辩证·反驳）

idioms.translation: 证明自己的观点是对的
idioms.example: Rather than arguing louder, she quietly finished the impossible task and let the result prove her point. （读后续写·沉默的胜利）

idioms.idiom: the proof of the pudding is in the eating
idioms.translation: 空谈无益,实践检验真理;是骡是马拉出来遛遛
idioms.example: They doubted whether a group of teenagers could run a charity sale, but the proof of the pudding is in the eating, and by nightfall every last item was sold. （议论文·实践·例证）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（系动词，无被动，to be 可省）事实证明是……，最后被发现是…… ≈ turn out to be
collocations.example: The design proved (to be) a success. 这个设计最后被发现是成功的。 / The promotion proved to be a turning point in his career. 这次晋升最后证明是他职业生涯的一个转折点。（PPT 原句·系动词用法）
He managed to prove his innocence to the police. 他得以向警察证明自己是无辜的。（PPT 原句·vt. 用法）
He proved himself determined to succeed. 他向人证明了自己不达目的不罢休。（PPT 原句·prove oneself）
They said she would never walk again, but she was determined to prove them wrong. 他们说她再也无法行走，但她下定决心要证明他们错了。（PPT【归纳】·prove sb wrong）
It has been proved / proven that the theory is correct. 这个理论已经被证明是正确的。（= The theory has proved (to be) correct.）（PPT 原句·被动 that 从句）

collocations.phrase: prove to be harmful to teenagers
collocations.translation: 结果证明对青少年有害（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: These so-called 'quick-fix methods' prove to be harmful to teenagers. （课文原句·系动词用法）

collocations.translation: 证明是，结果是……（系动词用法）
collocations.example: The stranger who had seemed so cold at first proved to be the kindest soul on the whole journey. （读后续写·反差）
Her sudden success proved that talent, without the courage to be seen, remains a locked treasure. （议论文·勇气）
In that crisis he proved himself a leader, calm where others panicked. （读后续写·危机）
Everyone had written off the small mountain school, and nothing tasted sweeter than the day its students proved them all wrong. （读后续写·逆袭）
The internship was his one chance to prove his worth, and he refused to waste a minute. （读后续写·奋斗）
Kindness done in secret is hard to prove, yet it is often the truest kindness of all. （议论文·善行）
The new reading corner proved so popular that students queued before class to claim a seat. （应用文·反馈）
We had feared the storm would ruin everything but, as it proved, it only made our shelter feel warmer. （读后续写·转折）

synonyms.example: Through one selfless act after another, she demonstrated a courage no words could capture. （读后续写·行动）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：demonstrate 侧重'通过行动、实例清楚地展示、表明'，较正式；prove 侧重'用证据或结果确证某事为真'，强调最终确凿性

synonyms.example: The task that had looked impossible turned out to be surprisingly simple once we started thinking. （读后续写·反转）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：turn out 为口语化短语，指事情'最终结果、原来是……'；prove 作系动词时义近（prove to be = turn out to be），但更书面，常接 to be

synonyms.example: The second experiment confirmed exactly what she had suspected all along. （读后续写·科研）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：confirm 侧重'进一步证实、确认已有的猜想或说法'；prove 侧重'从无到有地确立某事为真'，是初次证明

synonyms.example: The investigation finally established the truth that had been buried for years. （议论文·正义）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：establish 较正式，侧重'牢固地确立事实、真相或制度'；prove 更通用，泛指'证明某事成立'

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·prove 用法归纳（课件·重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: ① prove (to be)+n./adj. 事实证明是（系动词，无被动，to be 可省）② prove sth to sb 向某人证明某事 ③ prove oneself (to be) 证明自己是 ④ prove sb wrong 证明某人错 ⑤ It is proved/proven that... 据证明 ⑥ There's (no) proof that... （没）有证据证明
advancedExpressions.example: The design proved (to be) a success（系动词）; he proved his innocence to the police（vt.）; it is proved that the theory is correct（被动 that 从句）。（PPT【归纳】一表串讲六大用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·proof / prove 辨析（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: prove v. 证明 / proof n.（不可数）证据，证明；There's (no) proof that... （没）有证据证明
advancedExpressions.example: The proof that the two kinds are different species lies in the DNA analysis. 证明两者是不同物种的证据在于 DNA 分析。（PPT 语法填空：prove→proof，作主语用名词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·prove 作系动词（重点·无被动）
advancedExpressions.expression: prove (to be) + adj./n. 结果是… ≈ turn out to be
advancedExpressions.example: 课文用法：These methods prove to be harmful.（=turn out to be harmful）。此义为不及物系动词，不能说 be proved to be，to be 常可省略。

synonyms.example: The warm porridge offered not only nourishment for the shivering child's body but also, somehow, comfort for his frightened little heart. （读后续写·救助·温情）

advancedExpressions.expression: insisting that ... needed all the nutrition it could get, sb. quietly ...

advancedExpressions.expression: without proper nutrition, even the brightest mind cannot ...

definitionEn:
(1) n. the natural purpose or job of a person, thing, or organ; the way in which something works
(2) vi. to work or operate in a proper or particular way
(3) vi. to serve a particular purpose; to act or be used as
(4) n. a large formal social event or ceremony

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 运转,运作,起作用(= work / operate)
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights the volunteers had barely eaten, yet somehow their exhausted bodies continued to function. 志愿者三夜没睡几乎没吃，可疲惫的身体竟仍在运转。（v. 用法，课文取此义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 充当,起……作用(function as)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (正式的)社交聚会,典礼,仪式
uncommonMeanings.example: Dressed in a borrowed suit two sizes too large, he slipped into the glittering function. （读后续写·阶层落差·局促）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (数学中的)函数
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher explained that y was a function of x. （读后续写·课堂·哲理化）

I am writing to remind everyone that the primary function of our new reading corner is not merely to store books, but to create a quiet haven where classmates can escape the noise and lose themselves in a good story. （应用文·通知）
In my view, the essential function of education is not to cram young minds with facts, but to awaken in them a lifelong curiosity that no examination can ever measure. （议论文·教育主题）

The ancient clock tower, though weathered by a century of storms, still functions as the beating heart of the old town, its chimes ordering the daily rhythms of everyone who lives within earshot. （读后续写·小镇·怀旧）

collocations.translation: 【课件】正常运转，正常工作（vi. 起作用 = work in the correct way）
collocations.example: Flights in and out of that city wouldn't function normally / properly any time soon. 进出那个城市的航班在短期内无法恢复正常。（PPT 原句·function vi.）

collocations.phrase: function as (= serve / act / work as)
collocations.example: A stadium is functioning as a temporary hospital to deal with less serious cases. 一座体育场正被用作临时医院来处理病情较轻的病例。（PPT 原句·function as）

collocations.translation: 【课件】履行（更多）职能，发挥作用（function n. 作用，功能，职能）

collocations.translation: 正常运转，良好运作（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Their bodies need a lot of nutrition to function well. 他们的身体需要大量营养才能正常运转。（课文原句）

During the flood, the old bridge functioned as the villagers' only lifeline. 洪水期间，那座旧桥成了村民唯一的生命线。（重点搭配）
A balanced diet ensures that the brain functions well. （应用文·健康建议）

synonyms.example: The heart operates like a tireless pump, pushing blood to every corner of the body without a single moment's rest. （议论文·科普）

synonyms.example: The purpose of this campaign is to encourage every student to embrace a healthier lifestyle. （应用文·倡议）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·function 一词两性（n. & vi.）（课件·重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: vi. 起作用/运转/充当：function normally/properly, function as (=serve/act/work as) ｜ n. 作用/功能/职能：perform functions, bodily functions ｜ functional adj. 实用的
advancedExpressions.example: A stadium is functioning as a temporary hospital（vi. function as）; you will perform more functions in the new post（n.）; the app is highly functional（adj.）。（PPT 一词多用一句串讲）

advancedExpressions.expression: function → functional (adj. 功能的,实用的) → functionally (adv. 在功能上) → functionality (n. 功能性) → dysfunction (n. 功能失调)

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'运作/起作用'（可替换 function vi.）
advancedExpressions.expression: work / operate / run / serve as / act as
advancedExpressions.example: The old machine still works / operates / functions perfectly. 这台旧机器仍运转良好。（几词可替换，function 更强调'按其应有目的运作'）

advancedExpressions.expression: though ..., sth still functioned as ...

advancedExpressions.expression: the true function of ... lies not in ..., but in ...

advancedExpressions.expression: for sth to function properly, ... is indispensable

definitionEn:

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 摄入,吸收(食物、空气、氧气、水等;课文与课件均取此义)

readingExamples: She added, 'What's more, they should keep regular hours and get plenty of exercise to stay energetic and fit.'
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having or showing a lot of energy, strength, and enthusiasm
(2) adj. involving or requiring a lot of physical activity or effort
(3) adj. (of a person) forceful and active in pursuing goals

posExamples.sentence: The moment the whistle blew, the once-timid boy transformed into an energetic blur of motion, weaving past defenders as though the fear that had haunted him all season had simply vanished with the kick-off. （读后续写·比赛·蜕变）

We are looking for a few energetic and responsible volunteers to help organise our school's charity run this weekend, so if you love sports and enjoy helping others, please sign up at the office. （应用文·招募启事）
Regular exercise and a balanced diet keep young people energetic and alert, which in turn sharpens their focus and lifts their performance in the classroom. （议论文·健康主题）

Even at seventy, Grandpa remained astonishingly energetic, rising before dawn to tend his garden and returning each evening with soil on his hands and a bright, unwearied smile on his face. （读后续写·祖辈·活力）

definitionEn:
(1) adj. successful in producing a desired or intended result
(2) adj. (of a law, agreement, or system) in operation; officially valid
(3) adj. actual rather than official or theoretical; in reality
(4) adj. (of an image or performance) striking and impressive in effect

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (法律、协议)生效的,开始实施的

advancedExpressions.expression: get into shape 练出好身材 | be in shape 身体状况好 | be out of shape 身体状况差 | keep / stay in shape 保持健康体形 | get back into shape 恢复体形 | whip sth into shape 整顿好
advancedExpressions.example: He was badly out of shape, so he began to work out to get into shape and now keeps in shape all year round. 他曾身体很差，于是开始健身练出好身材，如今全年保持健康。（一组 shape 短语串讲）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·get + into + n. 表'进入某状态'
advancedExpressions.expression: get into shape / get into trouble / get into the habit of doing —— get into + 名词表'进入……状态或境地'
advancedExpressions.example: If you get into the habit of exercising, you will soon get into shape. 一旦养成锻炼的习惯，你很快就会练出好身材。（get into 结构串讲）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'强身健体'（可替换 get into shape）
advancedExpressions.expression: keep fit / work out / build up one's strength / stay in good shape
advancedExpressions.example: Swimming twice a week helps you keep fit and stay in good shape. 每周游两次泳能帮你保持健康、维持好体形。（keep fit 侧重保持,get into shape 侧重练回）

advancedExpressions.expression: mile by mile / day by day, sb. slowly got into shape
advancedExpressions.example: Day by day, drop of sweat by drop of sweat, he slowly got into shape, until the boy who once feared the starting line stood at its very front. （渐进短语+对比结尾,续写励志弧线）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no shortcut to getting into shape; only ... will do
advancedExpressions.example: There is no shortcut to getting into shape; only regular exercise, sound sleep and balanced meals will truly do the trick. （否定+唯一条件句,倡议书有力收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: getting into shape is not merely about ..., but about ...
advancedExpressions.example: Getting into shape is not merely about a slimmer figure, but about forging the discipline and resilience that carry us through hardship. （not merely...but...升华身体健康到品格层面）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She exercised a lot and got fit.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Morning after morning she laced up her worn running shoes and set out into the grey dawn, and slowly, almost without noticing, she got into shape — until one day she realised she was chasing the sunrise instead of running from her fears. （读后续写·励志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 重复结构(Morning after morning) + 细节名词(worn running shoes) + get into shape 替换 got fit + 破折号引出顿悟 + 隐喻收尾(chasing the sunrise)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise is the best way to become healthy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In my firm belief, steady exercise is the safest and most effective way to get into shape, for it strengthens not only the body but also the will to keep going when things grow hard. （议论文·健康观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In my firm belief 表态插入 + safest and most effective 双最高级 + for 引出因果 + not only...but also 递进升华到意志层面

classPractice.question: 好好生活是强身健体最安全、最有效的方式。Living well is the safest and most effective way to ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；get into shape 强身健体、练出好身材

classPractice.question: Months of skipping meals had left him badly ____ ____ shape, so weak that stairs left him gasping.
classPractice.note: out of shape 身体状况差；反义为 in shape

classPractice.question: 如果你养成锻炼的习惯，很快就会练出好身材。（用 get into the habit of, get into shape）
classPractice.answer: If you get into the habit of exercising, you will soon get into shape.
classPractice.note: get into + n. 表'进入某状态'；habit 后接 of doing

sub_section: B1 Building your language
original_sentence: I was very frightened when I woke up in hospital last Thursday.
readingExamples: I was very frightened when I woke up in hospital last Thursday.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. feeling fear or anxiety; afraid
(2) adj. showing or caused by fear
(3) adj. worried that something bad might happen (frightened of / that)

posExamples.sentence: When she woke to find herself in a strange white room with tubes in her arm, she was too frightened even to cry out, her wide eyes darting from the beeping machines to the anxious faces of the strangers around her bed. （读后续写·苏醒·惊恐）

I am writing to reassure any classmates who feel frightened about the upcoming swimming test that our instructors are patient and experienced, and that no one will ever be forced into water they are not ready for. （应用文·告知信）
A society that keeps its citizens frightened into silence may seem orderly on the surface, but true progress can only grow where people are free to speak their minds. （议论文·社会主题）
The little boy, frightened by the sudden crash of thunder, buried his face in his mother's coat and would not look up until the storm had rolled far beyond the hills. （读后续写·孩童·安抚）

wordForms.adjective: frightened (感到害怕的，修饰人) / frightening (令人害怕的，修饰物/事) / frightful
wordForms.other: -ed/-ing 辨析：frightened 主语『感到』害怕（多为人）；frightening 主语『令人』害怕（多为事物），如 a frightening film 一部恐怖片、a frightened child 一个受惊的孩子。frighten 为及物动词：sth frightens sb（某事吓到某人），被动 sb be frightened by sth。

idioms.translation: 吓得魂不附体,惊慌失措
idioms.example: Alone in the pitch-black cabin, she was frightened out of her wits when a shadow slid silently across the window — only to melt, moments later, into the harmless shape of a swaying branch. （读后续写·惊悚·虚惊）
The children were frightened to death by the story, yet they begged their grandfather, again and again, to tell it just one more time. （读后续写·童趣）
Bullied for years, the timid boy had grown frightened of his own shadow, flinching at every sudden voice in the crowded hall. （读后续写·成长创伤）

collocations.example: The little girl was frightened of being left alone in the house. 小女孩害怕一个人被留在屋里。（课件原句 feeling fear or worry）

collocations.phrase: be frightened to do sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】害怕做某事，不敢做某事
collocations.example: She was frightened to be left alone in the house. 她害怕一个人被留在屋里。（课件原句改写：be frightened to do）
He was frightened that the noise might wake the baby. 他担心那声响会把婴儿吵醒。（课件 be frightened of / to do / that 三搭配）
She was frightened to death when the lights suddenly went out. 灯突然熄灭时她吓得要死。（课件短语 be frightened to death 吓得要死）

collocations.phrase: be very frightened (课文原句词块)
collocations.translation: 非常害怕（课文原句：醒来时非常害怕）
collocations.example: I was very frightened when I woke up in hospital last Thursday. 周四我在医院醒来的时候非常害怕。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 害怕的（课文原句：醒来时很害怕）
collocations.example: I was very frightened when I woke up in hospital last Thursday. （课文原句）
As a child she was frightened of the dark until her father showed her the stars. （读后续写·克服恐惧）
The new student looked so frightened at the door that I offered her a seat. （读后续写·接纳）
A frightened look flashed across the child's face. （读后续写·细节）
Badly frightened by the near-accident, the driver pulled over and sat trembling. （读后续写·车祸边缘）
She crept forward so as not to frighten the injured bird away. （读后续写·护鸟）
As the fog thickened, the hikers grew frightened and called out to one another. （读后续写·迷雾）

synonyms.example: She was scared stiff when the lights suddenly went out, but she groped for the torch and forced herself to stay calm for her little brother's sake. （读后续写·停电）
synonyms.usage: 更口语、更日常,与 frightened 基本同义;书面/正式语境可优先用 frightened

synonyms.example: Terrified by the roar of the approaching flood, the villagers snatched up their children and fled towards the higher ground. （读后续写·灾难·逃生）
synonyms.usage: 程度远强于 frightened,表'惊恐万分';续写描写极端恐惧时用,冲击力更强

synonyms.example: Do not be afraid to make mistakes, for every error is a quiet teacher in disguise. （议论文·成长）
synonyms.usage: 多作表语(be afraid of/to do/that),不作定语;frightened 既可作表语也可作定语(a frightened child)

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be frightened 三搭配（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: be frightened of (doing) sth ／ be frightened to do sth ／ be frightened that + 从句（害怕…，不敢做某事）
advancedExpressions.example: be frightened of the dark（怕黑）；was frightened to be left alone（害怕独自被留下）；be frightened that it might return（担心它会再来）——课件三种句法一次记牢。

advancedExpressions.expression: frighten (vt. 使惊吓) → frightened (adj. 感到害怕的，修饰人) / frightening (adj. 令人害怕的，修饰物/事) / fright (n. 害怕，惊吓)
advancedExpressions.example: She was trembling with fright.（课件例句：她吓得直发抖）／ It is frightening to think what might happen.（课件填空：想到可能发生的事就令人害怕）—— -ed 表『被吓到』，-ing 表『令人害怕』，fright 为名词。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·frightening / frightened / fright（课件填空原题）
advancedExpressions.expression: 修饰物/事用 frightening；修饰人（感到害怕）用 frightened；名词『惊吓』用 fright
advancedExpressions.example: Walking through the forest alone was a frightening experience for the child.（令人害怕的经历）／ Frightened children were calling for their mothers.（受惊的孩子）／ You gave me quite a fright.（你把我吓了一跳）——课件用 fright 适当形式填空原题。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·be frightened 三搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: be frightened of sth／be frightened to do sth／be frightened that + 从句
advancedExpressions.example: be frightened of the dark（怕黑）；be frightened to speak（不敢开口）；be frightened that it might return（担心它会再来）——三种句法一次记牢。

advancedExpressions.expression: frighten(v.) → frightened(adj. 感到害怕) / frightening(adj. 令人害怕) / fright(n. 惊吓) / frightful(adj. 可怕的)
advancedExpressions.example: 同一词根变形容词，-ed 表『被吓到』，-ing 表『使人害怕』，续写描写心理常用 frightened，形容场面用 frightening。

advancedExpressions.expression: too frightened to do sth（太害怕以致不能做某事）
advancedExpressions.example: Too frightened to move, she could only watch the shadow creep closer. （前置状语+心理放大，续写紧张时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: too frightened to ..., sb. could only ...
advancedExpressions.example: Too frightened to move, she could only watch as the shadow crept closer, her heart hammering so loudly that she feared the whole house might hear it. （too...to 结构+心理放大，续写紧张时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no need to feel frightened, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is no need to feel frightened about the interview, for confidence, like a muscle, only grows stronger the more bravely we use it. （劝慰句式+比喻，书信/发言稿常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: a person frightened of failure will never ...
advancedExpressions.example: A person frightened of failure will never taste the sweetness of true achievement, for every great success is built upon a mountain of forgiven mistakes. （前置定语+因果论证，突出勇气主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very frightened when she woke up in hospital.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When she came to at last in the unfamiliar hospital ward, a cold wave of fear washed over her — for one frightened, disorienting moment she could not tell where she was, why her arm ached, or how she had come to be lying beneath these blinding white lights. （读后续写·苏醒·恐惧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: come to 替换 wake up + 比喻(a cold wave of fear washed over) + frightened, disorienting 双形容词 + 三个 wh-从句排比放大迷茫恐惧

sentenceUpgrade.original: Don't be frightened to try new things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Never be frightened to step beyond the safe and the familiar, for it is precisely on the trembling edge of the unknown that we discover who we are truly meant to become. （议论文·成长观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Never 开头强调否定祈使 + step beyond the safe and the familiar 意象化 + for it is precisely...that 强调句式深化哲理

classPractice.type: 用 fright 适当形式填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: Don't stand so near the edge! You're ____ (fright) me.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】用 fright 的适当形式填空；此处需动词现在分词/动词形式表『正在吓唬我』，用 frightening（frighten 的 -ing 形式）。

classPractice.type: 用 fright 适当形式填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: ____ (fright) children were calling for their mothers.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；修饰 children（人，感到害怕）用 -ed 形式 frightened，句首大写。

classPractice.type: 用 fright 适当形式填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: It is ____ (fright) to think what might happen if she left him.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；It is ... to do 结构中形容『令人害怕的』用 -ing 形式 frightening。

classPractice.type: 用 fright 适当形式填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: You gave me quite a ____ (fright) suddenly coming in here like that.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a + 名词，此处取名词义『惊吓、吓一跳』，用 fright（give sb a fright 把某人吓一跳）。

classPractice.question: He had tried to coax the dog to him but, ____ (frighten), it ran off.
classPractice.note: 课件辨析原句；此处形容 the dog『受惊』用 -ed 形式 frightened 作状语。

classPractice.question: I was very ____ (frighten) when I woke up in hospital last Thursday.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；主语为人『感到害怕』用 -ed 形式，作表语。

classPractice.question: It was such a ____ (frightened / frightening) experience that I still have nightmares about it.
classPractice.note: 修饰 experience（事物/经历）用 -ing『令人害怕的』；修饰人才用 -ed。

classPractice.question: 他太害怕了，不敢一个人待在黑屋子里。He was ____ ____ ____ stay in the dark room alone.
classPractice.note: too...to 结构表『太……以致不能』；be frightened to do 不敢做某事。

classPractice.question: 别害怕犯错。(frightened)
classPractice.answer: Don't be frightened to make mistakes. / Don't be frightened of making mistakes.
classPractice.note: be frightened to do 或 be frightened of doing 均可表『害怕做某事』。

sub_section: B1 Building your language
original_sentence: Fortunately, I was rushed to hospital immediately. The doctor helped me and I made a full recovery within two days.
readingExamples: Fortunately, I was rushed to hospital immediately. The doctor helped me and I made a full recovery within two days.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. before a particular period of time has passed; in less than a certain amount of time
(2) prep. inside a container, place, area, or group
(3) prep. not beyond the limits or range of something
(4) adv. inside; on the inside (formal or literary)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在（时间）之内，不超过（某时段）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: I made a full recovery within two days. （课文原句：两天之内痊愈）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在内心，内心深处（文学化用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Outwardly she smiled at the guests, but within, a storm of doubt raged. （读后续写·表里反差）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在（某能力、权限、承受）范围之内
uncommonMeanings.example: The old carpenter charged only what lay within a poor family's means. （读后续写·善良匠人）

posExamples.sentence: Within moments of the whistle, the entire stadium had risen to its feet, and a roar of joy swept over the boy who had, against all odds, scored the winning goal. （读后续写·比赛高潮·环境烘托）
I am writing to inform you that all completed application forms must be submitted within three days, as places on the summer camp are strictly limited and fill up quickly. （应用文·通知）
Genuine self-discipline lies not in setting impossible goals, but in mastering the small choices we make within a single ordinary day. （议论文·自律与成长）
The cottage looked cold and abandoned from the lane, yet within, a fire crackled warmly and the smell of fresh bread filled every corner. （读后续写·温暖转折·感官描写）

wordForms.other: 介词 within 主要辨析：① 表时间时 within = 『在……之内、不超过』，比 in 更强调期限（in two days 也可指『两天后』，within two days 只指『两天以内』）；② 反义词 beyond（超出……之外、非……所能）：within reach 触手可及 ↔ beyond reach 遥不可及；within one's power ↔ beyond one's power。

idioms.example: For the first time the dream she had chased for a decade felt truly within reach, and her trembling hands could barely hold the acceptance letter. （读后续写·梦想成真·情感升华）

idioms.idiom: within an inch of one's life
idioms.translation: 差一点丢了性命；濒临险境
idioms.example: The climber was rescued within an inch of his life, his frozen fingers still clenched around the last rock that had saved him. （读后续写·绝境求生·细节）

idioms.translation: 在某人权利范围之内；有权（做某事）
idioms.example: Although the customer was well within her rights to demand a refund, she chose instead to thank the anxious young clerk for his patience. （读后续写·善意·反差）

collocations.phrase: within two days (课文原句词块)
collocations.translation: 在两天之内（课文原句：两天内痊愈）
collocations.example: The doctor helped me and I made a full recovery within two days. （课文原句）
With proper rest, a full recovery could be expected within a week. （应用文·慰问）
Victory now seemed within grasp, and the exhausted rowers dug their oars deeper. （读后续写·拼搏）
Fortunately, the hospital was within walking distance. （读后续写·紧张）
Every proposal has been kept within the limits of our modest budget. （应用文·计划）
Parents should grant teenagers freedom within reason. （议论文·家庭教育）
True change in a community grows quietly from within, one person at a time. （议论文·改变）

collocations.translation: 在某人能力／掌控范围之内
collocations.example: She resolved to change everything within her power. （读后续写·释怀）
The charity fair was organised entirely within budget. （应用文·报道）
Within the space of a single afternoon, the timid new student had made three friends. （读后续写·转变）

synonyms.example: Inside the abandoned house, dust danced in the thin ribbon of light. （读后续写·探秘）
synonyms.usage: inside 最常用、口语化，主要指具体空间的内部；within 更正式，且能表时间/范围限度，inside 一般不表时间期限

synonyms.example: In just three days the seeds pushed their tender green heads through the soil. （读后续写·希望）
synonyms.usage: in 泛用而口语；表『在X时间后』时 in 与 within 都可，但 within 强调『不超过、期限之内』，语气更精确正式

synonyms.example: Throughout the region, farmers gathered to share seeds and stories. （议论文·合作）
synonyms.usage: throughout 强调覆盖『整个』范围或时段；within 只表『在……之内、不越界』，不含『遍及全部』之意

synonyms.example: For years the dream had felt beyond her reach; now, at last, it lay within her grasp. （读后续写·梦想）
synonyms.usage: beyond 是 within 的反义：within reach 触手可及 ↔ beyond reach 遥不可及；辨析时常成对出现，within 表『在界内』，beyond 表『越出界外/非……所能』

advancedExpressions.expression: within + 时间(two days/a week)／within reach／within walking distance／within one's power／within reason
advancedExpressions.example: 从『两天之内』到『力所能及』『步行可达』『合理范围内』，within 后接时间、距离、能力、限度均可，一网打尽。

advancedExpressions.expression: within / in / inside（可替换度视语境）
advancedExpressions.example: 表时间期限『不超过X』：within a week（最精确）≈ in a week；表空间内部：inside/within the house 可换，但表期限时优先 within。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·within 与 beyond 对照
advancedExpressions.expression: within reach ↔ beyond reach；within one's power ↔ beyond one's control
advancedExpressions.example: The summit that had once seemed beyond reach now lay within a single hour's climb. （within/beyond 对照，制造反差张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: the strength/answer lay within sb. all along
advancedExpressions.example: She had searched the whole world for courage, only to discover that the strength she needed had lain within her all along. （抽象具象化+倒装省略，续写结尾自我觉醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: please ensure that ... within ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please ensure that all borrowed books are returned within a fortnight, so that fellow readers may enjoy them too. （通知体，please ensure that 委婉指令+目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: change must come from within, not merely from without
advancedExpressions.example: Lasting reform must come from within a society, not merely be imposed from without, for rules unaccompanied by conviction crumble at the first test. （within/without 对比修辞，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He got better within two days.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To the astonishment of the entire ward, the boy who had arrived barely breathing was, within two short days, sitting up and asking cheerfully for a second bowl of porridge. （读后续写·康复·反差）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To the astonishment of... 结果前置引出惊叹 + who 定语从句回溯病危状态 + within two short days 插入表期限 + 生活化细节(a second bowl of porridge)增画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should solve problems using our own resources.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that a community grows strongest when it learns to solve its own problems from within, drawing on the quiet talents that lie hidden among its ordinary members. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + when 引导条件状语 + from within 强调内生动力 + 分词状语(drawing on...)补充手段 + lie hidden 比喻化表达

classPractice.question: The doctor helped me and I made a full recovery ____ two days.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；within + 时间段表『在……之内、不超过』。

classPractice.question: The library is ____ walking distance of my home, so I go there every day. (within / beyond / without)
classPractice.note: within walking distance 步行可达；对比 beyond（超出）。

classPractice.question: The top of the mountain once seemed ____ reach, but now it lies ____ reach at last. (within / beyond)
classPractice.note: beyond reach 遥不可及 ↔ within reach 触手可及，一对反义搭配。

classPractice.question: 请在一周之内交回所有借来的书。(within)
classPractice.answer: Please return all the borrowed books within a week.
classPractice.note: within a week 强调期限『不超过一周』，比 in a week 更精确。

sub_section: B1 Building your language
original_sentence: From now on, I'll pay more attention to my health rather than my weight.
readingExamples: From now on, I'll pay more attention to my health rather than my weight.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. used to introduce a correction, a more accurate statement, or an opposite idea (= instead; more exactly)
(2) adv. to a fairly large degree; to some extent (= fairly, quite, somewhat)
(3) adv. (rather than) used to say that one thing is preferred to, or done instead of, another
(4) adv. (would rather) used to express a preference for one thing or course of action over another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （rather than）而不是；胜过——课文义，连接两个平行成分
uncommonMeanings.example: I'll pay more attention to my health rather than my weight. （课文原句：关注健康而非体重）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 相当，颇（= fairly, quite），修饰形容词/副词，常含意外或轻微负面语气
uncommonMeanings.example: It turned out to be rather a stormy night. （读后续写·环境）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 更确切地说；或者不如说（or rather，用于修正自己刚说的话）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was not angry — or rather, he was too exhausted to be angry. （读后续写·自我修正语气）

posExamples.sentence: She did not run from the barking dog; rather, she knelt down slowly, held out an open palm, and let the trembling creature come to her in its own time. （读后续写·勇气与善意·动作描写）
I would suggest that we spend the raised money on planting trees rather than on a lavish celebration, for the former will benefit our campus for decades to come. （应用文·建议信）
True education should teach students how to think rather than merely what to memorise, for a mind trained only to recall facts is soon overtaken by any machine. （议论文·教育·论证）
The old letter, rather faded and smelling faintly of lavender, slipped from between the pages and fluttered to the floor like a leaf out of season. （读后续写·回忆·感官细节）

wordForms.other: 核心结构辨析：① rather than『而不是』连接对等成分（名词/动名词/不定式/介词短语），A rather than B 中 B 常用与 A 一致的形式；②  would rather do sth『宁愿做某事』后接动词原形，would rather do A than do B『宁愿A而不愿B』；③ would rather sb did sth『但愿某人做某事』用虚拟过去式；④ or rather『或者更确切地说』用于自我修正。

idioms.example: "I would rather stand alone for what is right than sit comfortably with the crowd for what is easy," she said, and turned to face them all. （读后续写·抉择·对话升华）

idioms.translation: 宁可你去也别是我（这活儿我可不想干）
idioms.example: "You're volunteering to clean the reptile house? Rather you than me," laughed her friend, wrinkling his nose in mock horror. （读后续写·同伴调侃·口语）
He apologised to his brother — or rather, he mumbled something at the floor that both of them chose to accept as an apology. （读后续写·别扭和解·幽默笔触）

collocations.translation: 【课件】相当，颇（= to some degree，修饰形容词/副词）
collocations.example: The patient has responded to the treatment rather better than expected. 病人对治疗的反应比预想的好得多。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】相当……的（一个）（rather 可置于不定冠词前）
collocations.example: It was a rather difficult question. 那是一个相当难的问题。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: rather than（而不是，引出并列结构）【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】而不是（= instead of sth），连接对等成分
collocations.example: I think I'll have a cold drink rather than coffee. 我想我要喝冷饮而不是咖啡。（课件原句：a cold drink rather than coffee）

collocations.phrase: to do A rather than (to) do B【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】做A而不是做B（rather than 连接两个不定式）
collocations.example: I decided to write rather than phone. 我决定写信而不是打电话。（课件原句：to write rather than phone）

collocations.translation: 而不是；胜过（课文原句：关注健康而非体重）
collocations.example: From now on, I'll pay more attention to my health rather than my weight. （课文原句）
Exhausted as she was, she would rather finish the last chapter tonight than leave it hanging. （读后续写·坚持）
Grandfather would rather give away his last coin than watch a hungry child pass his door. （读后续写·仁慈）
The problem is not laziness, or rather, it is a lack of clear purpose. （议论文·修正论点）
It turned out to be rather a stormy night, and the travellers were grateful for the inn's lamp. （读后续写·铺垫）
The speech was rather too long, and even the front rows were stifling their yawns. （读后续写·细节）
The melody was rather like a lullaby her mother once hummed. （读后续写·回忆）

collocations.translation: 而是（用于 not ... but rather 结构）
collocations.example: Success is measured not by how seldom we fall, but rather by how bravely we rise. （议论文·对比论证）

synonyms.example: The path grew quite steep near the summit, yet the view made every step worthwhile. （读后续写·登山）
synonyms.usage: 在英式英语中 quite 语气可强于 rather；rather 常带一丝『出乎意料』或轻微负面的意味（如 rather cold 有点太冷）

synonyms.example: The homemade cake was fairly plain to look at, but one bite silenced the whole room. （读后续写·反差）
synonyms.usage: fairly 语气最弱、偏中性褒义；rather 程度略强，且可含遗憾/意外语气，三者递进大致为 fairly < rather < quite

synonyms.example: He did not scold the frightened boy; instead, he ruffled his hair and offered him the last biscuit. （读后续写·宽容）
synonyms.usage: instead 独立成句或句首/句尾表『改为、反而』；rather (than) 多用于直接对比两项『是A而非B』，结构上更紧凑

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rather than 引出并列结构（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: A rather than B（而不是B）——rather than 连接对等成分，前后须一致（名词/动名词/不定式/介词短语）
advancedExpressions.example: a cold drink rather than coffee（名词）；chestnut rather than brown（形容词）；in August rather than in July（介词短语）；to write rather than (to) phone（不定式）——课件四组原句，前后结构一致是关键。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rather 表『相当』修饰程度（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: rather + adj./adv.（相当，= to some degree），可作 rather better／rather a difficult question
advancedExpressions.example: The patient responded rather better than expected.（相当，修饰比较级）／ It was a rather difficult question.（rather 置于 a 之前）——课件两处程度用法。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·rather 核心三搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: rather than（而不是）／would rather do（宁愿做）／or rather（更确切地说）
advancedExpressions.example: rather than 连对等成分；would rather do 表偏好接原形；or rather 自我修正——一词三用，考点密集。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『而不是/偏好』
advancedExpressions.expression: rather than / instead of / would prefer to ... rather than ...（可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: choose health rather than weight ≈ choose health instead of weight；表偏好 would rather do ≈ would prefer to do。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·would rather 的两种句法
advancedExpressions.expression: would rather do A than do B（接原形）／would rather sb did sth（接虚拟过去式）
advancedExpressions.example: I would rather walk than wait for the bus.（原形）；I would rather you told me the truth.（从句用过去式表现在或将来的愿望）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. chose to ... rather than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that trembling moment she chose to forgive rather than to fight, and something long clenched inside her finally loosened. （rather than 平衡两个不定式，凸显道德抉择，续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would rather suggest that ... than ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would rather suggest that we listen patiently to the younger members than dismiss their ideas as immature. （would rather...than 委婉提出更优方案，语气得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: the question is not ..., but rather ...
advancedExpressions.example: The question is not whether machines can think, but rather whether we humans will still bother to. （not ... but rather 重构问题焦点，制造思辨张力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I care about health, not weight.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From that day on, I resolved to measure myself by how strong and alive I felt each morning, rather than by the cold, unforgiving number glowing on the bathroom scale. （读后续写·观念转变·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: From that day on 时间标记转变 + resolved to 表决心 + rather than 对比两种自我评价 + the cold, unforgiving number 拟人化贬抑 + glowing on the scale 细节具象

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should teach students to think, not to memorise.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that schools taught students to question, to reason and to create, rather than merely to memorise facts that any search engine can retrieve in an instant. （议论文·教育·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 虚拟过去式(taught) 呼吁 + 三动词排比(question, reason, create) + rather than merely 弱化对立项 + 时事对照(search engine)增强现实感

classPractice.question: 我更想喝一杯冷饮而不是咖啡。I think I'll have a cold drink ____ ____ coffee.
classPractice.note: 课件原句 a cold drink rather than coffee；rather than『而不是』连接两个对等名词。

classPractice.question: 我决定写信而不是打电话。I decided ____ ____ rather than ____ (phone).
classPractice.note: 课件原句 to write rather than phone；rather than 连接两个不定式，第二个不定式常省略 to（rather than (to) phone）。

classPractice.question: 从现在起，我会更关注健康而不是体重。From now on, I'll pay more attention to my health ____ ____ my weight.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；rather than 连接两个对等的名词短语。

classPractice.question: I would rather ____ (walk) all the way home than wait an hour for the next bus.
classPractice.note: would rather do A than do B，两处都接动词原形。

classPractice.question: I would rather you ____ (tell) me the truth right now.
classPractice.note: would rather + 从句时用虚拟语气，表现在/将来的愿望用一般过去式。

classPractice.question: He decided to help others instead of thinking only of himself. → He decided to help others ____ ____ thinking only of himself.
classPractice.note: instead of = rather than，均接动名词，连接对等成分。

sub_section: B1 Building your language
original_sentence: Exercising regularly is also an important aspect of a healthy lifestyle.
readingExamples: Exercising regularly is also an important aspect of a healthy lifestyle.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one part or feature of a situation, idea, problem, or thing that has many parts
(2) n. a particular way of thinking about or considering something
(3) n. (formal) the appearance of a place, especially the direction it faces or the impression it gives
(4) n. (formal) a person's facial expression or the way they look

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （事物、问题的）方面，层面——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: Exercising regularly is also an important aspect of a healthy lifestyle. （课文原句：健康生活方式的一个重要方面）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （房屋、地方的）朝向；方位（正式）
uncommonMeanings.example: The little study had a southern aspect, so even in winter a pool of light lay across the desk. （读后续写·环境描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人的）神情，面容，样子（书面/文学）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a grave aspect to the doctor's face as he stepped out of the ward. （读后续写·凝重时刻）

posExamples.sentence: As she reread her grandmother's diary, an entirely new aspect of the woman she had thought she knew slowly revealed itself, and her eyes brimmed with quiet tears. （读后续写·亲情·认知转变）
I would like to draw your attention to one aspect of campus life that is too often overlooked: the loneliness felt by students who study far from home. （应用文·倡议信）
Physical exercise strengthens not only the body but also the mind, and this dual aspect is precisely why regular sport deserves a central place in every student's day. （议论文·健康·论证）
Every problem, he taught me, has more than one aspect; the wise man walks round it slowly before he dares to judge. （读后续写·长者教诲·哲理）

wordForms.other: aspect / side 辨析：aspect 指一个话题或问题被『看待、分析』出的某一侧面，较抽象正式，常搭 an aspect of sth；side 更口语，指事物明显对立的『一面』（the bright side, both sides of the story）。aspect 强调分析视角，side 强调对立立场。近义还有 facet（宝石刻面，文学）、dimension（新增维度）。

collocations.phrase: an important aspect of (课文原句词块)
collocations.translation: ……的一个重要方面（课文原句：健康生活的重要方面）
collocations.example: Exercising regularly is also an important aspect of a healthy lifestyle. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一个关键／至关重要的方面
collocations.example: Getting enough sleep is a crucial aspect of teenage health that students easily neglect. （议论文·健康）
Learning to cook was, for her, about reclaiming an aspect of her independence. （读后续写·顿悟）
The exchange programme opened our eyes to many aspects of a culture we had only read about. （应用文·感悟）
Social media has its positive aspects, yet its negative aspect is harder to resist. （议论文·辩证）

collocations.translation: 考虑／审视／探究方方面面
collocations.example: Before deciding, she considered every aspect of the offer. （读后续写·抉择）
The volunteers cared for the emotional aspect of the elderly residents' lives. （应用文·公益）

collocations.phrase: in every aspect / in all aspects
collocations.example: The young captain proved herself in every aspect of the role. （读后续写·领导力）

collocations.translation: 人性化的一面；人的层面
collocations.example: We must never lose sight of the human aspect of medicine. （议论文·科技与人文）

synonyms.example: Try to look on the bright side, for even the darkest night gives way to dawn. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: side 更口语，指事物明显对立的『一面』（both sides of the story）；aspect 更正式，指经分析看到的某一『侧面/层面』，不必对立

synonyms.example: Kindness was but one shining facet of a character as rich as a cut diamond. （读后续写·人物·比喻）
synonyms.usage: facet 本义为宝石刻面，比喻整体的『众多面向之一』，文学性更强；aspect 更中性通用，可指抽象情形的任一方面

synonyms.example: The most striking feature of the old town was its narrow, laughter-filled lanes. （读后续写·地点描写）
synonyms.usage: feature 强调显著、可辨识的『特征』，偏具体外显；aspect 偏指某个『侧面/层面』，不必是突出特征

synonyms.example: Volunteering added a new dimension to his once-ordinary summer. （读后续写·成长）
synonyms.usage: dimension 隐含『增添的新层次/深度』，常与 add/new 连用；aspect 只是已存在的某个方面，不含『拓展维度』之意

advancedExpressions.expression: an important/key aspect of sth／in every aspect／consider every aspect of
advancedExpressions.example: an aspect of a healthy lifestyle（健康生活的一个方面）；prove oneself in every aspect（在各方面证明自己）——名词后必接 of。

advancedExpressions.expression: aspect / side / facet / dimension（据语体可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: an important aspect of the issue ≈ one side of the issue（口语）≈ one facet of the issue（文学）；表『新增层面』用 dimension。

advancedExpressions.expression: aspect = a-(朝向) + spect(看，词根 spec/spect) → 『看向的方向/侧面』
advancedExpressions.example: 同根词 inspect（往里看→检查）、respect（回头看→尊重）、spectator（观看者）、prospect（向前看→前景），一族记忆。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. came to see a new aspect of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only after the storm did he come to see an aspect of his father he had never noticed before: a tenderness hidden beneath years of gruff silence. （抽象名词+隐藏对比，续写揭示人物深层）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is one aspect of ... that deserves our attention
advancedExpressions.example: There is one aspect of our school's recycling scheme that deserves far more attention: the enthusiasm of the younger students who make it work. （用 that 定语从句聚焦被忽视的一面，倡议信引出主张）

advancedExpressions.expression: when we examine every aspect of ..., it becomes clear that ...
advancedExpressions.example: When we examine every aspect of the debate — economic, ethical and environmental — it becomes clear that short-term profit can never justify long-term ruin. （破折号列举三维度，逻辑严密，加强说服力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise is an important part of a healthy life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere pastime, regular exercise is a vital aspect of a healthy lifestyle — one that steadies the mind, strengthens the will and adds years to a life worth living. （议论文·健康·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being... 先破后立 + a vital aspect of 替换 important part + 破折号引出同位语 + 三动词排比(steadies, strengthens, adds) + adds years to a life worth living 收束升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: I learned something new about my grandmother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Turning the brittle, yellowed pages, I discovered an aspect of my grandmother I had never imagined — a fearless young woman who had once dreamed of crossing oceans she would never live to see. （读后续写·亲情·发现）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Turning the brittle, yellowed pages)带感官细节 + discovered an aspect of 替换 learned something + 破折号补充人物形象 + oceans she would never live to see 悲情收尾增厚度

classPractice.question: 经常锻炼也是健康生活方式的一个重要方面。Exercising regularly is also an important ____ ____ a healthy lifestyle.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；aspect 后固定接介词 of。

classPractice.question: Before making the decision, she carefully considered every ____ (aspect) of the offer.
classPractice.note: consider every aspect of 考虑方方面面；此处填单数名词原形。

classPractice.question: Try to look on the bright ____ of things instead of always seeing the worst. (aspect / side)
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 the bright side『光明的一面』用 side；aspect 偏正式、不用于此习语。

classPractice.question: 睡眠充足是青少年健康的一个关键方面。(aspect)
classPractice.answer: Getting enough sleep is a key aspect of teenage health.
classPractice.note: a key/crucial aspect of sth；注意 aspect 后接 of。

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: One of the reasons why people fail to get a good night's sleep is pressure from school or work.
readingExamples: One of the reasons why people fail to get a good night's sleep is pressure from school or work.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the worry, difficulty, or stress caused by having too much to do or by others' expectations
(2) n. an attempt to persuade or force someone to do something by using influence, arguments, or threats
(3) n. the force produced when something presses or pushes against something else
(4) vt. to try to make someone do something by using force, persuasion, or threats (= pressurize)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （来自外界的）压力，负担——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: One of the reasons why people fail to get a good night's sleep is pressure from school or work. （课文原句：来自学校或工作的压力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物理）压力，压强；气压
uncommonMeanings.example: As the plane began its descent, the sudden change in air pressure made the toddler wail. （读后续写·旅途细节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对……施压，迫使（= pressurize）
uncommonMeanings.example: No matter how the crowd pressured him to name his accomplices, the boy pressed his lips together. （读后续写·坚守）

posExamples.sentence: The pressure of the final exams weighed on her like a leaden coat, and for weeks she had risen before dawn, her desk lamp the only light in a sleeping house. （读后续写·备考·环境心理）
I am writing to suggest that our school offer counselling sessions, so that students struggling under the pressure of study may find someone to turn to. （应用文·建议信）
A certain amount of pressure can spur us to grow, but when it turns relentless, it crushes the very ambition it was meant to fuel. （议论文·压力与成长·辩证）
Her classmates pressured her to skip the rehearsal and join their trip, yet she quietly slipped away to the empty music room, drawn by a promise she had made to herself. （读后续写·坚持·抉择）

wordForms.noun: pressure (压力) / press (报刊界；印刷机) / pressing (紧迫)
wordForms.adjective: pressured (承压的) / pressurized (加压的) / pressing (紧迫的)
wordForms.other: press 词族：press(v. 按/压/催促；n. 报刊界)→ pressure(n. 压力，由 press+-ure 名词后缀构成)→ pressing(adj. 紧迫的)→ pressurize(v. 施压)。词根 press = 压。可数性提醒：作『压力/负担』义通常不可数（great pressure），但 pressures 复数可指『种种压力/难处』。

idioms.example: Under pressure that would have broken many a grown man, the fourteen-year-old kept his family afloat. （读后续写·逆境）
The coach never put unfair pressure on his players; he taught them to compete against yesterday's self. （议论文·教育）

idioms.translation: 压力来了；到了关键时刻
idioms.example: With one minute left and the scores level, the pressure was on. （读后续写·比赛）

collocations.phrase: pressure from school / work (课文原句词块)
