collocations.translation: 来自学校／工作的压力（课文原句）
collocations.example: One of the reasons why people fail to get a good night's sleep is pressure from school or work. （课文原句）
She performed best under pressure, as though the ticking clock lit a fire in her. （读后续写·抗压）
Well-meaning parents sometimes place so much pressure on their children that joy drains out of learning. （议论文·家庭教育）
Much of a teenager's anxiety springs from peer pressure whose approval seems to matter more than air. （议论文·青少年）
The nurse checked his blood pressure and, seeing his frightened eyes, told him a gentle joke. （读后续写·医院·温情）

collocations.phrase: cope with / handle / deal with pressure
collocations.example: Learning to cope with pressure is a skill no textbook can teach, yet no adult can do without. （议论文·成长）
A brisk walk beneath the plane trees never failed to ease the pressure that study piled on him. （读后续写·舒缓）

collocations.phrase: be / come under pressure to do sth
collocations.example: Young athletes are increasingly under pressure to win at any cost. （议论文·体育）
Despite the financial pressure at home, he never once complained. （读后续写·善良）
Where a lesser candidate might have buckled under pressure, she drew a slow breath and began again. （读后续写·抗压）

synonyms.example: Months of stress had etched shadows beneath her eyes, yet the results melted them into a radiant smile. （读后续写·放榜）
synonyms.usage: stress 更侧重个人内在的『紧张、劳累』心理状态；pressure 既可指外部施加的压力，也指处境本身，语义更宽

synonyms.example: The strain of caring for her sick father had aged her a decade in a single year. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: strain 强调长期负荷造成的『损耗、绷紧』（可用于身体、关系、资源）；pressure 更指驱使或逼迫的『压力』本身

synonyms.example: He carried the burden of the family's hopes on his young shoulders. （读后续写·担当）
synonyms.usage: burden 侧重需要长期背负的『负担/责任』，常搭配 carry/bear；pressure 侧重外力的『逼迫、催促』，动态感更强

advancedExpressions.expression: under pressure／put pressure on sb／peer pressure／blood pressure／cope with pressure
advancedExpressions.example: 承压 under pressure、施压 put pressure on、同伴压力 peer pressure、血压 blood pressure——名词+动词/形容词搭配一次记全。

advancedExpressions.expression: pressure / stress / strain / burden（据侧重可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: the pressure of exams ≈ the stress of exams（内在紧张）；长期损耗用 strain，责任重担用 burden。

advancedExpressions.expression: press(压) → pressure(n. 压力) → pressing(adj. 紧迫) → pressurize(v. 施压) → depress/compress/express
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 press=压：depress（往下压→使沮丧）、compress（一起压→压缩）、express（向外压→表达），一族联记。

advancedExpressions.expression: under the weight of ..., sb. refused to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Under the crushing weight of everyone's expectations, she refused to break; instead, she straightened her back and turned her fear into fuel. （具象化压力(weight)+ refused to break 表意志+ turn fear into fuel 转化式收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: in order to relieve the pressure of ..., it would help if ...
advancedExpressions.example: In order to relieve the pressure of examinations, it would help enormously if the school arranged short outdoor breaks between study sessions. （建议信，用 it would help if 委婉提议，语气得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: pressure, in moderation, ... ; in excess, however, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Pressure, in moderation, sharpens our focus and summons our best; in excess, however, it corrodes both mind and body. （分号平行+in moderation/in excess 对照，辩证论证收放有度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He felt a lot of pressure before the exam.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the exam drew near, the pressure settled over him like a gathering fog, thick and cold, until he could scarcely tell where the fear ended and he himself began. （读后续写·备考·比喻心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As... drew near 时间推进 + 明喻(like a gathering fog) + thick and cold 感官双形容词 + where the fear ended and he himself began 心理与情绪交融的意识流收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Too much pressure is bad for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It cannot be denied that excessive pressure, far from motivating young minds, gradually erodes their curiosity and their confidence alike, leaving behind only weariness where wonder once lived. （议论文·压力·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It cannot be denied that 正式让步主句 + far from + doing 先否定错误认知 + erodes 动词升级 + curiosity and confidence 头韵 + where wonder once lived 意象化对比收束

classPractice.question: 人们睡不好的原因之一是来自学校或工作的压力。One of the reasons why people fail to get a good night's sleep is ____ ____ school or work.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；pressure from sth 表『来自……的压力』。

classPractice.question: She always keeps calm ____ pressure and never lets stress affect her performance.
classPractice.note: under pressure 在压力之下，固定搭配。

classPractice.question: Many teenagers give in to ____ pressure and do things they know are wrong just to fit in. (peer / blood / air)
classPractice.note: peer pressure 同伴压力，青少年主题高频词。

classPractice.question: The teachers do everything they can to help students ____ (cope with / put) the pressure of the college entrance exam.
classPractice.note: cope with pressure 应对压力；put pressure on 才是『施加压力』，此处语义应为『应对』。

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems.
readingExamples: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. & vt. to give money, help, ideas, or effort in order to help achieve or provide something
(2) vi. (contribute to) to be one of the causes of something; to help to make something happen
(3) vi. & vt. to write articles, stories, or other material for a newspaper, magazine, or book
(4) vi. (contribute to) to play a part in improving or developing a situation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 捐献（钱、物）；出（力）；贡献（想法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old fisherman insisted on contributing his morning's entire catch to the flood-stricken village. （读后续写·善良）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （contribute to）是……的原因之一；导致；有助于——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems. （课文原句：导致睡眠问题）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 投稿；撰稿（为报刊、书籍写文章）
uncommonMeanings.example: For years the shy teacher had quietly contributed poems to the local paper under a false name. （读后续写·隐藏才华）

posExamples.sentence: Though he had little money to spare, the old fisherman insisted on contributing his morning's entire catch to the flood-stricken village, pressing the basket into the volunteers' hands. （读后续写·善良·动作细节）
I sincerely hope that every member of our class will contribute to the charity sale, whether by donating books, baking cakes, or simply lending a helping hand. （应用文·倡议书）
A healthy lifestyle contributes far more to lasting happiness than wealth ever could, for no fortune can buy back a body or a mind that has been neglected. （议论文·健康·论证）
Each student contributed a single sentence to the story, and by the end of the lesson a tale none of them could have written alone lay glittering on the page. （读后续写·合作·温暖收束）

wordForms.noun: contribution (贡献；捐款；投稿) / contributor (贡献者；捐助人；撰稿人)
wordForms.other: 常用名词搭配 make a contribution to sth（对……作贡献），= contribute to sth。注意 contribution 后接 to，形式与动词一致。contribute 既可及物（contribute sth to sb/sth）也可不及物（contribute to sth）；重音在第二音节 /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/。

collocations.phrase: contribute to sth (课文原句词块)
collocations.translation: 导致；有助于（课文原句：导致睡眠问题）
collocations.example: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems. （课文原句）
Every household in the lane contributed a few coins towards rebuilding the little school. （读后续写·团结）

collocations.translation: 为讨论／辩论出力，发表见解
collocations.example: Even the quietest boy found the courage to contribute to the discussion. （读后续写·突破）

collocations.phrase: contribute an article / a poem to
collocations.translation: 向……投稿一篇文章／一首诗
collocations.example: She was overjoyed to be invited to contribute an article to the magazine's anniversary issue. （应用文·喜讯）
Volunteers contribute significantly to the smooth running of the museum. （应用文·公益）
If each of us is willing to contribute our part, no burden will feel too heavy. （议论文·集体）
The suggestion box invited every student to contribute ideas for a greener campus. （应用文·倡议）
Even a shy first-year can make a real contribution to the class magazine. （应用文·鼓励）
New to the team and eager to contribute, she stayed behind each evening to learn. （读后续写·融入）

synonyms.example: The children emptied their piggy banks to donate every coin to the animal shelter. （读后续写·善良）
synonyms.usage: donate 专指无偿『捐赠』钱物给慈善/机构，对象明确；contribute 更宽泛，可指捐钱、出力、贡献想法，也可表『导致』

synonyms.example: His unexpected apology added to the warmth already glowing in the little room. （读后续写·和解）
synonyms.usage: add to 侧重使某事物『增多/加剧』（可褒可贬），较口语；contribute to 更正式，且暗含『作为促成因素之一』的因果意味

synonyms.example: Poor sleeping habits give rise to a host of problems, from failing concentration to fraying tempers. （议论文·健康）
synonyms.usage: give rise to 是较正式的『引起/导致』，主语多为原因；contribute to 表『是原因之一(非唯一)』，因果关系更委婉

advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to sth（导致/有助于）／contribute sth to sb（捐献/贡献）／contribute an article to（投稿）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一动词三义：contribute to sleep problems（导致）、contribute money to charity（捐献）、contribute a poem to the paper（投稿）。

advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to sth = make a contribution to sth（名动可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: Everyone can contribute to a greener campus. ≈ Everyone can make a contribution to a greener campus. 名词式后接 to。

advancedExpressions.expression: contribute(v.) → contribution(n. 贡献/捐款) → contributor(n. 贡献者/撰稿人) → contributory(adj. 促成的)
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 tribute=给予、分配（同 distribute 分发、tribute 贡品）；con-(共同)+tribute → 共同给予→贡献。

advancedExpressions.expression: however humble, sb.'s contribution ...
advancedExpressions.example: However humble his offering seemed, that single basket of fish contributed more to the village's survival than all the fine speeches of the wealthy. （让步短语前置+对比，凸显平凡奉献的分量）

advancedExpressions.expression: we can all contribute in our own way to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We can all contribute in our own way to a greener campus, whether by switching off an idle light or by carrying a reusable bottle. （倡议书，用 whether...or 举例号召，亲切有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: several factors contribute to ..., chief among which is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Several factors contribute to the rising rates of teenage anxiety, chief among which is the relentless comparison bred by social media. （多因素+chief among which 定语从句锁定主因，逻辑清晰）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone gave money to help the village.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One by one, neighbours who themselves had little stepped forward to contribute whatever they could spare — a handful of rice here, a folded note there — until the small pile on the table became a mountain of quiet hope. （读后续写·团结·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: One by one 逐一推进 + who themselves had little 定语从句制造反差 + contribute 替换 gave + 破折号列举细节 + 从 pile 到 mountain of hope 的意象升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise helps you stay healthy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is widely acknowledged that regular exercise contributes not merely to a stronger body, but to a sharper mind and a steadier heart, laying the foundation for a life of genuine well-being. （议论文·健康·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is widely acknowledged that 正式引出共识 + contribute to 替换 help + not merely...but 递进 + 三名词平行(body, mind, heart) + laying the foundation 分词状语收束升华

classPractice.question: Noise and light pollution in big cities may also contribute ____ sleep problems.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；contribute to sth『导致/有助于』，介词 to 不可省。

classPractice.question: Every member of the class is eager to make a ____ (contribute) to the charity sale.
classPractice.note: make a contribution to 作贡献；此处需名词形式 contribution。

classPractice.question: The rich businessman ____ a large sum of money to the disaster area. (contributed / gave rise to)
classPractice.note: 此处为『捐献钱物』义，用 contributed... to；give rise to 只表『导致』，不表捐赠。

classPractice.question: 熬夜和不吃早餐都会导致健康问题。(contribute)
classPractice.answer: Staying up late and skipping breakfast both contribute to health problems.
classPractice.note: contribute to + 结果，表『（多个原因之一）导致』，常用于坏结果。

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems.
readingExamples: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to be one of the causes that makes something happen (often something bad)
(2) phr. v. to help to make something happen, succeed, or develop in a positive way
(3) phr. v. to give money, time, or help towards something
(4) phr. v. to write something (an article, a poem) for a publication

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 是……的原因之一；导致（常指坏结果）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems. （课文原句：导致睡眠问题）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有助于（使某事成功/发展，褒义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every hour of honest practice was in truth contributing to the success she could not yet see. （读后续写·励志）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 为……捐款、出力、作贡献
uncommonMeanings.example: Moved by the news, hundreds of people rushed to contribute to the relief fund. （读后续写／应用文·公益）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 为（报刊、书籍）撰稿，投稿
uncommonMeanings.example: Invited to contribute to a famous magazine, the young writer stared at the blank page for hours. （读后续写·机遇）

posExamples.sentence: Staying up late, skipping breakfast and living on screens — all of these quietly contribute to the exhaustion that so many students carry into their morning classes. （议论文·健康·因果论证）
I warmly invite every one of you to contribute to our tree-planting project this spring, so that future students may study beneath the very shade we plant today. （应用文·倡议书）
Seeing the old man struggle with his heavy cart, three passing students rushed over without a word, each eager to contribute to a stranger's easier afternoon. （读后续写·善良·动作群像）
A single kind word can contribute to a stranger's whole day, reminding us that generosity need cost nothing yet mean everything. （议论文·善意·哲理）

wordForms.other: 『双义』重点：contribute to 在高考中最常考两个方向——① 消极：导致、造成（坏结果），近 lead to；② 积极：有助于、促进（好结果），近 help to。判断靠语境（后接的是 problems/anxiety 还是 success/development）。to 为介词，其后接名词或动名词（doing），不接动词原形。

idioms.example: Bad habits contribute to poor health, while good ones contribute to a long and happy life. （一句显双义，对照记忆）

collocations.phrase: contribute to sleep problems (课文原句词块)
collocations.translation: 导致睡眠问题（课文原句）
collocations.example: Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also contribute to sleep problems. （课文原句）
Noise and light pollution may quietly contribute to the sleep problems that plague urban families. （议论文·城市）

collocations.translation: 有助于成功／进步／发展（积极义）
collocations.example: Every hour of honest practice was contributing to the success she could not yet see. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 回报社会／为社区做贡献
collocations.example: A life truly worth living is one that contributes to the community around it. （议论文·价值观）

collocations.translation: 对……大有帮助；起重要作用
collocations.example: Regular reading contributes significantly to a child's imagination and patience. （议论文·教育）
Among the many factors that contribute to happiness, close friendships rank highest. （议论文·幸福）
Hundreds of ordinary people rushed to contribute to the relief fund within a single afternoon. （读后续写·公益）
Fresh air, sound sleep and a cheerful heart all contribute to the kind of health no medicine can provide. （议论文·健康·排比）

synonyms.example: One reckless decision on that rainy night led to consequences he would spend a lifetime undoing. （读后续写·教训）
synonyms.usage: lead to 表『直接引出/导致』某结果，因果链更直接明确；contribute to 强调只是『促成因素之一』，因果较间接、委婉

synonyms.example: The howling wind only added to the travellers' sense of being utterly alone. （读后续写·渲染）
synonyms.usage: add to 侧重使既有的量或程度『增加』；contribute to 更强调作为促成整体结果的一份原因，且语体更正式

synonyms.example: A few words of encouragement helped to rekindle a hope he had almost given up. （读后续写·激励）
synonyms.usage: help (to) 最口语通用，语气积极中性；contribute to 更正式书面，且既可导致好事也可导致坏事，适用范围更广

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·contribute to 双义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to a problem（导致，消极）／contribute to success·society（有助于/回报，积极）
advancedExpressions.example: 后接 problems/anxiety 多为『导致』；后接 success/development/society 多为『有助于/回报』，靠宾语判断褒贬。

advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to = lead to = give rise to = result in（可替换，因果强弱不同）
advancedExpressions.example: Bad habits contribute to／lead to／give rise to poor health. contribute to 语气最委婉（只是原因之一）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·积极『有助于』
advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to = help (to) = be conducive to = benefit（可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise contributes to／is conducive to good health. 表积极促进时可与 help/benefit 互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: contribute to + n./doing（不接动词原形）
advancedExpressions.example: Staying up late contributes to being tired the next day.（to 后接动名词 being，不能写 to be）。

advancedExpressions.expression: even the smallest act can contribute to ...
advancedExpressions.example: She realised at last that even the smallest act of kindness could contribute to a happiness far greater than her own. （even the smallest...结构放大微小善举的意义，续写主旨升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: by doing ..., we can all contribute to ...
advancedExpressions.example: By sorting our rubbish and treasuring every drop of water, we can all contribute to a campus we will be proud to leave behind. （by doing 引出具体行动+we all 号召，倡议书结尾有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being harmless, ... contributes to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being harmless, the habit of endless scrolling contributes to a slow erosion of focus that few of us even notice. （far from being 先破除误解+contributes to 揭示隐性危害，论证深刻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many things cause sleep problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A tangle of modern habits — glowing screens at midnight, mounting schoolwork, and the ceaseless hum of the city — all quietly contribute to the sleep problems that leave so many teenagers hollow-eyed at dawn. （议论文·健康·因果）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A tangle of 隐喻式主语 + 破折号列举三诱因(排比) + all...contribute to 汇总因果 + hollow-eyed at dawn 具象化后果收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Helping others makes society better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that when each of us is willing to contribute to the welfare of strangers, even in small and unnoticed ways, the whole of society grows warmer, kinder and more worthy of the name. （议论文·社会·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + when 条件状语 + contribute to 替换 helping + even in small and unnoticed ways 让步插入 + 三形容词递进(warmer, kinder, more worthy)收束升华

classPractice.question: 大城市的噪音污染和光污染也可能导致睡眠问题。Noise pollution and light pollution in big cities may also ____ ____ sleep problems.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处为消极『导致』义，后接 problems。

classPractice.question: Staying up late every night will surely contribute to ____ (feel) exhausted the next day.
classPractice.note: contribute to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 doing，不能用动词原形。

classPractice.question: Regular exercise ____ good health, while junk food ____ obesity. (both use: contributes to)
classPractice.note: 同一短语双义：前句『有助于』（积极），后句『导致』（消极），全凭宾语判断褒贬。

classPractice.question: Many factors lead to teenage anxiety. → Many factors ____ ____ teenage anxiety.
classPractice.note: 消极『导致』义时 lead to ≈ contribute to，但 contribute to 更委婉，指『原因之一』。

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: In the short term, people with sleep problems often feel tired and have trouble concentrating. In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
readingExamples: In the short term, people with sleep problems often feel tired and have trouble concentrating. In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. during the period of time that is near to the present, or that is far in the future
(2) phr. used to contrast the immediate consequences of something with its eventual, longer-lasting effects
(3) phr. (as an adjective, short-term / long-term) lasting only a limited time, or continuing far into the future

posExamples.sentence: In the short term the diagnosis felt like the end of everything, yet in the long term it became the very turning point that taught her to cherish each ordinary sunrise. （读后续写·逆境成长·今昔对比）

I am aware that skipping breakfast may save a few minutes in the short term, but I urge every classmate to remember that in the long term it quietly undermines both our health and our concentration. （应用文·倡议书）
Cutting corners on environmental protection may boost profits in the short term, but in the long term it inflicts a debt on future generations that no economy can ever repay. （议论文·环境保护）
In the long term, the reading habit my grandfather patiently nurtured in me shaped my character far more profoundly than any single examination result ever could. （读后续写·亲情启迪）

collocations.phrase: in the short term ... in the long term
collocations.translation: 从短期来看……从长期来看（课文原句）
collocations.example: In the short term, people with sleep problems often feel tired and have trouble concentrating. In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack. （课文原句·睡眠短期与长期后果对比）
In the short term, giving up sugar left him irritable and craving sweets. （读后续写·习惯养成）
In the long term, her tiny daily savings grew into a fund for college. （读后续写·家庭责任）

collocations.translation: 短期目标 / 收益 / 好处
collocations.example: Setting a realistic short-term goal each week kept the trainees motivated. （应用文·活动感悟）
Scientists warn of the long-term impact of sleep deprivation on the teenage brain. （议论文·健康）

collocations.translation: 长期承诺 / 计划 / 投资
collocations.example: Volunteering is a long-term commitment that reshaped how I view my privileges. （应用文·申请信）
Learning an instrument has long-term benefits, sharpening memory and patience. （议论文·教育）
Chronic stress can erode short-term memory and leave students unable to recall. （议论文·健康）

collocations.translation: 以短期 / 长期的方式
collocations.example: The programme takes on students on a long-term basis, so real friendships take root. （应用文·通知）

synonyms.example: The extra hours she devoted to helping her classmates seemed a sacrifice, but in the long run they earned her a friendship worth more than any grade. （读后续写·友情）
synonyms.usage: 口语化、更常见，强调经过一段时间后的最终结果；与 in the long term 几乎可互换，但 in the long term 更书面、更常见于说明文/议论文

synonyms.example: Over time, the shy newcomer who once hid at the back of the classroom blossomed into a confident public speaker. （读后续写·人物成长）
synonyms.usage: 强调渐进的变化过程，不像 in the long term 那样与短期形成明确对比

synonyms.example: The path was steep and his legs ached, but eventually he reached the summit and understood why his father had insisted on the climb. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 副词，只点出最终结果的那个时间点，不强调整段长远时期

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·短期长期对比框架
advancedExpressions.expression: in the short term, ... ; in the long term, ... / short-term vs long-term
advancedExpressions.example: In the short term the diet felt like torture; in the long term it gave him a health he had never known. （对比框架，续写/议论文皆可）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·从长远看(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: in the long term / in the long run / over time / eventually / sooner or later
advancedExpressions.example: In the long run (= in the long term), the reading habit shaped her character far more than any grade. （功能：表最终结果，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: In the short term, ...; in the long term, ...（前后分句结构平行，形成鲜明对比）
advancedExpressions.example: In the short term people feel tired; in the long term they risk a poor memory. （前后主谓结构对称，考点：平行对比）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·今昔对比升华
advancedExpressions.expression: what seemed ... in the short term proved ... in the long term
advancedExpressions.example: What seemed a bitter defeat in the short term proved, in the long term, the seed from which her resilience grew. （对比结构+隐喻 seed，续写结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: though ... in the short term, in the long term it will ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though the new recycling scheme may cause minor inconvenience in the short term, in the long term it will safeguard the very campus we all cherish. （让步+呼吁，倡议信主体段）

advancedExpressions.expression: the short-term ... pales in comparison with the long-term ...
advancedExpressions.example: The short-term convenience of disposable plastics pales in comparison with the long-term damage they wreak upon our oceans.

sentenceUpgrade.original: In the short term it was hard, but later it helped her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the short term, the icy dawn runs felt like punishment, each breath tearing at her lungs; yet in the long term, they forged in her a quiet, unbreakable will that no obstacle could ever again shake. （读后续写·环境+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 短期/长期对比框架 + 环境细节(icy dawn, each breath tearing) + 分号并置 + 隐喻(forged...will)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This plan is good for the long term.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that, however modest its immediate results, this plan will yield profound and lasting benefits in the long term, benefits our whole community will one day come to treasure. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + however 让步插入 + 名词 benefits 重复+定语从句强化 + long term 收尾

classPractice.question:
从短期来看，熬夜似乎能省时间，但从长远来看，它会损害你的健康。（in the short/long term）
____ ____ ____ ____, staying up late seems to save time, but ____ ____ ____ ____ it harms your health.
classPractice.answer: In the short term / In the long term
classPractice.note: 考短期/长期对比框架：前空 in the short term，后空 in the long term，term 前用 the

classPractice.question: 用 short-term 或 long-term 填空：Regular exercise brings ____ benefits that last for many years.
classPractice.note: "持续许多年"对应长期，作定语用连字符形式 long-term

classPractice.question: In the long term, honesty always pays off. → In the ____ ____, honesty always pays off.（换成口语同义表达）
classPractice.note: in the long term = in the long run，二者可互换，run 前用 the

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
readingExamples: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the ability to remember things, experiences and information
(2) n. something that you remember from the past; a thing or an event that you recall
(3) n. the part of a computer where information and instructions are stored
(4) n. the memory of a dead person; the respect and affection in which they are remembered

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机的）存储器，内存
uncommonMeanings.example: The old laptop groaned; its memory could no longer hold the sprawling files of his final project. （读后续写·科技细节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 回忆，往事（可数，常用复数 memories）
uncommonMeanings.example: The scent of jasmine brought back a flood of memories of her grandmother's courtyard. （读后续写·嗅觉触发回忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对逝者的怀念；纪念（in memory of）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every spring the villagers planted a lily in memory of the fisherman who had drowned saving a child. （读后续写·纪念）

posExamples.sentence: The scent of jasmine drifted through the window and, in an instant, a flood of memories carried her back to her grandmother's sunlit courtyard. （读后续写·嗅觉触发回忆）
I am writing to share a treasured memory of our exchange trip, a memory that has stayed with me long after the plane touched down back home. （应用文·感谢信）
Scientists argue that a good night's sleep does far more than rest the body; it consolidates memory, allowing the brain to lock away what we have learned during the day. （议论文·健康）
As the fever worsened, his memory began to blur, and faces that had once been dear to him dissolved into strangers. （读后续写·疾病·心理）

wordForms.noun: memory / memorization (记忆内容/记忆过程)
wordForms.adjective: memorable (adj. 值得纪念的，难忘的) / memorial (adj. 纪念的; n. 纪念碑)
wordForms.other: 构词法：memor(记)+y→memory；memor+able→memorable(难忘的)；memor+ial→memorial(纪念的)。易混：memory(记忆)≠memoir(回忆录)≠memo(备忘录)。in memory of(纪念)≠in honour of(为表彰/向……致敬)

idioms.example: She committed the poem to memory not for the exam, but because its final line spoke to her. （读后续写·成长感悟）

idioms.idiom: if my memory serves me right / correctly
idioms.example: If my memory serves me right, it was on that very bench that we first promised to stay friends. （读后续写·重逢）
Flipping through the album turned into a walk down memory lane, each picture unlocking a story. （读后续写·怀旧）

collocations.translation: 记性差 / 好（课文：a poor memory）
collocations.example: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory. （课文原句·睡眠不足损害记忆）
The scholarship was established in memory of a beloved teacher of the mountain children. （应用文·通知）
Standing before the silent audience, she recited the whole speech from memory. （读后续写·演讲）
The crackling of the campfire brought back memories of summers by the lake. （读后续写·怀旧）
Long after graduation, we would treasure the memory of those late-night talks. （应用文·毕业留言）

collocations.translation: 鲜明的 / 美好的 / 痛苦的记忆
collocations.example: Even decades later, the fond memory of her mother's lullaby could soothe her. （读后续写·亲情）
Regular exercise can boost memory and sharpen concentration far better than any pill. （议论文·健康）
No amount of time could erase the memory of letting go of his father's hand. （读后续写·遗憾）

synonyms.example: His recollection of that rainy afternoon remained astonishingly clear, right down to the smell of wet earth. （读后续写·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 更书面、更正式，多指对某个具体往事的回想这一动作或内容；memory 用法更广，可指记忆能力、记忆内容或计算机内存

synonyms.example: A minute of silence was observed in remembrance of those who had given their lives. （应用文·致辞）
synonyms.usage: 偏正式、庄重，多用于对逝者或重大事件的缅怀，常见于 in remembrance of；日常记忆用 memory

synonyms.example: The old sailor's reminiscences of distant ports held the children spellbound around the fire. （读后续写·长辈讲述）
synonyms.usage: 强调愉快地、深情地追述往昔，常带怀旧色彩，多用复数；memory 中性，不必然带情感

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·记忆动作(记住/回想/纪念)
advancedExpressions.expression: have a good/poor memory · commit sth to memory · bring back memories · in memory of
advancedExpressions.example: He committed her advice to memory; years later it would bring back memories of the kindest teacher he ever had. （记忆动作短语连用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·回忆/记忆(可替换,视语体)
advancedExpressions.expression: memory / recollection / remembrance / reminiscence
advancedExpressions.example: Her recollection (= memory) of that rainy afternoon stayed astonishingly clear. （功能：指对往事的回想，recollection/reminiscence 更书面深情）

advancedExpressions.expression: memory(n.) → memorize(v.记住) → memorable(adj.难忘的) → memorial(纪念的) → memorably(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The trip was so memorable that she wanted to memorize every detail before the memory faded. （同根词串联，一句到位）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·感官触发回忆
advancedExpressions.expression: the ... instantly transported sb. back to ..., a memory so vivid that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The familiar melody instantly transported her back to that snowy Christmas Eve, a memory so vivid that she could almost feel her father's coat against her cheek. （感官触发+过去场景闪回，续写回忆段）

advancedExpressions.expression: the memory of ... will forever remain etched in my heart
advancedExpressions.example: The memory of your unwavering kindness during my darkest days will forever remain etched in my heart. （感谢信情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being a mere storehouse, memory shapes ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a mere storehouse of the past, memory shapes the very identity we carry into the future, colouring every choice we make.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She remembered her grandmother's garden.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One whiff of ripening tomatoes, and a memory long buried came rushing back: her grandmother, straw hat tilted against the sun, humming softly among the tangled vines of a garden that no longer existed. （读后续写·嗅觉+画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 感官触发(one whiff of) + 冒号引出画面 + 独立主格(straw hat tilted) + 定语从句收束情感(that no longer existed)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This trip gave me good memories.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This journey has left me with memories I shall treasure for a lifetime, memories not of the sights we saw, but of the friendships that quietly took root along the way. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在完成时增添分量 + memories 重复+对比结构(not of...but of...) + 隐喻(took root)

classPractice.question: A school garden was planted in ____ (memory) of the teacher who had given her life to the village children.
classPractice.note: 固定短语 in memory of sb "为纪念某人"，memory 不加复数、不加冠词

classPractice.question: Actors have to ____ ____ ____ (把台词记住) all their lines before the first rehearsal.
classPractice.note: commit sth to memory = 把某物记住；注意 sth 放在 commit 与 to memory 之间

classPractice.question: 用 memory / memorable / memorize 填空：The graduation ceremony was so ____ that I want to ____ every moment of it.
classPractice.note: 第一空作表语用形容词 memorable(难忘的)；第二空 want to 后用动词原形 memorize(记住)

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
readingExamples: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of having a poor memory, being overweight and suffering a heart attack.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a violent or aggressive act intended to hurt a person, damage a place, or defeat an enemy
(2) n. a sudden short period of illness or of a strong feeling; a fit (e.g. a heart attack, a panic attack)
(3) v. to use violence against someone or something; to try to hurt or defeat them
(4) v. to criticize someone or something strongly, in words

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （疾病的）发作（a heart / panic / asthma attack）
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway up the stairs the old man clutched his chest; a heart attack sent him crumpling to the floor. （读后续写·突发疾病）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 攻击，袭击（人身/军事/动物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The stray dog, cornered and terrified, suddenly attacked the boy who had meant to help it. （读后续写·意外冲突）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 抨击，（用言语）猛烈批评
uncommonMeanings.example: The columnist fiercely attacked the new policy for punishing the families it claimed to protect. （议论文·社会评论）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 着手处理（难题、任务）
uncommonMeanings.example: Rolling up his sleeves, he attacked the mountain of overdue homework with surprising determination. （读后续写·学业态度）

posExamples.sentence: Out of nowhere a panic attack seized her; her heart hammered, her palms turned to ice, and the crowded hall seemed to close in around her. （读后续写·心理·焦虑发作）
The stray dog, cornered and terrified, suddenly attacked the boy who had only meant to help it. （读后续写·意外冲突）
I am writing to warn residents that thieves tend to attack when the streets are quiet, so please keep your doors locked after dark. （应用文·公告/提醒）
Rather than attacking those who disagree with us, we should learn to challenge their ideas with reason and respect. （议论文·理性讨论）

wordForms.other: counter-attack (n./v. 反击)

idioms.example: For proposing longer study hours, the headmaster soon came under attack from students and parents alike. （议论文·争议话题）

idioms.idiom: attack is the best form of defence
idioms.example: Believing that attack is the best form of defence, the young debater opened not by shielding her own view but by dismantling her rival's. （读后续写·辩论）

collocations.translation: 心脏病发作（课文：suffering a heart attack）
collocations.example: In the long term, they may be at increased risk of ... suffering a heart attack. （课文原句·睡眠不足的长期风险）
The shocking news was so overwhelming that his grandfather very nearly had a heart attack. （读后续写·突发事件）
The thick smoke triggered an asthma attack, and she fought desperately for every breath. （读后续写·危急时刻）
Under cover of darkness the raiders launched an attack on the sleeping camp. （读后续写·冒险）
The reform came under fierce attack from those who feared losing their privileges. （议论文·社会）
The essay was read as a bold attack on the culture of overwork poisoning modern schools. （议论文·社会评论）
Clutching a broken oar, the fisherman fought to fend off the shark's relentless attack. （读后续写·海上求生）
She attacked the coding challenge line by line, refusing to give up until every bug was gone. （读后续写·钻研精神）
Instead of verbally attacking his opponent, the captain calmly let the facts speak for themselves. （议论文·理性）

synonyms.example: The sudden assault left the guard reeling, and the alarm shattered the silence of the night. （读后续写·冲突）
synonyms.usage: 更强调猛烈、突然的人身或军事袭击，语气比 attack 更重，也是法律术语（人身伤害罪）；attack 用法更宽，可指言语、疾病、任务等

synonyms.example: The editorial criticized the plan for ignoring the needs of rural students. （议论文·评论）
synonyms.usage: 仅指言语上的批评，中性偏客观；attack 表示批评时语气更激烈、带敌意

synonyms.example: The team met at dawn to tackle the flooding before it reached the village. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 指积极着手解决问题或任务，语气中性积极；attack 表此义时更强调猛烈、全力以赴的劲头

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·发动与抵御攻击
advancedExpressions.expression: launch/carry out an attack · come under attack · fend off/repel an attack · an attack on sth
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had they launched the attack than the villagers rose to fend it off. （攻击-抵御短语成对使用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·攻击/抨击(可替换,看对象)
advancedExpressions.expression: attack / assault(人身猛烈) / criticize(仅言语) / tackle·attack(处理难题)
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than assaulting (= attacking) his rival with insults, she chose to criticize the argument itself. （功能：assault 语气最重，criticize 最中性）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·attack 一词多义与词性
advancedExpressions.expression: attack 名词/动词同形：a heart attack(n.疾病发作) / attack sb(vt.袭击) / attack a problem(vt.着手)
advancedExpressions.example: When the deadline attacked (vt.迫近), he attacked the report (vt.着手) as if fending off an attack (n.). （考点：同形不同义与词性）

advancedExpressions.expression: without warning, ... attacked / an attack seized sb.
advancedExpressions.example: Without warning, a wave of dizziness attacked her, and the world tilted violently beneath her feet. （突发危机+身体反应，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: to guard against ..., we are advised to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To guard against sudden attacks by stray animals, we are strongly advised to walk in groups after dusk. （公告结尾建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: instead of attacking ..., we ought to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of attacking those whose opinions differ from ours, we ought to engage them in reasoned dialogue, for truth is refined, not destroyed, by disagreement.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dog attacked him and he was scared.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before he could even cry out, the dog lunged and attacked, its bared teeth flashing white in the fading light, and a cold wave of terror surged through every fibre of his body. （读后续写·动作+恐惧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: before 时间状语制造紧迫 + 动词升级(lunged and attacked) + 细节(bared teeth flashing white) + 心理描写(cold wave of terror surged)

sentenceUpgrade.original: People attacked the new rule.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No sooner had the new rule been announced than it came under fierce attack, with parents and teachers alike condemning it as hasty, ill-considered and blind to the realities of student life. （议论文·社会评论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No sooner...than 倒装制造张力 + 被动 came under attack + with 复合结构 + 三形容词递进(hasty, ill-considered, blind)

classPractice.question: Years of stress and poor sleep left him at real risk of ____ (suffer) a heart attack.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文 at risk of doing；介词 of 后用动名词 suffering，attack 此处指(疾病)发作

classPractice.question: 选词：Rather than ____ (attack / assault / criticize) those who disagree, we should challenge their ideas with reason.
classPractice.note: 此处指言语上的抨击，attack 或 criticize 均可；assault 多指人身猛烈袭击，语境不符

classPractice.question:
浓烟引发了一场哮喘发作，她拼命地喘着气。（asthma attack）
The thick smoke ____ ____ ____ ____, and she fought for every breath.
classPractice.note: attack 表疾病发作时可数，前加 an；trigger/have/suffer + an asthma attack

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: Everyone knows that the amount of quality sleep we get is important to us.
readingExamples: Everyone knows that the amount of quality sleep we get is important to us.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a quantity of something, especially the total quantity of money, time or a substance
(2) n. a sum of money
(3) v. (amount to) to add up to a total; to be equal to a particular figure
(4) v. (amount to) to be the same as something, or to have the same effect as it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 数量（不可数，常接 of + 不可数名词，尤指金钱/时间/努力等）
uncommonMeanings.example: A huge amount of effort had gone into the surprise party, and her tears made it all worthwhile. （读后续写·感动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （amount to）（数量）加起来达到，总计
uncommonMeanings.example: By the end of the sale, the coins the children had gathered amounted to more than a thousand yuan. （应用文·活动报道）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （amount to）等同于，无异于
uncommonMeanings.example: His stubborn silence at that crucial moment amounted to a confession, and everyone knew it. （读后续写·真相揭露）

posExamples.sentence: No amount of apology could undo the hurt his careless words had caused, yet he swallowed his pride and tried all the same. （读后续写·和解）
I am writing to report that, thanks to your generosity, a considerable amount of money has been raised for the flood-stricken families. （应用文·感谢信）
The amount of pressure heaped upon today's teenagers, some argue, is quietly robbing them of the very childhood that should shape them. （议论文·教育）
Ignoring the drowning stranger, the onlookers eventually realised, would amount to a betrayal of everything they claimed to believe. （读后续写·道德抉择）

idioms.example: No amount of money could ever buy back the years he had spent chasing wealth instead of his children's laughter. （读后续写·顿悟）

idioms.idiom: amount to nothing / not amount to much
idioms.translation: 毫无结果，成不了什么气候
idioms.example: They had told him his dreams would amount to nothing, yet years later his invention was changing lives across the country. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.phrase: the amount of + 不可数名词
collocations.translation: ……的数量（课文：the amount of quality sleep）
collocations.example: Everyone knows that the amount of quality sleep we get is important to us. （课文原句·睡眠质量的量很重要）

collocations.phrase: a large / small / huge amount of
collocations.translation: 大量的 / 少量的（+不可数名词）
collocations.example: A large amount of rubbish had piled up along the once-clear riverbank. （议论文·环保）
A certain amount of nervousness before a speech is a sign that you truly care. （应用文·经验分享）
The total amount donated exceeded our wildest hopes, and the class erupted into cheers. （应用文·活动报道）
To protect our oceans, each of us must reduce the amount of plastic we throw away. （议论文·环保）
The repairs amounted to nearly ten thousand yuan, a sum they could scarcely afford. （读后续写·生活压力）
No amount of persuasion could shake her quiet resolve to become a doctor. （读后续写·坚定）

collocations.phrase: an enormous / considerable amount of time
collocations.example: She had poured a considerable amount of time into rehearsing, and it showed. （读后续写·付出）

synonyms.example: A growing number of students now choose to study abroad after graduation. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 只用于可数名词(the number of students, a number of books)，谓语随中心名词；amount 用于不可数名词(the amount of water/time)，二者切勿混用——这是高考高频辨析点

synonyms.example: A small quantity of salt is enough to transform the whole dish. （说明文·生活）
synonyms.usage: 较中性正式，可搭配可数或不可数名词，强调可测量的多少；amount 通常只接不可数名词，且常与金钱、时间、努力等抽象量搭配

synonyms.example: He donated a generous sum to rebuild the village school. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 特指一笔具体的钱款；amount 泛指数量，用于金钱时侧重总量而非单笔

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·量的多少与合计
advancedExpressions.expression: a large/small amount of · a certain amount of · the total amount · amount to · no amount of
advancedExpressions.example: A large amount of donated food amounted to over two tonnes, yet no amount of food could feed every family at once. （量的短语连用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·数量(可替换,看可数性)
advancedExpressions.expression: amount(不可数) / number(可数) / quantity(通用) / sum(钱款)
advancedExpressions.example: The quantity of water and the number of bottles both mattered, but the amount of care behind them mattered most. （功能：三词各管一类名词，不可混用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致(the amount of ... is)
advancedExpressions.expression: The amount of + 不可数名词 + 单数动词；The number of + 复数名词 + 单数动词
advancedExpressions.example: The amount of sleep we get is important. （中心词 amount 为单数，谓语用 is，考点：主谓一致）

advancedExpressions.expression: no amount of ... could ...

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: Try to stick to your sleep schedule at the weekend too, even though weekends are probably the time when you feel like a lie-in.
readingExamples: Try to stick to your sleep schedule at the weekend too, even though weekends are probably the time when you feel like a lie-in.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a plan that lists all the work that you have to do and when you must do each thing; a timetable
(2) n. a list of the times when trains, buses, planes, etc. arrive and depart
(3) v. to arrange for something to happen or take place at a particular time
(4) n. a formal list, especially an official list of prices, rates or conditions attached to a document

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 日程安排，时间表（个人计划）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （火车、公交、航班的）时刻表
uncommonMeanings.example: A single glance at the departure schedule told her the last train home had already left. （读后续写·错过）

posExamples.sentence: Try to stick to your sleep schedule at the weekend too, for the body, like a loyal clock, quietly rewards those who keep their promises to it. （议论文·健康）

A punishing schedule of extra classes, some educators warn, leaves students too exhausted to think, let alone to dream. （议论文·教育）

idioms.example: Working through the night, the volunteers finished the whole mural a full day ahead of schedule. （读后续写·集体努力）

collocations.translation: 坚持你的睡眠时间表（课文：stick to your sleep schedule）

collocations.translation: 睡眠 / 工作 / 训练时间表
collocations.example: Doctors recommend keeping a regular sleep schedule to protect the body's rhythm. （议论文·健康）

Working through the night, the volunteers finished the mural a full day ahead of schedule. （读后续写·集体努力）

collocations.phrase: a tight / busy / packed / hectic schedule

Before the trip, we drew up a careful schedule so no one would stand at the wrong gate. （应用文·计划）
Somehow she managed to fit weekly hospital visits into her overflowing schedule. （读后续写·善良）

collocations.phrase: be scheduled to do / schedule sth for (a time)
collocations.translation: 被安排做…… / 把某事定在（某时间）

synonyms.example: The new timetable squeezed three science lessons into a single gruelling afternoon. （应用文·校园）
synonyms.usage: 英式英语常用，多指课程表、火车时刻表等固定重复的安排；schedule 更宽泛，可指个人日程、工作计划，也可作动词

synonyms.example: Their plan for the weekend fell apart the moment the rain began. （读后续写·意外）

advancedExpressions.expression: stick to a schedule · on schedule · ahead of schedule · behind schedule · be scheduled to do

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·日程/计划(可替换,看侧重)

sub_section: Restrictive relative clauses with relative adverbs
original_sentence: These negative thoughts are one reason why you stay awake after the light goes off.
readingExamples: These negative thoughts are one reason why you stay awake after the light goes off.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. harmful, unpleasant, or not wanted; bad
(2) adj. considering only the bad side of something or someone; lacking enthusiasm or hope; pessimistic
(3) adj. expressing 'no'; showing refusal, denial or the absence of something
(4) adj. (of a medical or scientific test) showing that a substance or condition is not present
(5) n. a word or statement that means 'no' or expresses denial

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 消极的，负面的；否定的（课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: These negative thoughts wrapped around her like a fog; the harder she tried to sleep, the more awake she grew. （读后续写·失眠·心理）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医学检测）阴性的
uncommonMeanings.example: When the doctor said the test had come back negative, the whole family let out a long-held breath. （读后续写·如释重负）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 负的（数学·电学，如负数、负极）
uncommonMeanings.example: A negative number always sits to the left of zero on the number line. （说明文·数学）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （摄影）底片；否定词
uncommonMeanings.example: In the dim red glow of the darkroom, he held the negative up to the light and watched the forgotten summer reappear. （读后续写·旧照片·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: These negative thoughts wrapped around her like a fog, and the harder she tried to sleep, the more wide awake she became. （读后续写·失眠·心理）
I am writing to express my concern about the negative effects that excessive screen time is having on our classmates' eyesight and mood. （应用文·建议信）
Dwelling on the negative aspects of failure, some argue, blinds us to the priceless lessons that only setbacks can teach. （议论文·成长）
His reply was curt and negative, and with a single shake of the head he crushed the small hope she had dared to nurse. （读后续写·失望）

wordForms.noun: negativity / negative (消极；底片/负数/否定词)
wordForms.adjective: negative (消极的/否定的/阴性的/负的)
wordForms.other: 反义词 positive(积极的/阳性的/正的) 各义项一一对应。熟词僻义：负数(a negative number)、底片(a photographic negative)、阴性(test negative)。构词法：neg(否定)+ative；同根 negate(否定), negation(否定)

collocations.example: These negative thoughts are one reason why you stay awake after the light goes off. （课文原句·消极想法致失眠）

collocations.phrase: a negative effect / impact / influence on
collocations.example: Staying up scrolling videos has a startling negative effect on both memory and mood. （议论文·健康）
A negative attitude, his coach warned, would defeat him long before any opponent could. （读后续写·励志）
Rather than being crushed by the negative feedback, she turned every criticism into a plan. （读后续写·成长）
When the audience reacted negatively, the speaker paused, breathed, and won them back with a smile. （读后续写·演讲）
To everyone's relief, all the passengers eventually tested negative and went home. （应用文·报道）
The media too often portrays teenagers in a negative light, ignoring their quiet kindness. （议论文·社会）
Ignoring the signs of exhaustion can lead to negative consequences no coffee will fix. （议论文·健康）

synonyms.example: She chose to replace every negative thought with a positive one, and slowly her outlook brightened. （读后续写·心理转变）
synonyms.usage: negative 的核心反义词，各义项一一对应：消极↔积极、负数↔正数、阴性↔阳性；写作中 negative...positive 对照可制造转折与升华

synonyms.example: Even in the bleakest weeks, she refused to become pessimistic, sure a door would open. （读后续写·乐观）
synonyms.usage: 专指对未来悲观、总预期坏结果的心态；negative 含义更广，可指有害的、否定的、阴性的等

synonyms.example: Excessive noise is far more harmful to concentration than most students realise. （议论文·健康）
synonyms.usage: 直接强调造成实际伤害或损害；negative 常指影响不好、令人不快，程度不一定到伤害

synonyms.example: Despite the unfavourable weather, the whole team turned up for the charity run. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，指不利的条件或不赞成的态度；negative 更口语常用，且可指情绪、检测结果等

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·负面影响与情绪
advancedExpressions.expression: a negative effect/impact on · negative thoughts/emotions · in a negative light · react negatively

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·负面的(可替换,看侧重)
advancedExpressions.expression: negative / pessimistic(悲观) / harmful(有害) / unfavourable(不利) / adverse(不利,书面)

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·neg-否定家族与正反对照

advancedExpressions.example: He refused to let negativity negate his progress, choosing to face each setback positively rather than negatively. （同根词+正反对照一句到位）

advancedExpressions.expression: she brushed the negative thoughts aside and ...

advancedExpressions.expression: what appears negative at first glance may prove ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Long after the light went off, negative thoughts circled his mind like restless moths around a lamp, and sleep, however desperately he chased it, slipped further and further away. （读后续写·失眠·心理）

translation: 塑料 | adj. 塑料制的
sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: A man received plastic surgery at King's Hospital last month to treat burn marks he got one year ago.
readingExamples: A man received plastic surgery at King's Hospital last month to treat burn marks he got one year ago.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a light, strong artificial material that can be moulded into shape when soft and used to make many kinds of objects
(2) adj. made of plastic
(3) adj. easily shaped, moulded or changed; capable of being made into different forms
(4) adj. (disapproving) artificial and not sincere; lacking natural or genuine quality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】塑料的；可塑的（adj. 塑料的，可塑的；un. 塑料，塑胶）
uncommonMeanings.example: The chair is made of plastic. 这把椅子是塑料做的。（课件义项：plastic un. 塑料 / adj. 塑料的、可塑的）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 可塑的；柔软易成形的（本义引申，常喻人格/大脑可塑）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her mentor often reminded her that a young mind is remarkably plastic — every book she read, every failure she endured, was quietly reshaping the person she was destined to become. （读后续写·成长感悟·大脑可塑）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 假惺惺的；不真诚的；做作的（贬义）

posExamples.sentence: As the tide drew back, she stared in horror at the beach that had once been her playground — now a graveyard of tangled plastic, each faded bottle a silent accusation of human carelessness. （读后续写·环保觉醒·海滩污染）

I am writing to urge every member of our student union to say no to single-use plastic, for the mountains of waste we generate each term are slowly suffocating the very campus we cherish. （应用文·倡议书·减塑）

Although plastic packaging offers undeniable convenience, its environmental cost far outweighs this fleeting benefit, and it is high time society reconsidered its reckless dependence on it. （议论文·环境与便利）
With trembling hands the little boy clutched his one and only toy — a chipped plastic soldier — as if it were the last treasure standing between him and a world too big to face alone. （读后续写·童年·珍视）

wordForms.other: plastics (n. 塑料制品/塑料工业)

collocations.translation: 【课件】整形外科，整容手术（改善外表或修复损伤）

collocations.translation: 整形手术（课文原句词块：A man received plastic surgery ... to treat burn marks）

collocations.translation: 塑料袋（复数，环保话题高频）
collocations.example: Many shops now charge for plastic bags to cut waste. 许多商店现在对塑料袋收费以减少浪费。
The volunteers filled sack after sack with discarded plastic bottles, their gloves black with grime but their hearts light with purpose. （读后续写·志愿服务）
Banning single-use plastic on campus may seem a small step, yet it plants in every student the seed of environmental responsibility. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.translation: 塑料垃圾 / 塑料污染
collocations.example: Scientists warn that plastic pollution has crept into the deepest oceans and even the food on our plates, a threat we can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·环境问题）

The company's shift to biodegradable plastic proved that profit and environmental conscience need not stand in opposition. （议论文·可持续发展）

Our class pledged to make this year's charity fair a completely plastic-free event, and the applause that followed told us the idea had struck a chord. （应用文·活动方案）

synonyms.example: The flowers on the table looked lush, but their artificial petals betrayed a coldness that no living bloom would ever have. （读后续写·环境暗示）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'人造、非天然的'，范围比 plastic 广；plastic 特指塑料制或引申'做作虚假'

advancedExpressions.example: We should say no to single-use plastic and cut down on plastic pollution. 我们应拒绝一次性塑料、减少塑料污染。

advancedExpressions.example: The plasticity of the young brain means early habits shape us for life. 年轻大脑的可塑性意味着早期习惯会塑造我们的一生。

advancedExpressions.expression: plastic 除"塑料(的)"外，还可作 adj. "可塑的、易成形的"(常喻人格/大脑)，及贬义"假惺惺的、做作的"
advancedExpressions.example: A young mind is remarkably plastic. 年轻的心智极具可塑性。 / Behind that plastic smile lay real exhaustion. 那假笑背后是真实的疲惫。

advancedExpressions.expression: a beach littered with plastic, a wound the sea could not heal
advancedExpressions.example: Before her stretched a beach littered with plastic — a wound the sea could not heal, no matter how many times the tide tried to wash it clean. （破折号+拟人+隐喻，用环境意象暗示主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is high time (that) we cut down on plastic and ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is high time that we cut down on plastic and embraced a greener campus, for the choices we make today will decide the world we leave behind. （it is high time+虚拟过去式，倡议信高级句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: convenient as plastic may be, its cost to the planet is beyond measure
advancedExpressions.example: Convenient as plastic may be, its cost to the planet is beyond measure; genuine progress lies not in producing more, but in wanting less. （as 引导让步倒装 + 对比升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a lot of plastic on the beach.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As far as the eye could see 视野铺陈 + 隐喻(a suffocating blanket) + 列举(bottles, bags and broken toys)增画面 + as if 拟人升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use less plastic.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore my earnest appeal that every one of us, however small our individual effort may seem, resolve to reduce plastic consumption — for a river of change is, after all, fed by countless quiet streams. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my earnest appeal that+虚拟(should省略) 正式主句 + however 让步插入语 + 破折号引出隐喻(river fed by streams)收束呼吁

classPractice.question: The company has invested heavily in developing biodegradable ____ (plastic) to replace single-use ones.
classPractice.note: plastics 作"塑料制品/多种塑料"讲时可数，此处指多种可降解塑料，用复数。

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: A woman who has recently had plastic surgery on her face now regrets the decision.
readingExamples: A woman who has recently had plastic surgery on her face now regrets the decision.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the treatment of injuries or diseases in people or animals by cutting open the body and often removing or repairing parts
(2) n. (BrE) the place where a doctor, dentist, etc. sees patients; a doctor's or dentist's consulting room
(3) n. (BrE) the period of time during which a doctor, dentist, etc. is available to see patients
(4) n. (BrE) a period when a Member of Parliament, lawyer, etc. is available for people to consult

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 外科（学）；外科手术这一治疗方式/学科（不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: She decided to study surgery, dreaming of the day she would stand at the operating table herself. 她决定攻读外科，梦想有朝一日亲自站上手术台。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 诊所；医生（牙医）的诊室（英式英语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The waiting room of the village surgery was crowded that morning, and the old doctor moved from patient to patient with a patience that a lifetime of service had polished. （读后续写·乡村诊所·医者仁心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （议员/律师的）接待时间，咨询时段（英式英语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every Friday the MP held a surgery in the town hall, where ordinary people, hats in hand, brought their troubles to a man they hoped might still listen. （读后续写·议员接待·民生）

posExamples.sentence: For six agonising hours the family sat outside the operating theatre, and when the surgeon finally emerged to say the surgery had been a success, the mother's legs gave way with sheer relief. （读后续写·手术等待·亲情）
I am writing to express our heartfelt gratitude to the medical team whose skilful surgery gave my grandfather a second chance at life. （应用文·感谢信·致医生）
While modern surgery can work near-miracles on the human body, we must never forget that a caring word from the doctor often heals wounds that no scalpel can reach. （议论文·医疗与人文关怀）
Only after the surgery on her injured knee did the young gymnast grasp how fragile a dream could be, and how fiercely she would have to fight to reclaim it. （读后续写·运动员·伤病与坚持）

wordForms.noun: surgery (手术/外科) / surgeon (n. 外科医生)
wordForms.other: 对比记忆：a surgeon 外科医生 vs a physician 内科医生；surgical mask 外科口罩

collocations.phrase: have / get / undergo / receive surgery【课件】

collocations.translation: 【课件】进行外科手术（surgical adj. 外科的）

collocations.translation: （在……上）做整形手术（课文原句词块：A woman who has recently had plastic surgery on her face）
collocations.example: A woman who has recently had plastic surgery on her face now regrets the decision. 一名近期在脸上做过整形手术的女子如今后悔了这个决定。

Rather than let fear win, she chose to undergo the surgery, whispering to herself that courage was simply fear that had said its prayers. （读后续写·勇气·抉择）
The debate over whether teenagers should be allowed cosmetic surgery continues to divide parents and doctors alike. （议论文·社会话题）
The surgeon who performed the delicate surgery on the child's heart had not slept for twenty hours, yet his hands never once trembled. （读后续写·医者·敬业）

collocations.translation: 心脏 / 脑部 / 开胸手术
collocations.example: After successful open-heart surgery, the veteran runner set himself a single quiet goal: to finish, however slowly, one last marathon. （读后续写·康复·梦想）
The doctor reassured them it was only minor surgery, yet to the anxious mother waiting outside, no operation on her only son could ever feel minor. （读后续写·亲情·担忧）
Thanks to keyhole surgery, patients now recover in days rather than weeks, a quiet revolution that spares countless people needless suffering. （议论文·医学进步）

collocations.translation: 为做某事而进行的手术
collocations.example: He received surgery to repair the tendon, and the long months of therapy that followed tested his patience as much as his body. （读后续写·伤病恢复）
As she slowly recovered from surgery, the flowers her classmates sent lined the windowsill like small promises that she was not forgotten. （读后续写·友情·温暖）

synonyms.example: The operation lasted well into the night, and only at dawn did the exhausted team allow themselves a weary, grateful smile. （读后续写·手术·团队）
synonyms.usage: operation 指一次具体的手术'过程/事件'，可数；surgery 多指手术这一'治疗方式/学科'，常不可数

synonyms.example: The doctor explained that the procedure was routine, yet his gentle tone did more to calm the boy than any statistic ever could. （读后续写·医患沟通）
synonyms.usage: procedure 为较正式/中性的'医疗操作'，涵盖手术及非手术处置；surgery 特指'开刀'类治疗

synonyms.translation: 诊所（美式对应 surgery 的诊所义）
synonyms.example: The free clinic on the edge of town was the only place the migrant workers could turn to when illness struck. （读后续写·民生·关怀）
synonyms.usage: clinic 为通用'诊所'（英美通用）；surgery 表'诊所'时是英式用法，且多指全科/家庭医生诊室

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·surgery 常用搭配（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: have / get / undergo / receive surgery 接受手术 / surgeon n. 外科医生 / perform surgical procedures 进行外科手术 / plastic (cosmetic) surgery 整形(美容)手术
advancedExpressions.example: The surgeon will perform the surgery tomorrow, and the patient is willing to undergo it. 外科医生明天将实施手术，病人也愿意接受。（课件短语归纳）

advancedExpressions.expression: have / undergo surgery 接受手术 / perform surgery on sb 给某人做手术 / recover from surgery 术后康复 / plastic (cosmetic) surgery 整形(美容)手术 / open-heart surgery 开胸手术
advancedExpressions.example: She underwent surgery and slowly recovered from it over the summer. 她接受了手术，并在整个夏天里慢慢康复。

advancedExpressions.expression: surgery (n. 手术/外科) → surgeon (n. 外科医生) → surgical (adj. 外科的/手术的) → surgically (adv. 通过手术地)；注意 -eon 结尾表"人"
advancedExpressions.example: The surgeon put on a surgical mask before the surgery began. 手术开始前，那位外科医生戴上了外科口罩。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·手术/医疗操作（功能：可替换 surgery）
advancedExpressions.expression: surgery / an operation / a procedure（"一次手术"多用 an operation 或 a procedure；"外科这一学科/治疗方式"用 surgery）
advancedExpressions.example: The operation (= the surgery) lasted six hours. 这场手术持续了六个小时。

advancedExpressions.expression: not until the surgeon emerged did they dare to breathe
advancedExpressions.example: Not until the surgeon emerged, mask lowered and eyes crinkling into a tired smile, did the whole family dare to breathe again. （not until 倒装 + 细节神态描写渲染紧张后的释然）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly convey how grateful we are for the surgery that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly convey how grateful we are for the surgery that pulled my father back from the very edge of despair. （words can hardly convey 情感升华套式，感谢信升华句）

advancedExpressions.expression: surgery may mend the body, but it takes compassion to heal the person
advancedExpressions.example: Surgery may mend the body, but it takes compassion to heal the person; a hospital without warmth is merely a workshop of repairs. （对比结构 mend the body / heal the person + 隐喻收尾）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He had surgery and felt happy afterwards.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the bandages were at last unwound and he glimpsed his healed face in the mirror, the young man who had hidden from the world for a year felt something long forgotten stir within him — hope, warm and unmistakable, rising like the first light of a spring dawn. （读后续写·康复·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句铺陈 + 破折号点题(hope) + 比喻(like the first light of a spring dawn) + 心理动词(stir within him)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The doctors did a good surgery, so we thank them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of my entire family, I wish to extend our deepest gratitude to the surgical team, whose extraordinary skill and unwavering dedication turned what we feared would be a farewell into a joyful new beginning. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of 正式开头 + extend our deepest gratitude 套式 + whose 定语从句 + 对比升华(farewell / joyful new beginning)

classPractice.answer: undergo surgery / have surgery / receive surgery

classPractice.note: 课件 surgeon n. 外科医生；此处需表『做手术的人』，-eon 结尾表人。

classPractice.note: 课件 perform surgical procedures；修饰名词 instruments 需用形容词 surgical『外科的、手术用的』。

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: A man received plastic surgery at King's Hospital last month to treat burn marks he got one year ago.
readingExamples: A man received plastic surgery at King's Hospital last month to treat burn marks he got one year ago.
definitionEn:
(1) n. medical operations to repair or reconstruct damaged, deformed or missing parts of the body, especially the skin
(2) n. surgery performed to improve a person's appearance rather than for medical necessity (i.e. cosmetic surgery)

posExamples.sentence: A year after the fire had left his skin scarred and his spirit crushed, plastic surgery finally gave the young man back a face he was no longer afraid to show the world. （读后续写·烧伤康复·重生）
I am writing to share my view on whether teenagers should be encouraged to have plastic surgery, an issue that has recently sparked heated discussion among my classmates. （应用文·观点信·开头）

While plastic surgery can undoubtedly restore confidence to those disfigured by accidents, using it merely to chase an impossible standard of beauty is a road that leads only to endless dissatisfaction. （议论文·整容利弊）
The nurse gently reassured the trembling girl that plastic surgery would erase the burn marks, and for the first time in months a fragile smile crept across her face. （读后续写·医患·希望）

collocations.phrase: plastic surgery（整形外科，整容手术）【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】整形外科，整容手术（=cosmetic surgery，改变面部/身体外观以改善外表或修复损伤）
collocations.example: Plastic surgery is the medical practice of changing the appearance of people's faces or bodies, either to improve their appearance or to repair injuries. 整形手术是改变人的面部或身体外观、以改善外表或修复损伤的医疗做法。（课件定义原句）

collocations.phrase: receive plastic surgery to treat ...【课件/课文原句词块】
collocations.example: A man received plastic surgery at King's Hospital last month to treat burn marks he got one year ago. 一名男子上月在国王医院做整形手术，以治疗一年前留下的烧伤疤痕。（课文原句，课件语篇背景）
After the accident, she chose to undergo plastic surgery not out of vanity, but simply to look in the mirror without flinching. （读后续写·康复·心理）
Reconstructive plastic surgery restored the burn victim's hand, allowing him to hold his daughter's tiny fingers once more. （读后续写·亲情·康复）
The rising popularity of cosmetic plastic surgery among the young reflects a society increasingly obsessed with outward appearance. （议论文·社会现象）
Standing before the mirror, she quietly regretted the plastic surgery that had chased away not her flaws, but the very face her late mother had loved. （读后续写·反思·亲情）
Too many young people, dazzled by celebrity photos, overlook the very real risks of plastic surgery. （议论文·论证）
When she got plastic surgery on her face, she believed it would bring happiness; only later did she learn that self-worth is never skin-deep. （读后续写·价值反思）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】美容手术（课件明确 plastic surgery = cosmetic surgery）
synonyms.example: Cosmetic surgery may smooth a wrinkle or two, yet no scalpel can carve away the insecurity that lives within. 美容手术或许能抚平一两道皱纹，却无法削去内心的不安。（课件同义标注）
synonyms.usage: 课件将 plastic surgery 与 cosmetic surgery 并列同义；狭义上 cosmetic surgery 专指『为美观』的整容，plastic surgery 更广，含『修复重建』与『美容』两类

synonyms.example: The facial reconstruction gave the soldier back not only his features but his willingness to face old friends. （读后续写·康复·尊严）
synonyms.usage: reconstruction 强调'重建修复'受损部位，医疗必要性强；plastic surgery 为上位概念，兼含美容整形

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·plastic surgery 课件定义（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: plastic surgery / cosmetic surgery：the medical practice of changing the appearance of people's faces or bodies, either to improve their appearance or to repair injuries（整形外科，整容手术）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件用一句英英定义点明两大目的：either to improve appearance（改善外表）or to repair injuries（修复损伤）——写作时区分『美容型』与『修复型』整形。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 plastic surgery
advancedExpressions.expression: plastic (adj. 可塑的/整形的) + surgery (n. 手术) = plastic surgery 整形手术；同类合成：cosmetic surgery 美容手术、keyhole surgery 微创手术
advancedExpressions.example: Plastic surgery can reshape a face, but not the heart behind it. 整形手术能重塑一张脸，却塑造不了脸后的那颗心。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·plastic surgery 常用搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: have / undergo / receive plastic surgery 做整形手术 / plastic surgery on one's face 在脸上做整形 / reconstructive plastic surgery 重建整形 / the risks of plastic surgery 整形的风险
advancedExpressions.example: He received plastic surgery on his face to treat the burn marks. 他在脸上做了整形手术以治疗烧伤疤痕。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·整形/美容手术（功能：可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: plastic surgery / cosmetic surgery / a nose job(口语·隆鼻) / going under the knife(口语·开刀)；"为美观"多用 cosmetic surgery，"含修复重建"用 plastic surgery
advancedExpressions.example: More and more teenagers are tempted to have cosmetic surgery. 越来越多青少年被美容手术所诱惑。

advancedExpressions.expression: the plastic surgery gave sb back not just a face, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The plastic surgery gave him back not just a face, but the courage to walk into a room without lowering his eyes. （not just A, but B 递进 + 抽象升华 courage）

advancedExpressions.expression: opinions are divided over whether ... should resort to plastic surgery
advancedExpressions.example: Opinions are divided over whether ordinary people should resort to plastic surgery in pursuit of beauty, and I would like to offer my own. （opinions are divided over 引出争议话题的经典开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: plastic surgery may reshape the face, but true beauty is shaped from within
advancedExpressions.example: Plastic surgery may reshape the face, but true beauty is shaped from within — and no operation can ever mould a kind heart. （对比 reshape / shaped from within + 破折号点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After plastic surgery he was happy and went outside.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The morning after the bandages came off, he stepped out of his front door for the first time in a year — chin lifted, heart pounding — and let the ordinary sunlight fall on a face that plastic surgery, and his own quiet courage, had finally set free. （读后续写·重生·动作心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语铺陈 + 破折号插入神态(chin lifted, heart pounding) + 双重原因并置(surgery and courage) + 象征(sunlight/set free)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Some people think plastic surgery is good but I disagree.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Although many contend that plastic surgery is a shortcut to confidence, I remain firmly convinced that genuine self-assurance can never be purchased on an operating table — it must be earned, slowly, through the way we live and treat others. （议论文·驳论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Although 让步引出对方观点 + I remain firmly convinced 表明立场 + 比喻(purchased on an operating table) + 破折号补充升华

classPractice.question: The badly scarred man decided to ____ plastic surgery ____ his face to treat the burn marks.（做整形；部位介词）
classPractice.note: "做整形手术"用 have/undergo/receive plastic surgery；表"在(某部位)"用介词 on，如 on his face。（课文原句结构）

classPractice.question: 人们对于青少年是否应该做整形手术意见不一。（用 opinions are divided over whether + plastic surgery）

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: Last January, Mr Wilson was caught in a horrible campus fire, and his skin was badly burnt.

definitionEn:

(2) n. a similar site occupied by a large company or organisation, containing several buildings
(3) adj. (attributive) relating to or taking place on a college or university campus

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （大公司/机构的）园区，办公园区

posExamples.sentence: As dusk settled over the quiet campus, the golden lamplight spilling from the library windows seemed to whisper that another day of learning had not been wasted. （读后续写·校园黄昏·氛围）
