A healthy campus culture, built on respect and shared curiosity, does far more to nurture talent than any strict rulebook. （议论文·教育）
Nothing prepared him for the sheer scale of the university campus, where he wandered for an hour before finding a single familiar face. （读后续写·迷茫·新环境）
During the campus tour, the guide's proud descriptions of the old bell tower kindled in the visitors a longing to study there one day. （读后续写·参观·向往）
The news of the charity fair spread across the campus within hours, and by noon nearly every class had signed up to help. （读后续写·校园·集体行动）

synonyms.example: The autumn leaves scattered across the school grounds turned the whole place into a canvas of gold and crimson. （读后续写·景物描写）
synonyms.usage: grounds 泛指某建筑周围的'场地/庭园'，不限于学校；campus 特指大学/学院或大型机构的'整个园区'

synonyms.example: Students lay sprawled across the sunlit quad, books forgotten, savouring the last warm afternoon before exams. （读后续写·校园闲适）
synonyms.usage: quad 仅指校园内被建筑环绕的'四方形院子'，是 campus 的一部分；campus 指整个校区

synonyms.example: The whole college gathered in the great hall to bid farewell to the beloved old professor. （读后续写·师生离别）
synonyms.usage: school/college 指'机构/学校'这一整体概念；campus 强调其'物理场所（建筑与场地）'

advancedExpressions.expression: on campus 在校园里/住校 / off campus 在校外 / campus life 校园生活 / campus culture 校园文化 / a campus fire 校园火灾 / across the campus 遍及校园
advancedExpressions.example: Rich campus life on campus quietly shapes who we become. 校园里丰富的生活悄然塑造着我们成为怎样的人。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·campus 复数与派生
advancedExpressions.expression: campus (n.) → 复数 campuses（-s 前是 s 加 -es）；相关：campus-wide (adj. 全校范围的)、on-campus / off-campus (adj. 校内的/校外的)
advancedExpressions.example: The new library serves all three campuses of the university. 新图书馆服务于这所大学的全部三个校区。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·校园/校区（功能：可替换 campus）
advancedExpressions.expression: campus / school grounds / the quad(四方庭院·campus 的一部分) / college(机构义)；campus 强调"整个物理园区"
advancedExpressions.example: Students lay across the sunny quad on campus, savouring the last warm afternoon. 学生们躺在校园里洒满阳光的四方庭院上，享受最后一个温暖的午后。

advancedExpressions.expression: as night fell over the campus, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As night fell over the campus and the last light in the study hall flickered out, she realised that home was no longer a place, but the friends who waited for her here. （as 引导环境铺陈 + 抽象升华 home）

advancedExpressions.expression: our campus boasts ..., where ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our campus boasts a century of history and a garden of learning, where every stone path seems to echo with the footsteps of those who dreamed before us. （boast 表'拥有'高级词 + where 定语从句渲染底蕴）

advancedExpressions.expression: a campus is not merely a place to study, but a world in which we learn to live
advancedExpressions.example: A campus is not merely a place to study, but a small world in which we first learn to live, to fail, and to rise again. （not merely A but B + 三动词递进 live/fail/rise）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She walked around the campus and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She wandered slowly through the sun-dappled campus, past the whispering plane trees and the fountain where freshmen tossed coins for luck, and with every step a quiet contentment settled over her, as though the place itself had reached out to welcome her home. （读后续写·校园漫步·情景交融）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去时叙述 + 环境细节列举(plane trees, fountain) + 情景交融(contentment settled over her) + as though 拟人化升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our campus is beautiful, please come and visit.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be our great honour to welcome you to our campus, a place where ancient bell towers stand shoulder to shoulder with modern laboratories, and where the spirit of learning breathes in every corridor. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be our great honour to 正式邀请套式 + a place where 同位语从句 + 对比意象(ancient towers / modern labs) + 拟人(spirit breathes)

classPractice.question: Last January, Mr Wilson was caught in a horrible campus fire, and his skin ____ (badly burn).
classPractice.note: skin 是动作 burn 的承受者，且为过去发生，用一般过去时被动 was badly burnt。（课文原句）

classPractice.question: Living ____ campus taught her how to share, forgive and stand on her own two feet.（在校园里/住校）
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 on campus"在校园里、住校"，campus 前不加冠词；"在校外"则是 off campus。

classPractice.question: 从 campus / grounds / college 中选词：The whole ____ gathered in the great hall to bid farewell to the old professor.（指机构/整体的"学院"）
classPractice.note: 此处指"学院这一机构/整体"，用 college；campus 强调物理园区，grounds 泛指场地。

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: Mr Wilson is very happy with the treatment.
readingExamples: Mr Wilson is very happy with the treatment.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the use of drugs, exercises, surgery, etc. to cure a person of an illness or injury; medical care given to a patient
(2) n. a way of behaving towards or dealing with a person or thing
(3) n. a process by which something is cleaned, protected, or preserved
(4) n. the way in which a subject is discussed, described or dealt with, e.g. in a book, film or article

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】治疗（sth done to cure an illness or injury）——对疾病或损伤所做的治疗
uncommonMeanings.example: She is responding well to treatment. 她经过治疗大有起色。（课件义项1原句：治疗）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】处理，防治（a process by which sth is cleaned or protected against）
uncommonMeanings.example: There should be greater treatment of sewage before it is discharged. 污水排放之前应该进行更充分的处理。（课件义项2原句：treatment of sewage 污水处理）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】对待，待遇（a way of behaving towards or dealing with a person）
uncommonMeanings.example: We don't want any special treatment. 我们不想要任何特殊待遇。（课件义项3原句：special treatment 特殊待遇）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对待（人/事物）的方式；处理方式
uncommonMeanings.example: Mr Wilson is very happy with the treatment. 威尔逊先生对（所受的）治疗/对待很满意。（课文原句，此处主指治疗，亦体现"待遇"色彩）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对待（人/事物）的方式；处理方式（更广义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The gentle treatment she received from the old librarian, who never once mocked her stammer, taught the shy girl that kindness could be a language of its own. （读后续写·关怀·成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对题材/主题的）处理，探讨方式
uncommonMeanings.example: The film's tender treatment of loss moved the whole cinema to silence, and more than one grown man was seen wiping his eyes in the dark. （读后续写·艺术感染力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （材料的）处理，加工（如防水、防腐处理）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wooden bridge had received a special treatment against rot, and even after fifty winters it still stood firm above the roaring stream. （读后续写·环境/物象）

posExamples.sentence: Week after week of painful treatment could not break her spirit; each time the needle went in, she pictured the finish line of the race she had sworn to run again. （读后续写·抗病·意志）
I am writing to express our family's sincere thanks for the attentive treatment my grandmother received during her long stay at your hospital. （应用文·感谢信）
Equal treatment of every student, regardless of family background or grades, is not merely a matter of fairness but the very foundation on which trust in education is built. （议论文·教育公平）
The kind treatment the stray dog received at the shelter slowly melted away its fear, until one evening it laid its trusting head on the volunteer's knee. （读后续写·善待动物·感动）

wordForms.verb: treat (v. 治疗；对待；款待；处理)
wordForms.other: treated (adj. 经过处理的)；辨析：treat sb (to sth) 款待/请客 vs treat sb + 副词 对待某人 vs treat an illness 治疗

idioms.idiom: give sb the full / red-carpet treatment
idioms.translation: 对某人隆重款待，给予贵宾待遇
idioms.example: On her first day back from hospital, her classmates gave her the full treatment — balloons, banners and a cake — and for a moment she forgot she had ever been ill. （读后续写·友情·惊喜）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对治疗有反应；治疗见效
collocations.example: She is responding well to treatment. 她经过治疗大有起色。（课件义项1原句）
The injured man required immediate medical treatment. 那名伤者需要立即接受药物治疗。（课件短语 require hospital/medical treatment）
There are various treatments available for this condition. 对这种病情有各种疗法。（课件义项1原句；此义可数用复数 treatments）

collocations.translation: 【课件】污水的处理（处理、防治义）
collocations.example: There should be greater treatment of sewage before it is discharged. 污水排放之前应该进行更充分的处理。（课件义项2原句）
We don't want any special treatment. 我们不想要任何特殊待遇。（课件义项3原句）

collocations.phrase: treat sb for sth with sth【课件·treat】
collocations.translation: 【课件】（用某物）治疗某人的某病
collocations.example: She was treated for sunstroke. 她因中暑而接受治疗。／ The condition is usually treated with drugs and a strict diet. 这种病通常用药物和严格控制饮食进行治疗。（课件 treat 义项1：治疗）

collocations.phrase: treat sb with respect / consideration【课件·treat】
collocations.translation: 【课件】以尊敬/体谅对待某人（对待义）
collocations.example: You should treat people with respect and consideration. 你应当尊敬、体谅地对待别人。／ He was treated as a hero. 他被当成英雄看待。（课件 treat 义项2：对待 treat sb with sth / as sth）

collocations.translation: 【课件】款待某人；请某人享用某物
collocations.example: She treated him to lunch. 她请他吃午饭。／ I'm going to treat myself to a new pair of shoes. 我打算给自己买双新鞋。（课件 treat 义项4：款待）

collocations.phrase: my treat / a special treat【课件·treat n.】
collocations.translation: 【课件】我请客；一次特别的款待/享受（treat 作名词：乐趣，款待）
collocations.example: Let's go out for lunch — my treat. 咱们出去吃午饭，我请客。／ We took the kids to the zoo as a special treat. 我们特地带孩子们去动物园，让他们开心一下。（课件 treat n. sth very pleasant 乐趣；款待）

collocations.translation: 对治疗/待遇很满意（课文原句词块：Mr Wilson is very happy with the treatment）
collocations.example: Mr Wilson is very happy with the treatment. 威尔逊先生对这次治疗非常满意。
The victims received free medical treatment at the local hospital. 伤者在当地医院接受了免费治疗。
For months he received treatment far from home, and every letter his family sent became a small lifeline pulling him toward recovery. （读后续写·亲情·康复）

collocations.translation: 对治疗有反应；治疗见效
collocations.example: When the doctor announced that the boy was finally responding to treatment, his mother pressed a trembling hand to her mouth to hold back a cry of joy. （读后续写·希望·亲情）
Every employee deserves fair treatment, for a workplace built on respect draws out the very best in people. （议论文·公平）
The novel's honest treatment of poverty forces readers to confront a reality they might rather look away from. （议论文·文学）
Too ashamed to seek treatment, he suffered in silence for years — a reminder of how deeply stigma can wound. （议论文·心理健康）
The harsh treatment the young apprentice endured only sharpened his determination to one day prove them all wrong. （读后续写·逆境·励志）
She refused any special treatment, insisting on earning her place through effort alone. （读后续写·人物·自尊）

synonyms.translation: 治疗，疗法（尤指非手术的长期调理）
synonyms.example: Months of physical therapy gradually coaxed strength back into her shattered wrist, one painful exercise at a time. （读后续写·康复·坚持）
synonyms.usage: therapy 侧重'物理/心理/长期调理型'疗法，常不含手术；treatment 涵盖一切医疗处置，范围更广

synonyms.example: The doctors could offer no cure, only comfort, yet in that comfort the dying man found a peace he had never known. （读后续写·生命·尊严）
synonyms.usage: cure 强调'治好'的结果或'根治的方法'；treatment 侧重'治疗的过程/手段'，不保证痊愈

synonyms.example: The tender care of the night nurses did as much for his recovery as any medicine. （读后续写·护理·温情）
synonyms.usage: care 泛指'照料/护理'，情感色彩强；treatment 更专业，指具体的医疗手段或对待方式

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·treat 一词多义（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: treat sb for sth with sth（治疗）／ treat sb with respect / as sth（对待、看待）／ treat sb to sth（款待、请客）／ treat n. 乐趣、款待（my treat 我请客）
advancedExpressions.example: She was treated for sunstroke（治疗）；He was treated as a hero（看待）；She treated him to lunch（款待）；Let's go out — my treat（我请客）——课件把 treat 四义靠搭配区分，一次讲透。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·treatment 三义项（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: treatment 1) 治疗（respond to / require medical treatment）2) 处理、防治（treatment of sewage）3) 对待、待遇（special treatment）
advancedExpressions.example: She responded to treatment（治疗）；the treatment of sewage（处理）；special treatment（待遇）——课件三义项靠语境定，作『治疗/处理』多不可数，作『各种疗法』可数。

advancedExpressions.expression: medical treatment 医疗 / receive (undergo) treatment 接受治疗 / respond to treatment 治疗见效 / be happy with the treatment 对治疗满意 / fair (equal) treatment 公平对待 / the treatment of sth 对……的处理
advancedExpressions.example: He is happy with the treatment and is responding to it well. 他对治疗很满意，且疗效不错。

advancedExpressions.expression: treat (v.) → treatment (n. 治疗/对待/处理) → treatable (adj. 可治疗的) → treated (adj. 经处理的)；一词多义靠搭配定：treat an illness 治病 / treat sb kindly 善待某人 / treat sb to a meal 请某人吃饭
advancedExpressions.example: The disease is treatable if caught early, but the boy was treated too late. 此病早发现可治，但那男孩救治太晚了。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·治疗（功能：可替换 treatment 的"医疗"义）
advancedExpressions.expression: treatment / therapy(尤指长期物理/心理调理) / cure(强调治愈结果) / care(护理照料)；treatment 范围最广，涵盖一切医疗处置
advancedExpressions.example: After surgery she needed months of physical therapy as follow-up treatment. 术后她需要数月理疗作为后续治疗。

advancedExpressions.expression: little by little the treatment began to work, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little the treatment began to work, and colour crept back into her cheeks like spring returning to a frozen field. （little by little 渐进 + 比喻 spring returning 表康复）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are deeply indebted to you for the treatment ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are deeply indebted to you for the treatment and tireless care that guided my father back to health. （we are deeply indebted to 高级感谢套式，情感真挚）

advancedExpressions.expression: equal treatment is not a privilege to be granted but a right to be respected
advancedExpressions.example: Equal treatment is not a privilege to be granted but a right to be respected; a just society is one where no one is left behind. （not A but B 对比 + 抽象升华 just society）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After the treatment, he got better and was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the weeks of treatment slowly loosened illness's grip, the young man who had once stared blankly at the ceiling began, little by little, to laugh again — and each laugh, however faint, felt to his mother like a miracle she had almost stopped daring to hope for. （读后续写·康复·亲情心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 引导渐变 + 拟人(illness's grip) + little by little 节奏 + 破折号补充 + 母亲视角(miracle)双重情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We thank the doctors for treating my grandmother well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of my whole family, I wish to convey our heartfelt gratitude for the compassionate treatment my grandmother received, for it was your patience and warmth, as much as your medicine, that carried her through the darkest of days. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of 正式开头 + convey heartfelt gratitude 套式 + for 引导原因 + as much as 平衡结构(patience/medicine) + 隐喻(darkest days)

classPractice.type: 辨析选词（课件 treatment 三义项）
classPractice.question: 从 treatment / therapy / cure 中选词：Every student deserves equal ____, regardless of family background.（对待）
classPractice.note: 课件 treatment 义项3『对待、待遇』；equal treatment『平等对待』；therapy/cure 只有『治疗』义，不能表『对待』。

classPractice.type: 用 treat 的正确形式填空（课件 treat 用法）
classPractice.question: The kind nurse always ____ (treat) her patients with patience and respect.（对待）
classPractice.note: 课件 treat sb with + 抽象名词『以……方式对待某人』；主语第三人称单数用 treats，叙述过去用 treated。

classPractice.type: 短语填空（课件 treat 款待义）
classPractice.question: Don't worry about the cost — I'll ____ you ____ lunch.（请你吃午饭）
classPractice.note: 课件 treat sb to sth『款待、请某人享用某物』；She treated him to lunch. 是课件原句结构。

classPractice.question: Thanks to the doctors' care, Mr Wilson is very happy ____ the treatment he has received.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 be happy with sth『对……满意』，介词用 with。（课文原句）

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: "Now I can go out just like a normal guy!" he said.
readingExamples: "Now I can go out just like a normal guy!" he said.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (informal) a man; a boy
(2) n. (guys) (informal) used to address or refer to a group of people of either sex
(3) n. a rope or wire used to hold something, especially a tent or pole, firmly in place (also 'guy rope')
(4) n. (BrE) a figure representing Guy Fawkes, burnt on a bonfire on 5 November

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （固定帐篷/杆子的）拉索，牵索（也作 guy rope）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the storm rose, he crawled from the tent to tighten every guy, knowing that a single loose rope could leave them shelterless in the roaring dark. （读后续写·野外·求生）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英）盖伊·福克斯的模拟像（篝火节焚烧的假人）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children dragged their homemade guy through the village, collecting pennies for the bonfire that would light up the frosty November night. （读后续写·英国民俗·篝火节）

posExamples.sentence: When the new boy offered his umbrella to the soaked stranger without a second thought, everyone silently agreed he was the kind of guy you could trust with anything. （读后续写·人物品格·善良）
Come on, guys — if each of us gives just one afternoon this weekend, we can clean up the whole riverbank and show the town what our class is made of! （应用文·倡议/演讲·号召同学）
We often assume that the loud, popular guy is the happiest person in the room, yet appearances can be deeply deceiving. （议论文·外表与内心）
"Now I can walk down the street just like any other guy," he whispered, and the relief in his voice spoke of a year of hiding finally at an end. （读后续写·康复·重获平常生活）

wordForms.verb: guy (vt. 用牵索固定；取笑，戏弄)

idioms.example: He acted the tough guy in front of his friends, but the moment his little sister cried, all that hardness melted away in an instant. （读后续写·外冷内热·性格反差）

idioms.idiom: the good guy / the bad guy
idioms.translation: 好人 / 坏人（尤指故事中的正反角色）
idioms.example: Life, she was learning, was rarely a simple tale of the good guy and the bad guy; most people were a shifting blend of both. （议论文/读后续写·人性思考）
Everyone said he was a nice guy, yet it was only in the crisis that they discovered just how deep his courage ran. （读后续写·人物·关键时刻）

collocations.translation: 一个普通人（课文原句词块：Now I can go out just like a normal guy!）
collocations.example: "Now I can go out just like a normal guy!" he said. "现在我可以像个普通人一样出门了！"他说。

collocations.translation: 你们（口语，指一群人，男女皆可）
collocations.example: "You guys are the best team I've ever coached," he said, his voice thick with emotion as the season drew to a close. （读后续写·告别·真情）
All he had ever wanted was to be an ordinary guy again — to buy bread, to greet neighbours, to live unnoticed among the crowd. （读后续写·平凡渴望·康复）
The coach was a great guy who stayed behind long after practice, patiently teaching the slowest runner not to give up. （读后续写·师者·耐心）

collocations.translation: 嘿，各位 / 加把劲，伙计们
collocations.example: "Come on, guys, we're almost there!" she shouted over the wind, and her voice alone seemed to pull the exhausted team up the final slope. （读后续写·团队·鼓舞）
Instead of blaming the other guy for the misunderstanding, he chose to apologise first, and the quarrel dissolved on the spot. （读后续写·宽容·化解矛盾）
In the film he always played the bad guy, yet off-screen he was the gentlest soul you could hope to meet. （读后续写·反差·人物）

collocations.translation: 某个人（不认识或不重要的人）
collocations.example: Some guy she had never met stopped to help her carry the heavy boxes up four flights of stairs, and then vanished before she could even thank him. （读后续写·陌生善意·感动）

synonyms.example: The old fellow at the corner shop always slipped an extra sweet into the children's bags, asking nothing in return. （读后续写·温情·人物）
synonyms.usage: fellow 较 guy 更书面/略旧式，可带温情或轻微评价色彩；guy 更口语、中性、日常

synonyms.example: "He's a decent chap," the old gardener nodded, watching the boy return the lost wallet without a second thought. （读后续写·英式·品评人物）
synonyms.usage: chap 是英式口语，带亲切/略老派味道；guy 通行英美，更普遍更随意

synonyms.example: The bloke next door, gruff as he seemed, was the first to shovel snow from every doorstep on the street. （读后续写·外冷内热·邻里）
synonyms.usage: bloke 为英式俚语，专指男人，市井气浓；guy 更中性、国际通用，可指男性也可复数泛指众人

advancedExpressions.expression: a normal / ordinary guy 一个普通人 / a nice (good, great) guy 好人 / a tough guy 硬汉 / the good guy vs the bad guy 好人/坏人(故事角色) / you guys, hey guys 你们/各位(口语呼语)
advancedExpressions.example: He's just a normal guy, but a really nice guy at heart. 他不过是个普通人，但骨子里是个大好人。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·(口语)家伙/人（功能：可替换 guy）
advancedExpressions.expression: guy(通用·中性) / fellow(略书面旧式) / chap(英式亲切) / bloke(英式俚语·专指男人)；正式书面则用 man / person
advancedExpressions.example: That fellow at the corner shop is a decent chap. 街角小店那个人是个正派的好家伙。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·guys 作呼语，男女通用
advancedExpressions.expression: guys 复数作口语呼语时不分性别，可指一群人（含女生），常见于 hey guys / come on guys / you guys；单数 guy 才多指"男的"
advancedExpressions.example: "Come on, guys, let's finish this together!" “加油，各位，我们一起完成它！”

advancedExpressions.expression: all he longed for was to be just an ordinary guy again
advancedExpressions.example: All he longed for was to be just an ordinary guy again — to blend into the crowd, unremarkable and free, the way he had never valued until it was taken from him. （all sb longed for was 强调句式 + 破折号补充 + 对比 never valued）

advancedExpressions.expression: come on, guys — together we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Come on, guys — together we can turn this small idea into something our whole school will remember! （呼语 guys 拉近距离 + 破折号 + together we can 号召句，演讲/倡议高频）

advancedExpressions.expression: the quiet guy in the corner may carry the loudest courage of all
advancedExpressions.example: We too readily overlook the quiet guy in the corner, forgetting that the deepest courage often keeps the softest voice. （反直觉论断 + 对比 loudest courage / softest voice）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was happy he could go out like a normal guy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As he stepped into the bustling street and no one turned to stare, a lump rose in his throat — for the first time in a year he was simply another guy in the crowd, wonderfully, gloriously ordinary. （读后续写·重获平常·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 引导场景 + 生理细节(a lump rose in his throat) + 破折号点题 + 副词递进(wonderfully, gloriously) 强化情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: He is a good guy who always helps others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He is the sort of guy who never waits to be asked — who notices the classmate struggling in silence, and quietly offers a hand before anyone else has even looked up. （读后续写/人物刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the sort of guy who 定语从句刻画 + 破折号并列 who notices/offers + 细节动作(before anyone else looked up)烘托主动善良

classPractice.question:
他终于康复了，如今可以像个普通人一样出门了。
He has recovered at last and can now go out just ____ ____ ____ ____.（像个普通人一样）
classPractice.note: like 作介词表"像……一样"，后接名词短语 a normal guy。（课文原句）

classPractice.question: 从 guy / fellow / bloke 中选最口语、英美通用的词："Come on, ____s, we can do it!" the captain shouted.
classPractice.note: 呼语 guys 最口语、英美通用且男女不分；bloke 是英式俚语专指男人，fellow 偏书面旧式。

classPractice.question: 别再责怪对方了，先道歉的人才是真正的强者。（用 the other guy）
classPractice.answer: Stop blaming the other guy; the one who apologises first is the truly strong.
classPractice.note: the other guy 口语中指"对方、另一个人"，此处指争执中的另一方。

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural and that she is unable to make certain facial expressions.
readingExamples: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural and that she is unable to make certain facial expressions.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the process of adding two or more numbers or amounts together to find their total
(2) n. a thing that is added to something else to improve or complete it
(3) n. a person or thing that joins or becomes part of an existing group or collection
(4) n. the act of adding something to a larger thing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （房屋的）扩建部分，加建的房间
uncommonMeanings.example: The old farmhouse had grown organically over the decades, each addition telling the story of a new marriage, a new child, a new dream nailed onto the walls. （读后续写·家族记忆·空间叙事）

posExamples.sentence: When the shy transfer student finally set her tray down at our lunch table, none of us imagined what a wonderful addition she would become to our tight little circle of friends. （读后续写·友情·新成员融入）
I am writing to recommend the introduction of a reading corner to our library, an addition that I firmly believe would enrich the daily life of every student on campus. （应用文·建议信）
The addition of moral education to the core curriculum is not a luxury but a necessity, for knowledge without character is a ship without a rudder. （议论文·教育主题）
For young learners, mastering addition and subtraction is merely the first modest step on the long and winding road toward mathematical confidence. （议论文·学习成长）

wordForms.other: additive (n. 添加剂 / adj. 附加的)

idioms.example: In addition to organising the fundraiser, the volunteers spent the whole weekend repainting the shelter's weathered fence. （应用文·活动报道）

collocations.phrase: an addition / a worthy addition to
collocations.translation: 【课件】增添物；对……是一个很好的补充
collocations.example: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the Cambridge Encyclopedia series. 这是一本好书，对剑桥百科全书系列是一个很好的补充。（课件原句）
The latest addition of reference books will be of great help to the students. 新增加的参考书将对学生大有帮助。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be added to / add to sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】被新添到……；增加（= to increase the size, number, amount, etc.）
collocations.example: A huge sports complex will be added to the city. 一个巨大的体育综合体将新添到城市中。This latest incident will add to the pressure on the government. 最近的这次事件将会给政府增加压力。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】额外的 / 添加剂 / 此外（add 词族派生）
collocations.example: additional costs 额外的费用；food additives 食品添加剂；additionally = in addition 此外。（课件构词）

collocations.translation: 此外，另外（课文原句词块：In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural）
collocations.example: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural. 此外，爱德华兹小姐说手术让她看起来很不自然。
In addition to her dazzling academic record, what truly won our hearts was the quiet kindness she showed to every struggling classmate. （读后续写·人物刻画）
The newly opened rooftop garden proved a welcome addition to the crowded campus, offering weary students a rare pocket of green. （应用文·校园报道）
The stray kitten, a recent addition to our household, curled up on my grandfather's lap as if it had always belonged there. （读后续写·家庭温情）
Before submitting the proposal, the committee decided to make one final addition to the safety guidelines. （应用文·倡议书）
With the addition of two experienced coaches, our once-hopeless basketball team suddenly found a fighting spirit it had never known. （读后续写·励志·团队逆袭）
The teacher demonstrated how the total could be reached either by addition or by clever grouping. （议论文·数学思维）

collocations.translation: 家庭新成员（常指新生儿）
collocations.example: The whole village came bearing gifts to celebrate the newest addition to the family. （读后续写·乡村人情）

synonyms.example: This handbook is designed as a supplement to, not a replacement for, our regular classroom instruction. （应用文·说明文）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：supplement 强调“为使某物完整或更好而额外补充”，多用于书籍、饮食、收入等；addition 更中性，泛指“任何被加进来的东西”。

synonyms.example: The steady increase in library visitors this term reflects a heartening shift in students' reading habits. （议论文·数据论证）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：increase 侧重“数量/程度上的增大”，是一个动态过程；addition 侧重“加入某个具体事物”这一动作或结果。

synonyms.example: The new extension to the school hall finally provided enough seating for the entire graduating class. （应用文·校园通知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：extension 特指“在原有基础上向外延展、扩大”，尤指建筑或期限；表示“房屋加建”时可与 addition 互换，但 extension 更强调延伸感。

advancedExpressions.expression: add (v. 增加/加/补充说) → addition (n. 增加/增添物/加法) → additional (adj. 额外的) → additionally (adv. 此外) → additive(s) (n. 添加剂)
advancedExpressions.example: We need additional funding; additionally, the addition of two staff and no chemical additives would help. 我们需要额外资金；此外，增加两名员工且不加任何添加剂会有帮助。（课件词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: in addition 此外(句首独立) / in addition to + n./doing 除……之外 / a welcome (new) addition to 受欢迎的新增/新成员 / the addition of sth ……的加入 / make an addition to 对……增补
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to the library, the addition of a reading corner would be a welcome addition to campus. 除图书馆外，增设一个读书角会是校园里受欢迎的新添。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in addition vs in addition to
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition 作副词短语，独立用于句首/句中(后加逗号)；in addition to 是介词短语，后必须接名词/代词/doing，不能直接跟句子
advancedExpressions.example: In addition, he sings. = In addition to dancing, he sings. 除跳舞外，他还唱歌。

advancedExpressions.expression: prove (to be) a ... addition to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little did we know that the timid newcomer would prove the most treasured addition our team had ever welcomed. （Little did 倒装制造悬念 + 结尾情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the addition of ... would greatly ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely believe that the addition of a peer-tutoring scheme would greatly ease the pressure faced by first-year students. （建议信正式句式，the addition of 作主语显客观）

advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to A, B ... ; more importantly, ...
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to broadening our horizons, travel teaches humility; more importantly, it dissolves the prejudices that distance breeds. （递进式论证，两层展开+分号衔接）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A new girl joined our class and we liked her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The arrival of the new girl was, at first, just another name read out during roll call — yet within a fortnight she had become such a natural addition to our class that we could scarcely remember the empty seat she had filled. （读后续写·时间跨度+情感递进）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词作主语(The arrival of...) + 时间状语制造对比(at first...within a fortnight) + such...that 结果状语从句 + could scarcely remember 反衬融入之深

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should add a reading corner to the library.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my earnest hope that the school will consider the addition of a cosy reading corner to our library — a small change, perhaps, but one that could rekindle a love of books in even the most reluctant reader. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my earnest hope that... 委婉建议句式 + the addition of 名词化显正式 + 破折号补充说明 + 让步(perhaps)与升华(rekindle a love)结合

classPractice.type: 用适当形式填空（课件·add/addition词族）
classPractice.question: The latest ____ (add) reference books will be of great help to the students.（新增加的……）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】the addition of sth“……的增加/新增”，此处指“新增加的参考书”，用名词短语 addition of。

classPractice.question: 恶劣的天气增加了我们的困难。（用 add to）
classPractice.answer: The bad weather added to our difficulties.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】add to sth = to increase“增加、加重”，后接被增加之物，不可写成 add。

classPractice.question: The shy transfer student soon proved a wonderful ____ (add) to our tight little circle of friends.
classPractice.note: 空格前有冠词 a 和形容词 wonderful，需名词 addition"新成员、增添物"。

classPractice.question: In addition ____ raising money, the concert brought strangers together as friends. 填 to 还是不填？
classPractice.note: 此处后接动名词 raising，须用介词短语 in addition to + doing；若是 In addition, ... 独立成分则不加 to。

classPractice.question: 增设一个读书角会大大丰富每位学生的日常生活。（用 the addition of 作主语）
classPractice.answer: The addition of a reading corner would greatly enrich the daily life of every student.
classPractice.note: 用抽象名词短语 the addition of sth 作主语，语气客观正式，是建议信高级句式。

sub_section: Expressing your opinion about plastic surgery
original_sentence: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural and that she is unable to make certain facial expressions.
readingExamples: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural and that she is unable to make certain facial expressions.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. used to introduce another fact or piece of information that is relevant to what has just been said; also; besides
(2) adv. (in the form 'in addition to') as well as; over and above the thing already mentioned

posExamples.sentence: She had lost her way, her phone, and her last coin for the bus; in addition, a cold drizzle had begun to seep through her thin coat, turning a bad afternoon into a miserable one. （读后续写·困境叠加·氛围渲染）
The plan will beautify our neighbourhood; in addition, it will create part-time jobs for dozens of local students during the summer holidays. （应用文·倡议书）
Regular exercise strengthens the body; in addition, it sharpens the mind and steadies the emotions, making it indispensable to a balanced life. （议论文·健康主题）
In addition to raising a considerable sum for the orphanage, the charity concert brought together strangers who would remain friends for years to come. （读后续写·公益·意外收获）

collocations.translation: 【课件】此外，另外（引出补充信息，句首独立，后加逗号）
collocations.example: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural and that she is unable to make certain facial expressions. 此外，爱德华兹小姐说，手术使她看起来不自然，而且她无法做出某些面部表情。（课件原句）
In addition to his donation, Jack did lots of volunteer work for the community. 除了捐款，杰克还为社区做了大量志愿工作。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 此外，……（引出补充信息；课文原句词块：In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural）
collocations.example: In addition, Miss Edwards says the surgery makes her look unnatural. 此外，爱德华兹小姐说手术让她看起来不自然。

collocations.translation: 此外，另外（引出补充信息）
collocations.example: The volunteers cleaned the entire beach in a single morning. In addition, they sorted the collected waste into four neat categories for recycling. （应用文·活动报道）
In addition to comforting the frightened child, the firefighter carried out the family's elderly cat, earning a round of grateful applause. （读后续写·英雄形象）

collocations.phrase: in addition to the fact that
collocations.example: In addition to the fact that the policy saves energy, it also fosters a shared sense of responsibility among residents. （议论文·环保论证）

synonyms.example: The scheme is affordable; furthermore, it can be launched without any additional staff. （议论文·观点补充）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：furthermore 语气更正式、更书面，常用于议论文层层递进；in addition 通用性更强，口语与书面皆宜。

synonyms.example: It was far too late to turn back; besides, a strange curiosity now pulled her deeper into the fog. （读后续写·叙事推进）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：besides 常带“更何况、况且”的口语补充语气，可暗示前面的理由不是最关键的；in addition 更中性客观。

synonyms.example: The evidence is overwhelming; moreover, it comes from three independent studies. （议论文·加强论证）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：moreover 强调所补充的信息比前文更有分量、更进一层，语气最正式，适合议论文强力递进。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in addition vs in addition to（课件·高频易错）
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition = 副词短语（= also），独立作状语，置于句首/句中后加逗号，可直接连接前后两句；in addition to = 介词短语，后必接名词/代词/doing，不可接完整句子
advancedExpressions.example: He speaks French. In addition, he speaks English. = In addition to French, he speaks English. 除法语外，他还会英语。（课件辨析）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·递进衔接（功能：可替换 in addition，供写作升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition / besides / moreover / furthermore / what's more / additionally / on top of that 此外，而且（口语到正式递进：besides < what's more < in addition < moreover ≈ furthermore）
advancedExpressions.example: The plan is cheap; in addition (= besides / moreover / furthermore / what's more), it needs no extra staff. 这方案便宜；此外，它还无需额外人手。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in addition 用法要点
advancedExpressions.expression: In addition, + 完整句(句首独立) / in addition to + n./doing 除……之外 / in addition to the fact that + 句子 除了……这一事实之外
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to raising funds, the event made lasting friendships. 除筹款外，这次活动还结下了持久的友谊。

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and in addition, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The storm had knocked out the power, and in addition, the only road down the mountain now lay buried under a landslide. （用 in addition 层层加码,制造绝境感）

advancedExpressions.expression: In addition, it is worth noting that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In addition, it is worth noting that the campaign requires no extra budget, since all materials will be donated by local businesses. （补充可行性论据,增强说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: Not only ...; in addition, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not only does reading widen our vocabulary; in addition, it cultivates the patience and empathy that shallow scrolling can never provide. （Not only 部分倒装 + in addition 承接第二层论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was tired. He was also hungry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the time he reached the summit, exhaustion had drained the last of his strength; in addition, a gnawing hunger reminded him that he had not eaten since dawn. （读后续写·体力透支·细节渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By the time 时间状语从句铺垫 + 分号衔接两个困境 + in addition 引出叠加 + gnawing hunger 拟人化细节 + since dawn 时间锚点

sentenceUpgrade.original: The project helps the environment. It also saves money.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The proposed project would significantly reduce our school's carbon footprint; in addition, the energy saved each term could fund a new set of scholarships for students in need. （应用文·倡议书·双重益处）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: would 虚拟语气显礼貌 + 分号并列两大益处 + in addition 引出第二层 + could fund 具体化收益,让论证落地

classPractice.type: 用适当形式填空（课件·辨析in addition/in addition to）
classPractice.question: ____ some picture books, we still need some storybooks.（除……之外，还）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】后接名词 some picture books，须用介词短语 in addition to + n.；若独立作状语则用 In addition, ...。

classPractice.type: 用适当形式填空（课件·辨析in addition/in addition to）
classPractice.question: My grandma gave us sandwiches for our picnic and a bag of cookies ____.（此外，另外）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】句末独立作状语，意为“另外、此外”，不接宾语，故用 in addition。

classPractice.type: 用适当形式填空（课件·辨析in addition/in addition to）
classPractice.question: He had no time to prepare this lecture; ____, he was unwell.（此外）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】分号后引出补充理由，独立作状语，用 in addition“此外”。

classPractice.type: 用适当形式填空（课件·辨析in addition/in addition to）
classPractice.question: He speaks French ____ English.（除……外还）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】后接名词 English，表“除英语外还（会法语）”，用介词短语 in addition to + n.。

classPractice.question: The plan will beautify our neighbourhood. In ____, it will create part-time jobs for local students.
classPractice.note: in addition"此外"是固定副词短语，独立置于句首，后加逗号引出补充信息。（课文原句衔接结构）

classPractice.question: In addition ____ organising the fundraiser, the volunteers repainted the fence.（填 to 还是不填）
classPractice.note: 后接动名词 organising，须用介词短语 in addition to + doing；若独立作状语 In addition, ... 则不加 to。

classPractice.question: 用 in addition 改写：The scheme is affordable, and it also needs no extra staff. → The scheme is affordable. ____ ____, it needs no extra staff.
classPractice.note: in addition 可替换 and ... also，作独立衔接副词引出第二点，同义词还有 moreover / furthermore / besides。

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: "Don't judge a book by its cover," the old saying goes.
readingExamples: "Don't judge a book by its cover," the old saying goes.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a well-known and wise statement that gives advice about life or expresses a commonly held belief; a proverb
(2) n. a phrase or short expression that people often use
(3) n. (from 'say') the act of stating something in words

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （go without saying 结构中）不言而喻的事
uncommonMeanings.example: That she had risked everything for the very people who once mocked her went almost without saying — yet saying it aloud, at last, brought tears to every eye in the hall. （读后续写·情感高潮·点破无声之义）

posExamples.sentence: As my grandmother tucked me in, she whispered an old saying that has echoed in my heart ever since: 'The night is darkest just before the dawn.' （读后续写·亲情·祖辈智慧）
There is a saying that 'a small leak will sink a great ship', which is exactly why I am writing to remind every resident to check their taps before leaving home. （应用文·倡议书）
The ancient saying 'Haste makes waste' still rings true in our fast-paced age, warning us that genuine achievement is rarely the child of impatience. （议论文·处世哲理）
As the saying goes, 'Actions speak louder than words'; therefore, let us prove our commitment to the planet not by slogans but by daily deeds. （议论文·环保呼吁）

wordForms.other: said (adj. 上述的)

idioms.example: As the saying goes, 'Where there is a will, there is a way' — and Lucy's will, that stormy night, proved unbreakable. （读后续写·励志·引谚增色）
