Cut off from screens for a week, the students finally opened their eyes to the beauty of nature that had surrounded them all along. （读后续写·成长·顿悟）
It is inner beauty, not fashionable clothes, that leaves a lasting impression on those we meet. （议论文·价值观）
The hidden waterfall soon became a beauty spot beloved by every visitor to the region. （应用文·旅游推介）

collocations.phrase: admire / appreciate the beauty of sth
collocations.example: She paused on the bridge to admire the beauty of the reflected lanterns trembling on the water below. （读后续写·夜景·细节）
Everyone agreed the bride was a real beauty on her wedding day. （beauty 作可数名词表“美人/绝品”）
The school play, a lively version of Beauty and the Beast, drew the loudest applause of the whole evening. （应用文·活动报道）
The advertisement promised that its new beauty product could erase ten years overnight — a claim too good to be true. （议论文·消费主义·批判）

synonyms.example: It was not her looks but her easy charm that filled the little café with laughter every evening. （读后续写·人物·亲和力）
synonyms.usage: 侧重吸引人的气质、魅力，可指人或地方；beauty 侧重外表或事物令人愉悦的美感，续写写魅力用 charm 更传神

synonyms.example: She moved across the ballroom with an elegance that turned every head, though she seemed entirely unaware of it. （读后续写·气质·画面）
synonyms.usage: 强调优雅、有品位的美（举止、风格、设计）；beauty 更宽泛，elegance 特指精致而不张扬的美

synonyms.example: From the summit they gazed down upon the ancient city in all its golden splendour. （读后续写·壮景·升华）
synonyms.usage: 指宏伟壮丽、令人惊叹的美（宫殿、山河、盛景），正式且气势磅礴；beauty 更日常、更柔和

advancedExpressions.expression: standards of beauty / natural beauty / inner (true) beauty / the beauty of nature / a beauty spot
advancedExpressions.example: Standards of beauty in the media matter far less than the inner beauty of a kind heart. （课文搭配 + beauty 短语群）

advancedExpressions.expression: beauty = charm = elegance = splendour = loveliness
advancedExpressions.example: The valley's beauty / splendour left the hikers speechless. （功能：表“美”，语体与侧重不同，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: beauty (n.) → beautiful (adj.) → beautifully (adv.) → beautify (v.) → beautician (n. 美容师)
advancedExpressions.example: The gardener beautified the yard so beautifully that its beauty drew crowds. （beauty 名/形/副/动/派生一族）

advancedExpressions.expression: a beauty so ... that sb. could hardly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before them lay a beauty so breathtaking that the exhausted climbers could hardly believe such a place existed outside of dreams. （a beauty so...that 结果状语 + 心理反应 could hardly believe，收束景物描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: you will be captivated by the beauty of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I promise you will be captivated by the beauty of our ancient town, where every winding lane tells a story of a thousand years. （you will be captivated by 承诺式感染力 + where 定语从句添画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: genuine beauty lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Genuine beauty lies not in a flawless appearance but in the courage to be kind in a world that rewards indifference. （lies not in...but in 否定对比 + in a world that 定语从句深化立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The mountains were very beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Wrapped in the soft gold of dawn, the mountains revealed a beauty so serene that even the noisiest child among them fell silent, sensing they had stumbled upon something sacred. （读后续写·自然·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语(Wrapped in...)营造氛围 + a beauty so serene that 结果从句 + sensing 分词伴随心理 + sacred 升华意境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Inner beauty is more important than looks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that inner beauty — the beauty of compassion, honesty, and quiet strength — far outlasts the fleeting charm of a pretty face, for it grows richer with every passing year. （议论文·价值观）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + 破折号列举(compassion, honesty, quiet strength)具象化抽象概念 + far outlasts 对比 + for 引导原因收束

classPractice.question: ____ ____ beauty in the media can have a big influence on what you think of your physical appearance. （补全课文原句：审美标准）
classPractice.note: standards of beauty“审美标准”，standard 常用复数；of 引出所修饰对象。

classPractice.question: It is inner ____ (beauty / beautiful), not fashionable clothes, that leaves a lasting impression. （选名词形式）
classPractice.note: inner 后接名词 beauty“内在美”；beautiful 是形容词，不能作此处主语。

classPractice.question: 情人眼里出西施。（用 beauty 相关谚语）
classPractice.answer: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
classPractice.note: 谚语 beauty is in the eye of the beholder 意为“美是主观的、情人眼里出西施”。

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle—these standards are simply impossible for most of the population to live up to.
readingExamples: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle—these standards are simply impossible for most of the population to live up to.
definitionEn:
(1) idiom to try hard to do something that is almost certain to fail, or to struggle against something you cannot overcome
(2) idiom to keep making an effort in a situation where success is highly unlikely, despite the odds being against you

posExamples.sentence: For hours the small crew fought a losing battle against the rising water, bailing with buckets and bare hands, until at last one of them dropped his pail and simply began to pray. （读后续写·灾难·绝境）
I fear that without your support, our campaign to save the old library is fighting a losing battle, and I sincerely hope you will lend us your voice before it is too late. （应用文·呼吁信）
Those who try to preserve tradition by resisting all change are fighting a losing battle; the wiser course is to let the old and the new grow gracefully into one another. （议论文·传统与变革·论证）
Day after day she fought a losing battle with her own memory, and it broke her son's heart to be greeted, each morning, as a kindly stranger. （读后续写·亲情·病痛）

idioms.translation: 打一场注定失败的仗；做无望取胜的努力
idioms.example: Trying to keep the beach clean single-handedly, the old man knew he was fighting a losing battle, yet every dawn found him back among the drifting rubbish, refusing to give in. （读后续写·坚守·平凡英雄）
Even in a losing battle, she fought tooth and nail for every inch of ground, and her defiance alone inspired the others to keep going. （读后续写·抗争·精神）

collocations.example: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle. 试图模仿偶像外貌的青少年是在打一场注定失败的仗。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: standards of beauty in the media
collocations.example: These standards of beauty in the media are simply impossible for most people to live up to. 媒体的审美标准是大多数人根本不可能达到的。（课件）

collocations.translation: 在打一场必败之仗，做无望取胜的努力（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle. 试图模仿偶像外貌的青少年是在打一场注定失败的仗。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: fight a losing battle against sth
collocations.example: The firefighters fought a losing battle against the raging flames as the wind turned mercilessly against them. （读后续写·火灾·危机）

collocations.phrase: seem to be fighting a losing battle
collocations.translation: 似乎在打一场必败的仗
collocations.example: By midnight the doctors seemed to be fighting a losing battle, yet none of them was willing to be the first to stop trying. （读后续写·医院·坚持）

collocations.phrase: fight a losing battle with time
collocations.translation: 与时间赛跑却注定失败
collocations.example: The rescue team was fighting a losing battle with time, for every minute buried the trapped miners deeper in silence. （读后续写·救援·紧迫）

collocations.translation: 打一场艰难的仗（近义搭配）
collocations.example: The young reformer knew she faced an uphill battle, but a difficult fight was not the same as a hopeless one. （议论文·改革·信念）
Even while fighting a losing battle, he refused to admit defeat, and it was this stubborn hope that others would remember long after the outcome was forgotten. （读后续写·精神·升华）

synonyms.translation: 无望的事业，注定失败之事
synonyms.example: His friends called it a hopeless cause, but he replied that some causes are worth losing for. （议论文·理想主义·观点）
synonyms.usage: 名词短语，指注定失败的目标或事业；fight a losing battle 是动词性表达，强调抗争的过程与徒劳

synonyms.translation: 艰苦的斗争，困难重重之事
synonyms.example: Learning a new language at fifty was an uphill battle, yet she climbed it word by stubborn word. （读后续写·励志·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 指困难但仍有希望取胜的斗争；fight a losing battle 则强调几乎注定失败，语气更悲观，两者差别在于胜算

synonyms.example: Trying to convince him after his mind was made up was like flogging a dead horse. （应用文·劝说·无效）
synonyms.usage: 口语色彩浓，指做已无意义的事；fight a losing battle 更书面、更悲壮，可用于严肃叙事与议论

advancedExpressions.expression: fight a losing battle / an uphill battle / a hopeless cause
advancedExpressions.example: fight a losing battle 打必败之仗（几乎注定失败）；fight an uphill battle 打艰难的仗（难但仍有胜算）；a hopeless cause 无望的事业（名词，指目标本身注定失败）。

advancedExpressions.expression: fight a losing battle ≈ flog a dead horse ≈ beat one's head against a brick wall
advancedExpressions.example: 三者都可表"做徒劳无益的事"，可互换指白费力气；fight a losing battle 更书面悲壮，flog a dead horse 更口语。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·who 引导的定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: Teens who try to copy... are fighting a losing battle
advancedExpressions.example: 课文用 who 引导定语从句修饰先行词 Teens，从句谓语 try 与主句谓语 are fighting 分层，是高考定从考点。

advancedExpressions.expression: though sb. was fighting a losing battle, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though she was fighting a losing battle, she fought it with such grace that defeat itself began to look like a kind of victory. （though 让步从句 + such...that 结果结构 + defeat looked like victory 悖论升华，赞颂虽败犹荣）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cannot let ... fight this losing battle alone
advancedExpressions.example: We cannot let our teachers fight this losing battle against outdated facilities alone; the time for our community to act is now. （we cannot let sb. do 呼吁句式 + the time for...is now 紧迫收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: to fight a losing battle is not always to lose
advancedExpressions.example: To fight a losing battle is not always to lose, for the courage displayed in defeat can outshine the glory of easy triumph. （不定式作主语 + not always 弱化否定 + for 引导原因，辩证提升立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They tried to save the boat but knew they would fail.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Knowing full well they were fighting a losing battle, the sailors bailed on through the night, their arms leaden and their hopes thinning with every wave that crashed over the deck. （读后续写·海难·坚持）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语(Knowing full well)前置 + fighting a losing battle 习语 + their arms leaden 独立主格 + 隐喻(hopes thinning) 情感递减

sentenceUpgrade.original: Fighting against progress is useless.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It should be evident to any thoughtful observer that those who set themselves against the tide of progress are fighting a losing battle, and would be far wiser to steer its currents than to be swept aside by them. （议论文·变革·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It should be evident to 客观化主句 + set themselves against the tide 比喻 + fight a losing battle 习语 + steer...than be swept aside 对比+比喻收束

classPractice.question: 试图模仿偶像外貌的青少年是在打一场注定失败的仗。Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are ____ a ____ battle.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；fight a losing battle 打必败之仗，此处用现在进行时

classPractice.question: Persuading him to change his mind once it was made up felt like fighting a ____ battle.
classPractice.note: fight a losing battle 徒劳的努力；losing 作定语表"注定输的"

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (losing / uphill)：Learning to ski at sixty is an ____ battle, hard but far from hopeless.
classPractice.note: uphill battle 难但有望取胜；losing battle 几乎注定失败，据 far from hopeless 定 uphill

translation: 【课件】达到，不辜负（他人的期望）；名副其实
sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle—these standards are simply impossible for most of the population to live up to.
readingExamples: Teens who try to copy the looks of their favourite stars are fighting a losing battle—these standards are simply impossible for most of the population to live up to.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to be as good as what was expected, promised, or hoped for
(2) phr. v. to behave in the way that a particular standard, reputation, or principle requires
(3) phr. v. to succeed in doing as well as people expect, especially in fulfilling a reputation or a promise

posExamples.sentence: The moment she picked up the violin, every doubt in the crowded hall melted away — the shy country girl had, against all odds, lived up to the impossible reputation that rumour had built around her. （读后续写·比赛·逆袭）
I promise that our team will do everything in our power to live up to the trust the school has placed in us as this year's volunteer organisers. （应用文·承诺信）
A society that constantly pressures teenagers to live up to unrealistic images of success may unwittingly rob them of the very confidence such success requires. （议论文·青少年心理·论证）
For years the boy had struggled to live up to the memory of his celebrated father, until one quiet afternoon he realised he had only ever needed to become himself. （读后续写·成长·自我认同）

collocations.translation: 【课件】达到，不辜负（他人的期望）= do as good as people expect you to
collocations.example: He failed to live up to his parents' expectations. 他没能达到父母的期望。（课件）
The team called 'The No-Hopers' certainly lived up to its name. 那支叫"无望队"的球队果然名副其实。（课件）

collocations.phrase: be impossible for sb to live up to
collocations.translation: 是某人不可能达到的（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: These standards are simply impossible for most of the population to live up to. 这些标准是大多数人根本不可能达到的。（课文原句）
The long-awaited sequel more than lived up to expectations, leaving fans cheering in the aisles. （应用文·影评）
The little restaurant certainly lived up to its reputation; one bite of the dumplings and the travellers understood why the queue stretched around the block. （读后续写·美食·惊喜）
The mountain, aptly called 'Cloud's Rest', lived up to its name, its peak forever wrapped in drifting mist. （读后续写·景物·呼应）
Every product must live up to the highest safety standards before it ever reaches a customer's hands. （应用文·说明·质量）
He had made her a promise on that rainy platform years ago, and now, at last, he had come home to live up to it. （读后续写·守诺·团圆）

collocations.phrase: live up to the trust / faith placed in sb
collocations.example: The young captain vowed to live up to the faith his teammates had placed in him, whatever the final score might be. （读后续写·体育·担当）
When the celebrated author's new book failed to live up to the hype, critics were quick and unforgiving. （议论文·舆论·观点）

synonyms.example: The hotel exceeded rather than merely met their expectations, and the family left already planning to return. （应用文·点评）
synonyms.usage: 中性、常用，meet expectations/standards；live up to 更强调不负期望、承受压力后达标，带情感与考验意味

synonyms.translation: 履行，实现（诺言/责任/潜力）
synonyms.example: By coaching the children every weekend, she quietly fulfilled a promise she had made to her late teacher. （读后续写·践诺·感恩）
synonyms.usage: 侧重完成、兑现（承诺、职责、潜力）；live up to 更强调达到外界或自身设定的高标准/名声，含被评判之意

synonyms.translation: 达到（某人/某标准的）水准
synonyms.example: He feared he would never measure up to his brilliant elder sister, until a wise teacher taught him to run his own race. （读后续写·自卑·成长）
synonyms.usage: 常用于比较、够不够格（measure up to sb/expectations），略含忐忑；与 live up to 意义相近，但更突出'比较后是否合格'

advancedExpressions.expression: live up to expectations / one's reputation / one's name / a promise / the trust placed in sb
advancedExpressions.example: live up to 后接期望、名声、承诺、信任等抽象标准，表"达到、不辜负"；注意是不及物动词短语，后须直接跟宾语，无被动 be lived up to 的常见用法。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·达到/不辜负
advancedExpressions.expression: live up to ≈ meet ≈ fulfil ≈ measure up to
advancedExpressions.example: 四者都可表"达到期望/标准"：meet 最中性，fulfil 侧重兑现承诺潜力，measure up to 强调比较后是否合格，live up to 强调承受压力、被评判后达标。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·动副短语 live + up + to
advancedExpressions.expression: live up to sth（三词固定短语动词）
advancedExpressions.example: 三词一体不可拆，宾语须置于 to 之后：live up to it（不能说 live it up to）；对比 live it up 尽情享乐，含义完全不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment, sb. finally lived up to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment, standing tall before the silent crowd, he finally lived up to the man his father had always believed he could become. （时间状语 in that moment + 分词状语描绘姿态 + lived up to + 定语从句寄托期望，升华成长主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am confident that I can live up to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am confident that, given this opportunity, I can live up to and even surpass the responsibilities of the post. （I am confident that 自信句式 + live up to and even surpass 递进，申请信表决心）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should be judged not by ... but by whether we live up to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should be judged not by the promises we make in comfort but by whether we live up to them in the face of hardship. （not by...but by 对比结构 + whether we live up to 名词性从句，论证言行一致）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was as good as everyone had hoped.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the final note faded into a stunned silence, it was clear to every soul in that hall that the girl had not merely met but gloriously lived up to the legend that had preceded her. （读后续写·演出·高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 引导时间从句渲染氛围(faded into stunned silence) + it was clear to every soul 强调 + not merely...but gloriously 递进 + the legend that had preceded her 定语从句铺垫

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must keep our promises.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that the true measure of a person lies not in the grand promises he utters, but in his unwavering resolve to live up to them when it is hardest to do so. （议论文·诚信·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + the true measure of...lies not in...but in 对比句式 + unwavering resolve 抽象名词 + when it is hardest 让步收束

classPractice.question: 他没能达到父母的期望。He failed to ____ ____ ____ his parents' expectations.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；live up to expectations 达到/不辜负期望

classPractice.question: 那支叫"无望队"的球队果然名副其实。The team called 'The No-Hopers' certainly ____ ____ ____ its ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；live up to its name 名副其实；一般过去时

classPractice.question: 这些标准是大多数人根本不可能达到的。These standards are simply impossible for most of the population to ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；不定式 to live up to 作状语，主动形式表被动含义（standards...to live up to）

classPractice.question: The new coach promised to ____ ____ ____ the fans' high expectations by the end of the season.
classPractice.note: live up to expectations 不负期望；三词固定搭配

classPractice.question: The film was as good as everyone had hoped. → The film ____ ____ ____ everyone's hopes.
classPractice.note: was as good as...had hoped = lived up to（达到期望）；一般过去时

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: They will only end up feeling worse about themselves.
readingExamples: They will only end up feeling worse about themselves.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to finally be in a particular place, state, or situation, especially without having planned it
(2) phr. v. to reach a certain condition or result after a process or series of events
(3) phr. v. to eventually do something, often after other things have happened first (end up doing sth)

posExamples.sentence: What had begun as a simple shortcut through the woods ended up as the most terrifying night of their young lives, lost among trees that all looked exactly the same. （读后续写·迷路·转折）
If we do not act now to reduce waste on campus, we may well end up drowning in the very rubbish we so casually throw away. （应用文·倡议书·警示）
Students who chase every fleeting trend without a clear goal often end up mastering nothing, for a mind pulled in all directions arrives nowhere. （议论文·专注·论证）
He had set out that morning meaning only to buy bread, yet through a chain of small kindnesses he ended up carrying a stranger's groceries all the way across town. （读后续写·善意·意外）

collocations.translation: 【课件】最终成为，最终处于（做某事）
collocations.example: I ended up doing all the work myself. 结果所有活儿都是我一个人干的。（课件）
If you go on like this you'll end up in prison. 你要是再这样下去，最终会进监狱的。（课件）
If he carries on driving like that, he'll end up dead. 他要是继续那样开车，最终会送命的。（课件）
The medicine conference ended up with the Chairman's speech. 这次医学会议以主席的讲话结束。（课件）
If we neglect our future, we'll end up as failures. 如果我们忽视未来，最终会一事无成。（课件）
The government must put an end to the violence at once. 政府必须立即制止这场暴力。（课件）
As all good things must, the summer holiday finally came to an end. 一切美好都有尽头，暑假终于结束了。（课件）
I was worried she would walk out or bring the interview to an end. 我担心她会走出去或者把面试终止掉。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: call for an end to sth
collocations.example: The French government today called for an end to the violence. 法国政府今天呼吁结束暴力。（课件）
If we neglect our future, we'll end up in failure. 如果我们忽视未来，最终会以失败收场。（课件）
It rained for days on end, and the river swelled until it lapped at the doorsteps. 大雨连下了好几天，河水暴涨，一直漫到门口。（课件义项）

collocations.phrase: by the end of / at the end of
collocations.example: By the end of the year the little shop had, at the end of a long struggling street, become a local favourite. 到年底时，那家开在一条挣扎求生的街道尽头的小店已成了当地人的最爱。（课件）
Take a single wrong turn here and you could end up in a part of the city few tourists ever see. （应用文·旅行提示）
Once the class clown, he ended up as a respected professor, proof that a playful mind and a serious purpose can share the same person. （读后续写·励志·反差）
Those who cut corners to save time often end up with far more work than they started with. （议论文·踏实做事）
Determined not to end up like the idle men who lounged outside the tavern, the young farmer worked from first light to last. （读后续写·志气·对比）

collocations.translation: 最终一贫如洗／无家可归／孤身一人
collocations.example: The film warns that a life built on greed alone may end up empty and alone, however full the bank account. （议论文·价值观·论证）
No matter how the day begins, our long walks always end up at the same little bench by the river. （读后续写·温情·习惯）

synonyms.translation: 最终落得，结果变成（非正式）
synonyms.example: After a string of odd jobs across three countries, he wound up running a small bookshop in his hometown, happier than he had ever imagined. （读后续写·人生·归宿）
synonyms.usage: 与 end up 几乎同义，口语色彩更浓；两者常可互换，正式写作中 end up 更稳妥，wind up 更随意

synonyms.example: The stranger everyone had feared turned out to be the gentlest soul in the whole village. （读后续写·反转·善意）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'结果证明/原来是'，常接 to be / that 从句，强调真相揭晓；end up 侧重经过一系列过程后到达某结局/位置

synonyms.translation: 导致，结果是（正式，主语是原因）
synonyms.example: Years of careless deforestation resulted in the very floods the villagers now fear each spring. （议论文·因果·论证）
synonyms.usage: 正式、书面，主语通常是'原因'，后接结果；end up 主语通常是'人/事物本身'最终的处境，二者视角不同

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·end 短语群（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: end (up) with / end (up) as / put an end to / come to an end / bring... to an end / by the end of / at the end of / end in sth / on end / call for an end to
advancedExpressions.example: 课件 end 短语群：end (up) with 以…结束；end (up) as 最后成为；put an end to 使终止；come to an end 结束了；bring...to an end 使终止；by the end of 到…结束时；at the end of 到…尽头；end in sth 以…收场；on end 连续地；call for an end to 呼吁结束…。

advancedExpressions.expression: end up doing sth / end up + adj. / end up in-at (a place) / end up as sth / end up with sth / end up like sb
advancedExpressions.example: end up 后可接：动名词(end up feeling worse)、形容词(end up alone)、介词短语(end up in prison / as a doctor / with nothing / like his father)；核心考点是 end up doing，绝不接 to do。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·最终成为/结果是
advancedExpressions.expression: end up ≈ wind up ≈ turn out ≈ result in
advancedExpressions.example: end up 侧重经过一系列过程到达某结局；wind up 口语近义可换；turn out 侧重"结果证明是"接 to be/that；result in 主语是原因，视角相反。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·end up doing（V-ing 作宾语）
advancedExpressions.expression: They will only end up feeling worse about themselves.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：end up 后必跟动名词 feeling，不用不定式；only 强调"到头来只会"。高考语法填空常考 end up (do)→doing。

advancedExpressions.expression: what had started as ... ended up as ...
advancedExpressions.example: What had started as an ordinary Tuesday ended up as the day that would change the course of her entire life. （what had started as...ended up as 对比句式 + the day that would change 定语从句，制造命运感）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we fail to ..., we will end up ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we fail to protect our rivers today, we will end up leaving our children a poisoned inheritance and an unpardonable regret. （if 条件句 + will end up doing 后果 + an unpardonable regret 情感强化，倡议警示力度）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who ... often end up ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who value shortcuts over honest effort often end up paying, in the long run, a far higher price than they ever sought to avoid. （those who 泛指主语 + often end up doing + in the long run 插入语，因果论证辩证有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They got lost and ended up in a strange village.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One wrong turn led to another, and by nightfall the exhausted travellers ended up in a strange, silent village where not a single window showed a welcoming light. （读后续写·迷路·氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: One wrong turn led to another 因果链 + by nightfall 时间推进 + ended up in + where 定语从句(not a single...light)营造孤寂氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: If you waste time, you will fail.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It should be clear to us all that those who squander their youth on idle pleasures will, sooner or later, end up mourning the very years they once thought endless. （议论文·惜时·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It should be clear to us all 客观化主句 + squander their youth 动词升级 + sooner or later 插入语 + end up mourning + the very years 强调 + 定语从句反讽收束

classPractice.question: Some people tried many ways to lose weight, ending up ____ (gain) weight soon again.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；end up doing sth 后接动名词，此处 gaining

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (as / with / in)：If we neglect our future, we'll end up ____ failure as what happens to the man in the picture.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；end up in failure 以失败收场（end in / end up in sth 以……收场）

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (as / with / in)：The medicine conference ended up ____ the Chairman's speech.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；end (up) with sth 以……结束

classPractice.question: They will only end up ____ (feel) worse about themselves.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；end up doing sth，后接动名词，不用 to do

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (as / with / in)：After years of hard work, the shy intern ended up ____ the company's chief designer.
classPractice.note: end up as sth 最终成为某身份；end up with 得到某物，end up in 到某地

classPractice.question: 如果我们现在不采取行动，最终只会后悔。(end up)  → If we don't take action now, we will only ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: end up doing sth；regret 后接动名词 regretting，双重考点

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow.
readingExamples: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a popular style of clothes, hair, behaviour, etc. at a particular time; the business of making and selling clothes
(2) n. the way in which something is made or done; a manner of doing something
(3) vt. to make or shape something, especially with your hands or a few tools
(4) n. (after 'in ... fashion') a particular way or manner of behaving

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 方式,样子（熟词僻义，常见于 in a ... fashion 以…的方式 / after a fashion 勉强凑合）
uncommonMeanings.example: He answered the reporters' questions in a calm, measured fashion, as though nothing in the world could shake the quiet confidence he had earned. （读后续写·人物·从容）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (用手工)制作,塑造
uncommonMeanings.example: With nothing but a rusty knife and endless patience, the old fisherman fashioned a tiny wooden boat for his grandson, carving into it every story the sea had ever told him. （读后续写·祖孙·手艺·温情）

posExamples.sentence: She had never cared for fashion, yet the moment she slipped into her late mother's faded blue coat, she felt wrapped in something far warmer than any label money could ever buy. （读后续写·亲情·物是人非）

I am writing to invite you to our school's charity fashion show, where every outfit on the runway has been redesigned from recycled clothes to remind us that beauty need not cost the earth. （应用文·邀请信·环保）

In my opinion, blindly chasing fashion often costs teenagers not only their money but also their sense of self, for true confidence springs from character rather than from the logo on one's jacket. （议论文·青少年消费观）
Marooned on the island, he fashioned a fishing spear from a broken branch and a shard of stone, and in that small triumph he began, at last, to believe he might survive. （读后续写·荒岛·求生）

wordForms.other: unfashionable / old-fashioned

idioms.translation: 勉强,凑合(算是……但不太好)
idioms.example: He could play the piano after a fashion — enough to fill the quiet evenings, though never enough to still the longing for the teacher he had lost. （读后续写·遗憾·怀念）
The rescue was carried out in a swift and orderly fashion, and within the hour every trapped miner had been lifted safely into the daylight. （读后续写·救援·高效）

idioms.idiom: come into / go out of fashion
idioms.example: Handwritten letters may have gone out of fashion, yet nothing digital can ever match the warmth of ink pressed by a loving hand. （议论文·科技与情感）

collocations.translation: 有很好的时尚品味／穿衣审美（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow. 如果你的朋友长得好看或很有时尚品味，你会感觉活在他们的阴影里。（课文原句）
It was not her wealth but her effortless fashion sense that made the whole classroom fall silent whenever she walked through the door. （读后续写·人物出场·气场）
Rather than chasing the latest fashion every season, she learned to treasure a few well-made pieces that never seemed to age. （议论文·理性消费）
The wide trousers her grandmother once wore were suddenly back in fashion, and the girl wore them proudly, feeling two generations meet in a single outfit. （读后续写·代际·传承）

collocations.translation: 以……的方式（熟词僻义，=in a ... way/manner）
collocations.example: The volunteers cleared the debris in a swift and orderly fashion. 志愿者们迅速而有序地清理了废墟。
Too many young people follow fashion so blindly that they forget clothes should serve the person, not the person serve the clothes. （议论文·价值观）
Our school is holding a fashion show next Friday to raise money for children in remote mountain areas, and we sincerely hope you can join us. （应用文·通知）
The fashion industry, critics argue, produces mountains of waste each year, and it is high time both designers and shoppers rethought what we truly need. （议论文·环保）
Once a shy village girl who sketched dresses on scrap paper, she is now a celebrated fashion designer whose gowns grace the world's greatest stages. （读后续写·励志·逆袭）
A single change of fashion can turn last year's must-have coat into this year's forgotten rag, which is exactly why chasing trends is a race no one ever wins. （议论文·消费主义）

synonyms.example: Her writing had a style all its own, plain yet piercing, the kind of voice you would recognise even without a name on the page. （读后续写·个性）
synonyms.usage: 侧重个人独有的、较稳定的'风格',可用于穿着、写作、言谈;fashion 更强调一时流行、随时代变化的潮流

synonyms.example: A growing trend among students is to swap old books instead of buying new ones, a small habit that saves money and trees alike. （议论文·环保/社会现象）
synonyms.usage: 指某种正在发展的'趋势/走向',范围比 fashion 广,不限于服饰;fashion 特指服装及外表方面的流行

synonyms.example: He spoke in such a gentle manner that even the angriest customer soon lowered his voice. （读后续写·人物·修养）
synonyms.usage: 在'方式'义上与 fashion(in a ... fashion)相近,但 manner 更常用、更口语,还可指'举止/礼貌';fashion 表'方式'时偏书面

advancedExpressions.expression: have a great fashion sense / in fashion / out of fashion / come into fashion / go out of fashion / in a ... fashion / after a fashion
advancedExpressions.example: "时尚"义：in / out of fashion 流行/过时，fashion sense 时尚品味；"方式"义（熟词僻义）：in a swift fashion 以迅速的方式，after a fashion 勉强凑合。

advancedExpressions.expression: fashion ≈ trend ≈ style ≈ vogue（时尚义）; in a ... fashion ≈ in a ... way ≈ in a ... manner（方式义）
advancedExpressions.example: 时尚义：fashion 一时流行、随时代变，style 是稳定个人风格，trend 是趋势；方式义 in a...fashion 可与 in a...way/manner 互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: fashion → fashionable(adj.时髦的) → fashionably(adv.) → unfashionable(过时的) → old-fashioned(老式的)
advancedExpressions.example: fashion + able = fashionable 时髦的；前缀 un- 表否定 unfashionable；old-fashioned 是形容词，意为"老派的、过时的"。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was not ... but sb.'s ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not her fashion but her fearless kindness that drew people to her, the way lost travellers are drawn to a single lit window in the dark. （强调句+比喻,凸显内在美胜过外表）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a ... fashion
advancedExpressions.example: If each of us disposes of waste in a responsible fashion, our campus can stay clean without any extra cost or effort. （in a ... fashion 表方式,倡议书正式而简洁）

advancedExpressions.expression: to chase fashion is to ...; to cultivate character is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To chase fashion is to run after a shadow that shifts with every season; to cultivate character is to build a house no changing wind can shake. （对偶+比喻,深化'外表 vs 内在'的论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She had good fashion sense and looked beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With an effortless fashion sense that turned even a plain grey scarf into a statement, she moved through the crowded hall like a quiet flame, and heads turned one by one without quite knowing why. （读后续写·人物出场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 独立结构补细节 + turned...into a statement 夸张烘托品味 + like a quiet flame 比喻 + without quite knowing why 留白制造气场

sentenceUpgrade.original: Young people should not follow fashion blindly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time young people stopped following fashion blindly, for the truest elegance, as any wise soul knows, is not stitched into a designer label but woven into how one thinks, speaks and treats others. （议论文·青少年价值观）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time sb. did...虚拟语气呼吁 + for 引出理由 + as any wise soul knows 插入语增势 + not...but...对照 + 三动词排比(thinks, speaks, treats)

classPractice.question: 如果你的朋友长得好看或很有时尚品味……If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great ____ ____, it can feel like you are living in their shadow.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；fashion sense 时尚品味，have a great fashion sense 固定搭配

classPractice.question: The old song has come back ____ fashion and now everyone is humming it again.
classPractice.note: come into fashion 开始流行；对比 go out of fashion 过时

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (fashion / way)，本题用 fashion：The rescue was carried out in a swift and orderly ____.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义 in a ... fashion = 以…的方式，等于 in a ... way；此处考 fashion 表"方式"

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow.
readingExamples: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a dark shape that appears on a surface when someone or something is between the light and that surface
(2) n. an area of darkness caused by something blocking the light
(3) n. a slight amount or trace of something; the influence of something powerful or oppressive
(4) vt. to follow someone closely and secretly in order to watch them

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】跟踪，尾随（shadow sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was shadowed for a week by the secret police. 他被秘密警察跟踪了一个星期。（课件）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】跟随（管理人员等）实地学习，见习跟岗
uncommonMeanings.example: It is often helpful for teachers to shadow managers in industry. 教师跟随业界的管理人员实地学习，常常会很有收获。（课件）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】一丝，一点点（a shadow of a smile 一丝笑意）
uncommonMeanings.example: A shadow of a smile touched his mouth. 他嘴角透出一丝笑意。（课件）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (暗中)跟踪,尾随
uncommonMeanings.example: Sensing that the man in the grey coat had been shadowing her for three streets, she quickened her pace and slipped into the crowded market, her heart pounding against her ribs. （读后续写·悬疑·跟踪）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一丝,一点点(a shadow of doubt 一丝怀疑)
uncommonMeanings.example: When he finally confessed the truth, without a shadow of hesitation, the last trace of anger in her eyes melted into something close to respect. （读后续写·坦白·和解）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (临时)见习跟岗,观摩学习(job shadowing)
uncommonMeanings.example: For a whole week she shadowed the veteran nurse, watching how a steady hand and a warm word could soothe pain no medicine ever reached. （读后续写·职业体验·成长）

posExamples.sentence: As the sun sank behind the hills, the boy's shadow stretched longer and longer across the golden field, until it seemed to reach all the way back to the home he had left that morning. （读后续写·黄昏·思乡）
I am writing to remind everyone that hiking after dusk can be dangerous, for once the mountain falls into shadow, even the most familiar path grows treacherous and easy to lose. （应用文·安全提醒）
Living forever in the shadow of a brilliant sibling can quietly crush a child's confidence, which is why every parent should learn to celebrate difference rather than demand comparison. （议论文·家庭教育）
A shadow of doubt crossed her face as she reread the letter, for the handwriting was her brother's, yet the words sounded like those of a stranger. （读后续写·疑惑·转折）

wordForms.other: overshadow

idioms.translation: 生活在某人的阴影下(总被人比下去)
idioms.example: For years the younger brother had lived in the shadow of a champion he could never seem to equal, until the day he finally stopped racing others and began racing only himself. （读后续写·成长·走出阴影）
Without a shadow of a doubt, the quiet girl in the back row had written the finest essay the old teacher had read in twenty years. （读后续写·才华被发现）
The news of the coming storm cast a long shadow over the graduation ceremony, yet the students refused to let it dim the joy they had earned. （读后续写·毕业·坚韧）

idioms.idiom: be afraid of one's own shadow
idioms.example: Bullied since childhood, he had grown afraid of his own shadow, flinching at every raised voice in the crowded corridor. （读后续写·创伤·怯懦）

collocations.translation: 【课件】被（某人）的光彩所掩盖，生活在某人的阴影下
collocations.example: For years, his second daughter has been living in the shadow of his elder daughter. 多年来，他的二女儿一直生活在大女儿的光彩之下。（课件）

collocations.translation: 【课件】紧挨着（= be very close to）
collocations.example: The new market is in the shadow of the City Hall. 新建的市场紧挨着市政厅。（课件）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在……上投下影子；给……蒙上阴影
collocations.example: The ship's sail cast a shadow on the water. 船帆在水面上投下一片影子。/ He didn't want to cast a shadow on their happiness. 他不想给他们的幸福蒙上阴影。（课件）
A shadow of a smile touched his mouth. 他嘴角透出一丝笑意。（课件）

collocations.translation: 生活在某人的阴影下（总被比下去）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If you have friends who are good-looking or have a great fashion sense, it can feel like you are living in their shadow. 如果你的朋友长得好看或很有时尚品味，你会感觉活在他们的阴影里。（课文原句）
The ancient oak cast a cool, welcoming shadow across the yard, and beneath it the tired travellers finally set down their heavy packs. （读后续写·旅途·歇脚）
The tiny village sat quietly in the shadow of a great snow-capped mountain, sheltered from the wind and forgotten by the wider world. （读后续写·环境描写）
The news of the coming storm cast a long shadow over the graduation ceremony, yet the students refused to let it dim the joy they had earned. （读后续写·毕业·坚韧）

collocations.phrase: throw / cast a long shadow over
collocations.example: The failure of that first experiment threw a long shadow over the young scientist's confidence, and for weeks she hardly dared enter the lab. （读后续写·科研·挫折）
The painter spent his whole life chasing the delicate play of light and shadow on ordinary faces, convinced that beauty hid in the smallest details. （读后续写·艺术家）

collocations.phrase: a shadow of one's former self
collocations.translation: 今非昔比,大不如前(某人)
collocations.example: After the long illness he was but a shadow of his former self, yet the fire in his eyes when he spoke of his dreams had not dimmed at all. （读后续写·病后·意志）

collocations.phrase: beyond / without a shadow of doubt
collocations.example: Her selfless courage that night proved, beyond a shadow of doubt, that true heroes are not born but made in the heat of the moment. （议论文·英雄品质）
As the shadows lengthened across the empty playground, the old caretaker locked the gate and remembered, for a moment, the laughter that had once filled it. （读后续写·黄昏·怀旧）
Too shy to join the celebration, she hid in the shadows at the edge of the hall, watching the dancing lights she longed to step into. （读后续写·内向·渴望）

synonyms.example: At noon the exhausted farmers gathered in the shade of a spreading fig tree, sharing water and stories until the fierce heat had passed. （读后续写·田间·歇息）
synonyms.usage: 指'阴凉的区域'(供人乘凉),不表某物投下的具体轮廓;shadow 指有轮廓的'影子',也可喻'阴影、笼罩'

synonyms.example: There was not a trace of anger in his voice, only a deep and weary tenderness. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 在'一丝、一点点'义上与 a shadow of 相近,但 trace 更常用、更中性;a shadow of 常带阴郁或强调色彩(a shadow of doubt)

synonyms.example: The stray dog followed the boy all the way home, its hopeful eyes begging for a bowl of food and a place to belong. （读后续写·流浪·温情）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'跟随',中性;shadow(vt.)特指'暗中、持续地跟踪监视',带隐蔽和目的性,语气更强

advancedExpressions.expression: live in sb's shadow / in the shadow of sth / cast a shadow over sth / without a shadow of doubt / a shadow of one's former self
advancedExpressions.example: live in sb's shadow 活在某人阴影下（课文）；cast/throw a shadow over 使蒙上阴影；without a shadow of doubt 毫无疑问；a shadow of a doubt 一丝怀疑。

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: These external influences are always present, but there are certainly ways to deal with them.
readingExamples: These external influences are always present, but there are certainly ways to deal with them.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to or existing on the outside or outer part of something
(2) adj. coming from or relating to things outside a particular person, group, or situation
(3) adj. connected with foreign countries; relating to affairs outside one's own organization or country
(4) adj. (of a student) attending an institution's examinations without following its regular courses

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对外的,涉外的(external affairs 外交/对外事务)
uncommonMeanings.example: As the small nation opened its doors, the young minister found herself suddenly in charge of external affairs, negotiating late into the night with envoys twice her age. （读后续写·外交·成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 外用的(药物, 常见于 for external use only)
uncommonMeanings.example: The label warned in bold red letters that the ointment was for external use only, and the frightened child, having licked his cut finger clean, wondered whether he had done something terribly wrong. （读后续写·童年·误会）

posExamples.sentence: She had learned, through years of quiet suffering, that no external praise could ever fill the hollow within; peace had to be built, brick by patient brick, from the inside out. （读后续写·成长·内在力量）
I am writing to remind all club members that our final decision must rest on the project's real value, not on external pressures such as fashion or the fear of what others might say. （应用文·倡议书）
While external influences such as advertising and peer approval undeniably shape our choices, a truly independent mind learns to weigh them coolly rather than to obey them blindly. （议论文·独立思考）

From the outside the mansion looked flawless, every external wall gleaming white in the sun, yet behind those proud windows lived a loneliness that all the money in the world could not cure. （读后续写·表里反差）

wordForms.other: externalisation

collocations.translation: 外部影响（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: These external influences are always present, but there are certainly ways to deal with them. （课文原句）

Buckling under the external pressure of a demanding coach and disappointed parents, the young gymnast almost quit — until she remembered why she had first fallen in love with the sport. （读后续写·压力·初心）
We judge far too much by external appearance, forgetting that the plainest cover may hide the richest of stories within. （议论文·勿以貌取人）
Lost in her books, she built a quiet fortress against the noisy external world, one where kings, oceans and distant galaxies were only ever a page away. （读后续写·阅读·避风港）

The pharmacist circled the words 'for external use only' twice, making sure the elderly patient understood before he shuffled slowly out into the rain. （读后续写·关怀·细节）

collocations.translation: 外部的与内部的（反义 internal）
collocations.example: Every great challenge, the wise old coach said, is fought on two fronts at once — the external one you can see, and the internal one only you can feel. （读后续写·人生哲理）
She backed up three years of research onto an external hard drive minutes before the storm knocked out the power, a small habit that saved her entire thesis. （读后续写·未雨绸缪）

synonyms.example: Beneath its rough outer shell the coconut hid a sweetness the shipwrecked sailors had almost stopped believing in. （读后续写·荒岛·希望）
synonyms.usage: 指位置上'外层/外面的',常修饰具体物体的层次(outer shell/wall);external 更抽象、更正式,常喻'来自外界的'(external pressure)

synonyms.example: News of the outside world reached the mountain village only once a month, carried up the winding path by a single weary postman. （读后续写·闭塞·山村）
synonyms.usage: 口语常用,可作形容词/名词/介词/副词,较随意;external 更书面正式,尤用于抽象概念(external factors/affairs)

synonyms.example: In a foreign city where every face was a stranger's, the sound of her own language drifting from a small café brought sudden, overwhelming tears. （读后续写·异乡·思乡）
synonyms.usage: 指'外国的'或'陌生、不熟悉的';在'对外事务'义上与 external affairs 相近,但 external 更中性,foreign 明确指涉'国外'

advancedExpressions.expression: ex-（向外）+ tern（源自 external/exterior/extend）→ external 外部的；反义 internal（in- 向内）
advancedExpressions.example: external（外部的）↔ internal（内部的）；同族：exterior（外部/外表）、externally（从外部）。记法：ex- 表'向外'，凡'向外/在外'皆用它。

advancedExpressions.expression: external ... may ..., but ultimately it is internal ... that ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Countless external forces — the glare of others' opinions, the pull of passing fashions, the sting of quiet comparison — press in upon us every single day; yet within each of us lies a quiet compass that, once trusted, can steer us safely through them all. （读后续写·成长·内在坚定）

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be a grave mistake to...正式评判句式 + measure...worth by 抽象搭配 + mere external appearance 弱化外表 + for 引出理由 + 平行结构(a heart of...a mind of...)

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: Focusing on your strengths also helps you build your confidence.
readingExamples: Focusing on your strengths also helps you build your confidence.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the quality of being physically strong; the amount of physical power a person or animal has
(2) n. a good quality or ability that makes someone or something effective or successful
(3) n. the degree to which something is powerful, intense or concentrated
(4) n. the ability to deal with difficult situations with courage and determination

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优点，长处，强项（课文义：focus on your strengths；常与 weaknesses 对举，此义常用复数 strengths）

uncommonMeanings.example: By dawn the volunteer team had swollen to full strength, over three hundred pairs of hands ready to dig through the rubble for survivors. （读后续写·灾后救援·凝聚力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （酒、溶液的）浓度

I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the exchange programme, for his greatest strength lies not in his grades but in his unshakeable resolve to help everyone around him. （应用文·推荐信）
True strength of character reveals itself not in moments of triumph, but in how gracefully one rises after being knocked down by failure. （议论文·品格·逆境成长）
Focusing on your strengths rather than dwelling on your weaknesses is the surest way to build lasting self-confidence. （议论文·自我认知）

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: Take pride in things you do well instead of worrying about things you cannot change.
readingExamples: Take pride in things you do well instead of worrying about things you cannot change.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to feel proud and satisfied about something you own, have done or are connected with
(2) phr. to give special care and attention to something because it matters to you

posExamples.sentence: Wiping the sweat from her brow, the old cleaner stepped back to admire the gleaming floor — she took quiet pride in a job that others thought beneath them. （读后续写·平凡岗位·尊严）
As students of this school, we should take pride in our campus and do our part to keep every corner clean and green. （应用文·倡议书）

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: However, like a book, your contents are much more important than your cover.

definitionEn:
(1) n. (contents) the things that are contained in something such as a box, room or book
(2) n. the subject matter, ideas or information dealt with in a book, speech, film or website
(3) n. the amount of a particular substance contained in something
(4) adj. happy and satisfied with what you have, without wanting more

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: If you can learn to see the good things about yourself—your individuality, your value to others, your achievements—you will soon begin to love yourself just the way you are.
readingExamples: If you can learn to see the good things about yourself—your individuality, your value to others, your achievements—you will soon begin to love yourself just the way you are.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the qualities that make a person or thing distinctly different from others; distinctive character
(2) n. the state or condition of existing as an independent individual, separate from the group

posExamples.sentence: Amid a sea of identical uniforms, she expressed her individuality through a single hand-painted badge, and somehow that tiny splash of colour made her unforgettable. （读后续写·校园·独特性）
I firmly believe our school should encourage students' individuality rather than force everyone into the same narrow mould. （应用文·建议信）
A healthy society is one that celebrates individuality while still nurturing a strong sense of shared responsibility. （议论文·个性与集体）
Learning to see your own individuality — your value to others, your achievements — is the first step towards genuine self-love. （议论文·自我认知）

wordForms.other: 构词法：individual(adj./n. 个人的/个人) + -ity（名词后缀，表性质/状态）→ individuality(n. 个性)；派生链 individual → individually(adv.) → individualism(n. 个人主义)。小贴士：-ity 是把形容词变抽象名词的高频后缀（real→reality, active→activity）

collocations.phrase: your individuality (, your value to others, your achievements)
collocations.translation: 【课件】你的个性（、你对别人的价值、你的成就）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: …your individuality, your value to others, your achievements… 你的个性、你对别人的价值、你的成就……（课件·课文原句；PPT此处误作 our value，课文原文为 your value，已按原文订正）
Through her bold, unconventional paintings, she found a way to express an individuality words could never capture. （读后续写·艺术·自我）
Growing up in a large family, he fought hard to preserve a sense of individuality all his own. （读后续写·成长）
Good teachers respect each child's individuality instead of demanding blind conformity. （议论文·教育）
It takes real courage to preserve your individuality when everyone around you is chasing the same trend. （议论文·从众与坚持）
Our art festival celebrates individuality, welcoming every style, however strange or bold. （应用文·活动介绍）
An education that stifles individuality produces obedient followers but few true innovators. （议论文·教育弊端）

synonyms.example: The old town had a character all its own, from its crooked lanes to its friendly, weathered faces. （读后续写·环境·特色）
synonyms.usage: character 既指人的性格，也指地方、事物的独特气质；individuality 更强调与众不同、区别于他人的独特性

synonyms.example: It was the uniqueness of her voice, rough yet tender, that set her apart from every other singer. （读后续写·才华·独特）
synonyms.usage: uniqueness 强调独一无二、无可替代；individuality 更强调作为独立个体所具有的鲜明个人特质

synonyms.example: Moving abroad, she struggled to hold on to her cultural identity in an unfamiliar land. （读后续写·文化·归属）
synonyms.usage: identity 强调自我认同、归属和身份；individuality 强调把自己与他人区分开来的独特个性

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ity 抽象名词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: individual(adj.) + -ity → individuality(n. 个性)；同类：real→reality, active→activity, pure→purity
advancedExpressions.example: The suffix -ity turns an adjective into an abstract noun, so 'individual' becomes 'individuality', meaning the quality of being one's own unique self. （构词法讲解）

advancedExpressions.expression: express / show one's individuality（展现个性）；respect / celebrate individuality（尊重/赞美个性）；stifle / suppress individuality（扼杀个性）
advancedExpressions.example: A good school celebrates individuality rather than stifling it, letting every unique mind express itself freely. （对比短语连用，教育主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was her individuality, not her conformity, that finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was her individuality, not her willingness to blend in, that finally won the world's respect — she had dared to be no one but herself. （强调句+not...that对比+破折号升华，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely hope our school can honour each student's individuality
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely hope our school can honour each student's individuality, offering courses varied enough for every unique mind to flourish. （委婉表建议+现在分词补充，建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: a society thrives when it embraces individuality rather than demanding uniformity
advancedExpressions.example: A society truly thrives when it embraces individuality rather than demanding rigid uniformity, for it is difference, not sameness, that drives progress. （rather than对比+for原因状语，论证个性价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was different from the others and proud of it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While the other girls dressed and spoke alike, she wore her individuality like a quiet banner — and, in time, the very difference they had once mocked became the thing they most admired. （读后续写·独特·转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While让步对比开头 + 明喻(like a quiet banner) + 破折号转折 + the very...they had mocked became强调命运反转

sentenceUpgrade.original: Schools should let students keep their individuality.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than pressing every student into a single mould, schools should cherish and cultivate the individuality that makes each young mind irreplaceable. （议论文·教育）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than doing对比开头 + press into a mould比喻 + cherish and cultivate动词并列 + that定语从句凸显不可替代性

classPractice.note: 课文原句；your + 抽象名词 individuality 个性

classPractice.question: The teacher spoke to each child ____ (individual), giving everyone a few private words of encouragement.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 spoke 需副词 individually 逐个地/单独地

sub_section: Article: Don't judge a book by its cover
original_sentence: If you can learn to see the good things about yourself—your individuality, your value to others, your achievements—you will soon begin to love yourself just the way you are.
readingExamples: If you can learn to see the good things about yourself—your individuality, your value to others, your achievements—you will soon begin to love yourself just the way you are.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
(2) n. the act or process of achieving something; the fact of gaining something you want by effort
(3) n. (in education) a level of skill or knowledge that a student has reached in a subject

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （不带冠词）达成、完成（某目标的过程本身，而非成果）
uncommonMeanings.example: The achievement of true fluency in a foreign language demands not a single burst of effort, but years of quiet, unglamorous persistence. （议论文·语言学习）

posExamples.sentence: When she finally pinned her painting to the classroom wall, a warm glow of achievement spread through her chest, and for the first time she dared to meet the teacher's eyes without shrinking. （读后续写·成长自信）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the scholarship, as his remarkable academic achievements and unwavering dedication set him far apart from his peers. （应用文·推荐信）
Genuine achievement is measured not by the applause we receive, but by the obstacles we overcome and the people we lift up along the way. （议论文·成功的定义）
Standing at the summit, breathless yet triumphant, the boy realised that this hard-won achievement had cost him blisters, tears and countless doubts—and was worth every one of them. （读后续写·登山励志）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：achieve(v.) + -ment → achievement(n. 成就)；achieve + -able → achievable(adj. 可实现的)；achieve + -er → achiever(n. 有成就者)。小贴士：a sense of achievement 成就感；achieve one's goal / dream 实现目标/梦想

idioms.example: Nothing rivals the deep sense of achievement that floods over you when a goal, once thought impossible, finally lies conquered in your hands. （读后续写·情感升华）

collocations.phrase: make an achievement in / make great achievements in
collocations.example: In the last few years, China has made great achievements in environmental protection. 在过去几年里，中国在环境保护方面取得了巨大成就。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】你的成就（something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts）
collocations.example: …your individuality, your value to others, your achievements… 你的个性、你对别人的价值、你的成就……（课件·课文原句；PPT此处误作 our value，课文原文为 your value，已按原文订正）

collocations.phrase: your achievements (your value to others, your individuality)
collocations.translation: 你的成就（你对他人的价值、你的个性）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If you can learn to see the good things about yourself—your individuality, your value to others, your achievements—you will soon begin to love yourself just the way you are. （课文原句）
Volunteering at the nursing home gave the students a profound sense of achievement that no exam score could ever provide. （应用文·活动感悟）
Winning the national debating championship at fifteen was a remarkable achievement that earned her the admiration of the entire school. （应用文·表彰通知）
The school celebrates not only academic achievement but also the quieter virtues of kindness and perseverance. （议论文·教育理念）
Restoring the old library single-handedly was, in the eyes of the whole village, a proud achievement worthy of a plaque. （读后续写·社区）
His achievements in scientific research have brought honour to a country that once had little standing in the field. （议论文·科技强国）
The ceremony was held to recognise the achievements of every volunteer who had given their weekends to the community. （应用文·致辞）
The elderly teacher was honoured with a lifetime achievement award, though he insisted his students were his only true reward. （读后续写·师恩）
Providing free after-school tutoring is one effective way to narrow the achievement gap between rich and poor districts. （议论文·教育公平）

synonyms.example: Learning to swim at forty was, for my mother, an accomplishment she recounted with quiet pride for years afterward. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 与 achievement 高度近义，但更强调技能的习得与才艺，也可指‘造诣’；achievement 更泛指靠努力取得的重大成果

synonyms.example: Their success in raising ten thousand yuan for the flood victims proved that determined teenagers can move mountains. （议论文·青年担当）
synonyms.usage: 指结果层面的‘成功’，抽象、可数或不可数；achievement 更侧重‘做成的那一件具体事’

synonyms.example: Crossing the desert on foot was a feat of endurance that few believed possible. （读后续写·冒险）
synonyms.usage: 书面、褒扬色彩浓，指需要极大勇气或技巧的壮举，比 achievement 更具戏剧性和罕见性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·achieve 高频搭配（课件·拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: achieve vt. 达到，获得（通常指通过努力、技巧、勇气等获得或做成某事）：achieve success（获得成功）/ achieve one's ambition（实现抱负）/ achieve one's aim（达成目的）/ achieve balance（取得平衡）
advancedExpressions.example: Only through years of relentless effort did she finally achieve the balance between career and family she had long dreamed of. 只有经过多年不懈的努力，她才终于取得了梦寐以求的事业与家庭之间的平衡。（课件搭配串用）

advancedExpressions.expression: achieve(v.) → achievement(n.)；a sense of achievement（成就感）；achieve one's goal / dream（实现目标）
advancedExpressions.example: Only by working hard can you achieve your goals and enjoy the deep sense of achievement that follows. （词族串用，励志主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sense of achievement（成就感）；a remarkable / outstanding achievement（非凡成就）；recognise / celebrate one's achievements（认可成就）
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing gives a greater sense of achievement than seeing your outstanding achievements recognised by those you respect. （多短语连用）

advancedExpressions.expression: the achievement was not the medal, but the ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the crowd cheered, he understood that the real achievement was not the medal around his neck, but the fear he had finally left behind on the starting line. （对比句式，续写结尾点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s achievements speak for themselves
advancedExpressions.example: I need hardly elaborate on his qualifications, for his achievements speak for themselves. （推荐信中简洁有力的背书套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: true achievement lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True achievement lies not in outshining others, but in becoming a better version of oneself than the day before. （对比结构，定义类论点句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She felt happy about her achievement.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A quiet, unfamiliar warmth—the glow of hard-won achievement—rose within her, and she found herself blinking back tears she had not expected. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入语补充定义(the glow of hard-won achievement) + 心理动词短语(rose within her) + 细节动作(blinking back tears)增强画面感

sentenceUpgrade.original: His achievements are great, so he deserves the award.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In light of his outstanding achievements, both in the classroom and in service to others, I am firmly convinced that no candidate is more deserving of this honour. （应用文·推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In light of...状语引出依据 + both...and...并列范围 + I am firmly convinced that...正式主观判断

sub_section: Designing an app about a healthy lifestyle
original_sentence: Our app is called 'Easy Healthy Eating'. Its purpose is to help people eat healthily by making all aspects of planning meals easier.
readingExamples: Our app is called 'Easy Healthy Eating'. Its purpose is to help people eat healthily by making all aspects of planning meals easier.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (informal, short for application) a computer program designed for a particular purpose, especially one that you download onto a mobile phone or tablet
(2) n. a piece of software that performs a specific task within a larger system

posExamples.sentence: Late that night, unable to sleep, she opened the meditation app her sister had recommended, and slowly the gentle voice guided her racing thoughts into stillness. （读后续写·情绪疗愈）
I am writing to introduce our newly designed app, 'Green Steps', which encourages students to record their daily eco-friendly actions and compete for weekly rewards. （应用文·产品介绍信）
While a well-designed app can undoubtedly make learning more convenient, we must not allow it to replace the deep, patient thinking that no screen can teach. （议论文·科技与学习）
With one tap on the delivery app, a hot meal appeared at his door within minutes—yet he could not shake the strange loneliness of eating dinner alone again. （读后续写·都市孤独）

wordForms.other: 构词法·缩合（clipping）：app 是 application 的口语缩写形式（截取词首）；作可数名词 an app / two apps。小贴士：正式书面用 application，日常与手机软件语境用 app；类似缩合词：exam(examination), fridge(refrigerator), photo(photograph)

collocations.phrase: our app is called ... / its purpose is to ...
collocations.translation: 我们的应用叫…/它的目的是…（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Our app is called 'Easy Healthy Eating'. Its purpose is to help people eat healthily by making all aspects of planning meals easier. （课文原句）
Before the hiking trip, we downloaded an offline map app so that no dead signal could ever leave us stranded. （读后续写·户外）
Our team has developed a mobile app that reminds elderly users to take their medicine at the right time. （应用文·公益项目）
She launched the translation app and, to her delight, chatted freely with the foreign tourist for the very first time. （读后续写·跨文化）
The purpose of designing this app is to help people eat healthily by making every step of meal planning easier. （应用文·项目说明）

collocations.phrase: an app for doing sth / to do sth
collocations.example: There is now an app for almost everything, from tracking sleep to identifying birdsong in your garden. （议论文·数字生活）
After realising how much time it stole from his studies, he deleted the game app without a moment's regret. （读后续写·自律成长）

collocations.translation: 健身/语言学习/导航应用
collocations.example: A good language-learning app can supplement classroom study, but it can never substitute for real conversation. （议论文·学习工具）

synonyms.example: The company released a new application that allows farmers to monitor soil moisture from their phones. （应用文·科技报道）
synonyms.usage: app 是 application 的口语缩写，日常与手机软件语境用 app；正式书面、科技文档中用 application 更严谨

synonyms.example: The computer program was designed to detect errors that the human eye would easily miss. （议论文·人工智能）
synonyms.usage: program 泛指各类计算机程序（含电脑端大型软件），概念更广；app 特指小巧、面向特定用途、常在移动端的程序

synonyms.example: The school installed new software to help students with dyslexia read more comfortably. （应用文·校园改进）
synonyms.usage: software 为不可数总称，指软件整体；app 为可数，指某一具体应用

advancedExpressions.expression: app = application（截取词首的口语缩写）；同类缩合：exam=examination, photo=photograph, fridge=refrigerator, gym=gymnasium
advancedExpressions.example: 'App' is simply a short, informal form of 'application', just as 'photo' is short for 'photograph'. （构词法讲解·缩合）

advancedExpressions.expression: with a single tap on the app, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a single tap on the app, the whole world seemed to shrink into her palm—yet the warmth of a real handshake was still nowhere to be found. （以科技动作切入，转折带出主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the purpose of the app is to ... by doing ...
advancedExpressions.example: The purpose of our app is to promote healthy eating by making meal planning simple, visual and even enjoyable. （介绍信中说明功能的标准句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: convenient as apps are, they should never ...
advancedExpressions.example: Convenient as apps are, they should never become a substitute for genuine human connection or independent thought. （as 引导让步倒装，辩证论点句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He opened the app and felt less lonely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He tapped the app open, and as familiar voices drifted from the speaker, the empty flat suddenly felt a little less like a cage and a little more like home. （读后续写·情感转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作+并列结果(as...drifted) + 比喻对比(cage / home) + 副词递进(a little less...a little more)营造情绪缓和

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our app helps people eat healthily.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Designed with both convenience and well-being in mind, our app 'Easy Healthy Eating' guides users through every stage of meal planning, turning a daily chore into an effortless, even pleasurable, routine. （应用文·产品介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语开头(Designed with...)交代设计理念 + guide sb. through every stage 强调全流程 + turning...into 现在分词状语点出价值转化

classPractice.question: 我们的应用程序叫'轻松健康饮食'。它的目的是帮助人们健康饮食。Our ____ is called 'Easy Healthy Eating'. Its purpose is to help people eat healthily.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；an app 应用程序，可数名词，此处与 our 连用

classPractice.question: The word 'app' is actually a short form of the full word ____ (apply).
classPractice.note: 构词法·缩合：app 是 application 的缩写；apply 的名词形式 application 应用程序
